jobs.title: H&M Sales Advisor- Dimond Center
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Sales Advisor, you'll be responsible for providing excellent customer service, welcoming & guiding customers through your store to actively sell our products and providing customers with support & guidance. You'll use your fashion and product knowledge to provide our customers with all the relevant information they need for the best experience. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service
• Willingness to engage and have conversations with customers to provide excellent service
• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store
• Ability to effectively promote and sell our products to customers
• Actively promote our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Support with commercial or operational actions to reach sales targets with store management team

General Information

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc.
• Use your product & fashion knowledge to share relevant information to customers

Team & Development

• Retain and share your service, fashion and store operations knowledge and skills with colleagues
• Follow all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding, introduction processes & trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Complete full garment cycle from unpacking and refill to steaming and ensure good garment care
• Operate fitting room and checkout areas according to best practice & processes
• Contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house (including stockrooms)
• Support with garment presentation, execution and maintain attractive merchandise displays, clear trends & stories according to visual & commercial guidelines
• Ensure good stock levels with replenishment routines on sales floor
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $16.00 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Organizational Change Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Organizational Change Manager plays a critical role in ensuring the successful implementation and sustainment of key process and technology changes across Centria Autism Services. This role is responsible for leading change initiatives, driving adoption among all roles within the organization, and ensuring long-term success through the development of change champions and leadership coaching.

Additionally, the Organizational Change Manager is responsible for ensuring that leadership teams are trained to the extent necessary to sustain the change. This includes ensuring that leadership understands not only the processes and tools associated with the change but also why the change is being implemented, enabling them to communicate, reinforce, and model the change effectively.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role that requires significant travel (75%) to various Centria locations to provide in-person support, training, and engagement.

Duties and Responsibilities

The below reflects the essential functions considered necessary for this role and shall not be construed as a detailed description of all work requirements inherent in the job or assigned by supervisory personnel. This job description is used as a guide only and not inclusive of all responsibilities and job duties.

• Change Implementation and Adoption

• Collaborate with the Implementation Specialist to develop strategic rollout plans that ensure smooth transitions for new systems and processes.

• Execute and routinize change initiatives in alignment with project charters, ensuring timely and effective implementation.

• Engage with team members at all levels to drive understanding, adoption, and execution of new processes and technologies.

• Provide on-site and virtual training, coaching, and support to ensure successful transitions.

• Develop and deploy communication strategies to promote awareness and buy-in for key initiatives.

2. Leadership Training and Competency Development

• Ensure that leadership teams are trained to the level required to sustain the change long-term.

• Ensure leadership competency in managing change, including understanding why the change is being implemented, the expected outcomes, and how to support staff through the transition.

• Equip leaders with the knowledge and tools necessary to effectively reinforce and role model the change within their teams.

• Develop and facilitate leadership training sessions, workshops, and one-on-one coaching to ensure leaders can confidently answer questions and drive continued adoption

3. System Expertise and Managing Minimal Viable Product (MVP)/Agile Changes

• Develop deep expertise in all new and existing systems, ensuring the ability to anticipate questions, challenges, and user adoption barriers. System expertise is including but not limited to CareConnect (web and mobile), TechConnect, Kronos, Greenhouse, G-Suite (including Gemini), Scout, and the Pulse.

• Identify and proactively address issues that may arise with system changes, ensuring smooth integration into existing workflows.

• Manage staff through rapidly evolving system updates by providing clear communication, training, and support as changes are iterated upon.

• Adapt to a minimal viable product/agile (MVP) approach, recognizing that initial rollouts may require iterative improvements and ensuring that teams remain agile and engaged throughout the evolution of system changes.

4. Sustainment and Compliance

• Measure and track ongoing compliance with implemented changes through data reviews and case file audits.

• Identify areas of resistance and develop targeted interventions to reinforce change adoption.

• Establish mechanisms for continuous feedback and improvement to enhance change sustainability.

5. Change Champion and Leadership Development

• Identify and cultivate Change Champions within each region or department undergoing transformation.

• Equip leaders with the skills and tools necessary to manage change effectively within their teams.

• Facilitate workshops and leadership coaching sessions to build internal change capability.

5. Performance Measurement and Reporting

• Define and track key success metrics, including: Leadership competency: Observe and report on leadership’s ability to show high level of competency in change as measured through ability to articulate the reason for the change and model the change. Change adoption: Attainment of project outcomes as defined in the project charter. Satisfaction: Feedback from post-implementation surveys. Sustainability: Ongoing compliance through case file audits and data reviews. Provide regular reports and insights to leadership on the impact and effectiveness of change initiatives.

6. Compliance with Centria’s Code of Conduct, policies and procedures, and Federal and State laws.

7. Responsibility to report violations of Company policies or the Code of Conduct.

Qualifications

These guidelines can be used to make a list of qualifications required (or preferred) to perform the job successfully.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in business or relevant background and experience in organizational change

Preferred Work Experience

• 3+ years of experience in change management, organizational development, or process improvement.

• Strong facilitation and training skills with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders.

• Experience in leadership training and competency development, with a focus on ensuring leaders understand and can sustain change.

• Experience in the healthcare or ABA industry.

• Prosci or similar change management certification.

• Six Sigma or Lean certification a plus

Working Conditions

Centria’s office hours are Monday through Friday from 8:30am-6:00pm. Additional time may be required to complete above work or meet company objectives.

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this job, physical requirements such as bending, reaching and lifting of up to 50 pounds may be required. This role will require sitting a majority of the day as well as walking as standing when needed. This role will require close visual activity on multiple computer screens or monitors and the ability to analyze data and figures on a screen.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, Veteran status, or disability status. This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of qualifications, skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities, or working conditions associated with the position.  Centria reserves the right to amend this job description at any time, with or without written notice.

jobs.title: Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting
jobs.description:
Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting

*This is a remote position that requires you to work closely and collaboratively with internal teams.*

About Townsquare Media:

Townsquare is a community-focused digital and broadcast media and digital marketing solutions company principally focused on markets outside the top 50 in the U.S. Our assets include 340 radio stations across 74 local markets, more than 400 local news and entertainment websites and mobile apps, a subscription digital marketing services business (Townsquare Interactive) and a digital advertising division (Townsquare Ignite).

About the Opportunity:

The Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting owns Townsquare’s external reporting and technical accounting and is a key member of the accounting leadership team.

Responsibilities:

• Oversee all aspects of the market operation with a particular focus on revenue generation across Townsquare’s multiple media and entertainment platforms.

• Create a vision and strategy for consistent revenue and profit growth, with the ability to communicate and execute the plan

• Support the content team (on air and on line) and hold them accountable to executing the brand strategy and delivering content excellence.

• Recruit, train & develop top sales talent

• Lead their sales team to exceed revenue targets by developing a sales strategy and holding the team accountable to hitting and exceeding their individual goals.

• Ensure the station’s license is in order and that Federal Communications Commission (FCC) and other federal, state and local rules and regulations are followed.

• Drive key account growth through the selling of results based, integrated programs while also pushing significant new business development.

• Prepare and manage the fiscal budget. Develop/implement strategic goals to exceed local advertising, live events and digital services budgets.

• Represent TSM to key client accounts and community; developing strong client relationships and community partnerships that further our business.

Qualifications:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education & Experience:

• 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including public accounting (Big 4 or national firm preferred) and either at least three years of SEC reporting at a public registrant or equivalent experience auditing public companies.

• Assist in preparing sales presentations, proposals, and promotional materials
• Ensure promotional material inventory is stocked and accounted for

• Participate in internal planning meetings to review upcoming events and operational requirements
• Support event execution by acting as a liaison between the client and operational teams
• Monitor event timelines and ensure deliverables are completed on schedule

• Serve as a point of contact for group clients and event planners regarding logistics and coordination

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Manager, Data Centers
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

As Senior Commercial Manager, Data Centers, you will drive the commercial activities that support Nebius's data center expansion and operations across the United States.You will be the primary point of coordination between our data center providers and internal Infrastructure, Legal, Finance, Treasury, and Procurement teams. Your scope will include provider funding requests, contractual commitments, change orders, prepayments, and commercial issues affecting delivery. We are looking for someone who takes ownership from the initial request through final execution: clarifying requirements, resolving open questions, securing approvals, coordinating signatures and payments, and confirming that commitments are fulfilled. You will need to work independently, manage competing priorities, and bring structure to complex situations.

This remote position will require travel between Data Centers.

Your responsibilities will include:

Provider commercial management

• Own the coordination of commercial matters with colocation providers, data center developers, and power infrastructure partners.

• Review provider requests for completeness, supporting documentation, contractual basis, and alignment with agreed scope and milestones.

• Coordinate negotiations on change orders, payment schedules, and other commercial arrangements with the relevant business owners and Legal.

• Track provider obligations and follow through on unresolved commitments, discrepancies, and disputes.

Funding and Payment Coordination

• Drive funding requests, milestone payments, deposits, and prepayments through internal review and approval.

• Maintain a consolidated view of requested, approved, committed, and paid amounts across projects.

• Reconcile revised requests, funding reallocations, and previously paid amounts with Finance and providers.

• Coordinate with Legal and Finance on loan arrangements, escrow releases, guarantees, and other funding structures when required.

• Ensure documentation, signatures, and authorized approvals are completed before Treasury releases funds, and confirm payment receipt and allocation with providers.

Cross- Functional Execution

• Establish clear owners, deadlines, and next steps across Infrastructure, Legal, Finance, Treasury, and Procurement.

• Lead focused reviews to resolve open issues and secure decisions.

• Prepare concise recommendations explaining the request, available options, financial implications, and delivery impact.

• Escalate unresolved issues early and drive them through to closure.

Delivery Alignment and Reporting

• Work with construction, power, and operations teams to connect commercial decisions to project schedules and capacity availability.

• Identify funding or contractual dependencies that could delay procurement, construction, commissioning, or handover.

• Provide leadership with clear reporting on outstanding commitments, upcoming payments, and decisions required.

• Build repeatable processes for provider requests, approvals, documentation, and reporting as the portfolio grows.

What we expect you to have:

• 7+ years of relevant experience in commercial management, infrastructure business operations, project controls, or capital project delivery.

• Experience managing commercial activities involving data centers, energy, construction, real estate development, or other capital-intensive infrastructure.

• A demonstrated ability to drive work across Legal, Finance, and operational teams without direct reporting authority.

• Strong understanding of contract administration, change orders, payment milestones, budgets, and financial commitments.

• Confidence reviewing financial information, identifying inconsistencies, and challenging incomplete or unsupported requests.

• Strong negotiation, stakeholder management, and written communication skills.

• The ability to manage several complex matters simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and clear priorities.

• A bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

It would be an an added bonus if you have:

• Experience working with hyperscale or AI data center providers.

• Familiarity with colocation agreements, utility contracts, escrow arrangements, and infrastructure financing.

• Experience establishing commercial processes in a rapidly growing organization.

• An understanding of data center construction, power availability, commissioning, and operational handover.

Key employee benefits:

• Health insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental and vision coverage for employees and families.

• 401(k) plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.

• Parental leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.

• Remote work reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.

• Disability & life insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term and life insurance coverage.

Compensation
We offer competitive salaries ranging from $115K to $225K OTE, which includes base salary and performance bonus. Equity in the form of RSUs may be available at certain salary grades.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range

$115,000—$225,000 USD

Benefits & Perks:

• Competitive compensation

• Career growth and learning opportunities

• Flexibility and ownership

• Collaborative and innovative culture

• Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

• International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

jobs.title: Threat Hunter/Purple Team Operator
jobs.description:
Threat Hunter / Purple Team Operator

SIXGEN's mission is to deliver agile, mission-ready cybersecurity solutions that empower government and critical infrastructure organizations to stay ahead of advanced cyber threats. We combine innovation, deep expertise, and leading technical capabilities to uncover vulnerabilities, protect vital systems, and strengthen operational resilience.

POSITION OVERVIEW

• Position: Mid-Level Threat Hunter / Purple Team Operator

• Job Type: Full Time

• Location: Remote with travel to customers and test locations as required

• Clearance Requirement: Active Top Secret with SCI eligibility

WHAT YOU'LL DO

SIXGEN is seeking a mid-level Threat Hunter / Purple Team Operator to  identify threats that evade existing detection methods, develop and test hunting hypotheses, and feed findings back into detection engineering. This role will combine remote threat hunting and on-site purple team coordination in direct support of red team engagements to secure systems, strengthen the defenders, and build and validate detection methods that can catch offensive traffic in real time.

This role requires comfort working independently through remote hunts as well as the ability to translate adversary tradecraft into defensive guidance.

Responsibilities include:

• Conduct hypothesis-driven and intelligence-led threat hunts across endpoints, networks, and cloud telemetry for several weeks prior to each red team engagement.

• Analyze logs, alerts, and historical data for indicators of compromise (IOCs), anomalous behavior, and adversary TTPs mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK from partner-provided sources (EDR, SIEM, authentication/identify logs).

• Document hunt coverage and methodology, findings, detection recommendations, and any confirmed or suspected compromise, escalating immediately if active adversary activity is found.

• Deliver a threat hunt summary and determine if the customer environment is clear prior to red team assessments.

• Partner with blue teams during the purple portion of the engagement to assist in detecting, tuning, and validating controls against red team TTPs in real-time.

• Brief technical and non-technical stakeholders on hunt result and purple team detection outcomes.

• Serve as a Trusted Agent during the red team assessment and maintain strict confidentiality and operational security with insight into both red and blue team activity.

Technology proficiency includes:

• SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic).

• EDR/XDR tooling (e.g. CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne, Carbon Black).

• Network detection and traffic analysis tools (e.g. Zeek, Suricata, full packet capture).

• Log aggregation and correlation across endpoint, network, cloud, and identity sources (e.g., Azure AD/Entra ID, AWS CloudTrail, Microsoft 365).

• MITRE ATT&CK framework for mapping hunts and detections to adversary TTPs.

• Query and scripting languages for hunting and automation (e.g. KQL, SPL, Python).

• Familiarity with common red team tooling and tradecraft (e.g., Cobalt Strike, Havoc, and other C2 traffic patterns) to help recognize and detect it.

WHAT YOU BRING

Required qualifications:

• 3 – 5+ years of experience in threat hunting, SOC/detection engineering, incident response, or a closely related defensive security role.

• Hand-on experience working with a major SIEM and EDR platform.

• Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and how to map observed activity to adversary TTPs.

• Understanding of common adversary tradecraft and red team testing methodology to help close detection gaps.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to produce clear, customer-facing findings and an “all clear” determination.

• Comfortable operating independently in remote, customer-facing roles.

• U.S. citizenship, with eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance.

Preferred qualifications:

• Industry certifications such as GCFA, GCIH, GNFA, GCTI, CySA+, or equivalent.

• Prior experience performing threat hunting and/or purple team role working directly alongside a red team.

• Scripting and automation experience to streamline hunting workflows (e.g., Python, PowerShell).

• Prior experience working with multiple partner organizations or client environments.

• Active TS/SCI clearance.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

SIXGEN offers competitive compensation based on the responsibilities of the role and the candidate's experience, qualifications, specialized expertise, and security-clearance status. The final compensation package will be discussed during the hiring process.

SIXGEN offers benefits for full-time employees, including:

• Employer-paid health insurance premiums, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, for employees and their families

• Employer-paid short- and long-term disability insurance and basic life and AD&D insurance

• 401(k) plan with a 4% employer contribution

• Professional-development reimbursement options for training, certifications, and education

For more information, please contact Human Strategist Amy Maxwell at amy.maxwell@sixgen.io.

OUR COMMITMENT

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, marital status, ancestry, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer, Lab Infrastructure and Security
jobs.description:
About Plasmidsaurus

Plasmidsaurus is on a mission to accelerate new cures and promote a healthier planet by unlocking a new level of productivity for scientists. Our sequencing services are used daily by thousands of innovators, including Nobel laureates, Fortune 100 pharma, and over 70,000 scientists.



We began by revolutionizing plasmid sequencing, making it exponentially cheaper and faster, with innovative sequencing technologies and a global network of laboratories that turn samples into answers in hours, not weeks.



Now we are expanding that same disruptive model across all of genomics. With the launch of our new RNA-seq service, we are taking a bold step toward our vision to sequence everything, providing scientists everywhere with faster, simpler, and more affordable access to the data that powers discovery.



Every team member at Plasmidsaurus plays a crucial role in driving the future of biotech research. Together, we are building the world’s most efficient sequencing engine that operates overnight, scales globally, and helps scientists make breakthroughs faster than ever before.


Role Overview

At Plasmidsaurus, our infrastructure doesn't just run software. It powers the sequencers, robots, and compute systems that help scientists around the world speed up their research and get to breakthrough discoveries faster. We're looking for a Platform Engineer to build and scale the infrastructure behind our 10 labs worldwide. You'll work across networking, hardware, cloud infrastructure, automation, and security, and you’ll have the freedom to architect solutions to complex engineering challenges. Your work will directly shape how quickly we launch new labs, expand sequencing capacity, and deliver reliable results to scientists solving some of the most important problems in the world.



What You'll Do 



Architect and Scale Our Global Lab Networks


 - Design and scale the networks powering sequencers, robotics, and compute across our 10 global labs. Own network architecture and reliability, including pfSense, MikroTik, HA firewalls, VLANs, DHCP/DNS, Tailscale, and inter-site connectivity.

 - Architect and deploy networking for new labs and expansions, from rack and switch infrastructure to high-speed 10Gb connectivity between sequencers and storage.

 - Automate network provisioning and configuration with Terraform, Ansible, and CI/CD to make infrastructure deployments faster, more consistent, and reliable.


Build Reliable, Scalable Lab Compute Infrastructure

 - Build and improve the infrastructure supporting our production hardware, including Illumina and Oxford Nanopore sequencers, Opentrons robots, lab instruments, GPU clusters, and storage. Own connectivity, observability, and scalability as sequencing capacity grows.

 - Build and maintain secure, automated device identity and access systems using PKI, AWS IAM Roles Anywhere, and SSH.


Engineer Security Into Our Infrastructure

 - Own and strengthen the security of our cloud infrastructure, web applications, and APIs through proactive testing, AI-assisted red teaming, and close collaboration with Product Engineering to resolve vulnerabilities.

 - Build and operate vulnerability management across cloud infrastructure, lab devices, and application dependencies, including scanning, patching, and secrets management.

 - Lead technical security incident response, from detection and containment through resolution and postmortems, continuously improving our ability to prevent and respond to threats.


You are someone who:

 - Loves solving hard infrastructure problems, especially where hardware, networking, and software intersect.

 - Thinks like a builder. You automate repetitive work, improve the systems you inherit, and enjoy taking projects from design through production.

 - Has deep technical curiosity and enjoys experimenting with new technologies, tools, and approaches.

 - Is proactive about production reliability and security, anticipating problems rather than waiting for things to break.

 - Thrives in high autonomy environments. You take ownership, move quickly, and make solid decisions about tradeoffs.

 - Is a team player. Communicates clearly, shares knowledge, and makes those around you better.


Qualifications

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

 - 7+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, systems, or security engineering, ideally supporting physical production environments.

 - Strong experience automating infrastructure with Python, Terraform, Ansible, and CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, including network device configuration and provisioning.

 - Deep networking expertise, including routing, VLANs, firewalls, DHCP/DNS, VPNs (including Tailscale), and high-availability architectures. Experience with pfSense or MikroTik strongly preferred.

 - Hands-on experience in AWS, including networking (VPC, site-to-cloud connectivity), IAM, and containerized workloads (ECS, Lambda)

 - Excellent Linux systems administration skills, including system services, deployments, containers, and infrastructure configuration.

 - Hands-on security engineering experience, including web/API penetration testing or red teaming, vulnerability and dependency scanning, and incident response.

 - Ownership of production reliability, including on-call responsibilities, diagnosing complex infrastructure failures, and restoring service quickly.

 - Experience using AI coding agents as a primary development tool across the software lifecycle, including infrastructure automation, development, and security testing.

 - Experience with PKI, certificate management, and secrets management, ideally including internal CAs, ACME, or AWS Private CA.

 - Experience building observability for fleets of production devices and services, including metrics, logging, and alerting.
   
   

We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly align with the job description as we seek out diverse and creative perspectives. Team members who love to learn and collaborate in an inclusive environment will thrive with us. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. jobs.description:
Senior Space Red Team Operator

SIXGEN's mission is to deliver agile, mission-ready cybersecurity solutions that empower government and critical infrastructure organizations to stay ahead of advanced cyber threats. We combine innovation, deep expertise, and leading technical capabilities to uncover vulnerabilities, protect vital systems, and strengthen operational resilience.

POSITION OVERVIEW

• Position: Senior Space Red Team Operator

• Job Type: Full Time

• Location: Remote or Hybrid with travel to customer and test locations as required

• Clearance Requirement: Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance; active Secret or higher preferred

WHAT YOU'LL DO

SIXGEN is seeking a hands-on Senior Space Red Team Operator to lead authorized adversarial assessments of space systems and the infrastructure that supports them. You will evaluate attack paths across spacecraft, payload, ground, cloud, mission-network, and operator environments; develop safe and repeatable test methods; and translate technical findings into clear mission risk and practical engineering improvements. This role is suited to an operator who can move comfortably between Linux hosts, cloud services, embedded targets, and customer briefings while maintaining disciplined authorization and mission-safety boundaries.

Responsibilities include:

• Lead end-to-end red team assessments, penetration tests, and threat-informed adversary emulation against authorized space and mission systems.

• Develop assessment plans, attack paths, test cases, and Rules of Engagement that define objectives, authorization boundaries, safety controls, prohibited actions, and stop-work criteria.

• Assess Linux-based systems, embedded devices, flight and payload software, ground-station services, mission networks, cloud environments, and supporting applications for exploitable weaknesses.

• Research and validate vulnerabilities in firmware, operating systems, communications interfaces, authentication flows, APIs, containers, identity services, and other mission-relevant components.

• Create or adapt operator tooling, exploits, proof-of-concept code, automation, and test harnesses to support repeatable assessment objectives.

• Coordinate closely with system owners, engineers, operators, range personnel, and defensive teams to execute testing without unacceptable impact to safety, availability, or mission operations.

• Correlate technical access with realistic mission effects and help customers understand how weaknesses could affect command, telemetry, payload data, availability, or operational trust.

• Document evidence, reproduction steps, attack chains, severity, and prioritized remediation recommendations in clear technical reports and executive briefings.

• Support purple-team validation, detection engineering, remediation retesting, and after-action activities to confirm that identified attack paths have been reduced or closed.

• Mentor operators, contribute to internal tradecraft and lab development, and support technical scoping, customer discussions, and proposal efforts when needed.

WHAT YOU BRING

Required qualifications:

• Seven or more years of hands-on experience in red teaming, penetration testing, vulnerability research, exploit development, or closely related offensive security work; equivalent military, government, or industry experience will be considered.

• Advanced Linux knowledge, including networking, permissions, services, process behavior, logging, troubleshooting, and security controls.

• Hands-on embedded-systems knowledge, including firmware analysis, boot processes, hardware-software interfaces, common processor architectures, debugging, and at least some exposure to RTOS or embedded Linux environments.

• Practical cloud-security knowledge in at least one major platform such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including identity and access management, networking, logging, storage, compute, and common misconfiguration paths.

• Experience assessing enterprise networks and applications, including TCP/IP, routing, VPNs, DNS, authentication protocols, web services, APIs, and segmented or hybrid environments.

• Ability to write and review code or automation in Python and shell scripting; working knowledge of C, C++, Go, or similar systems-oriented language is strongly valued.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage technical ambiguity, preserve evidence, and communicate risk to both deeply technical and nontechnical audiences.

• Commitment to authorized testing, operational safety, professional ethics, and careful handling of sensitive customer information.

• Ability to travel periodically and support testing windows that may occur outside normal business hours.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience assessing satellites, spacecraft buses, payloads, ground stations, mission-control systems, or other aerospace and operational-technology environments.

• Familiarity with spacecraft flight software, command and telemetry workflows, common space-data protocols, or platforms such as NASA core Flight System.

• Experience with firmware extraction and reverse engineering, JTAG or SWD, UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, bootloaders, device drivers, or hardware debugging tools.

• Experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, cloud-native services, and identity attack paths across hybrid environments.

• Familiarity with radio-frequency systems, software-defined radio, satellite communications, or testing within hardware-in-the-loop and cyber-range environments.

• Active U.S. Government security clearance and prior work supporting Department of War, Intelligence Community, civil-space, or commercial-space missions.

• Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, OSED, GXPN, GPEN, GREM, or comparable demonstrated technical expertise.

jobs.title: Sleep Scoring Technologist – RPSGT (PRN – Remote)
jobs.description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

What you will be doing:

Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

We are seeking experienced sleep technologists for PRN Scoring positions. Qualified candidates must hold an active RPSGT credential along with a current license in the District of Columbia, Louisiana or Delaware. Candidates must also maintain current BLS/CPR certification and remain fully compliant with AASM continuing education requirements. The RPSGT PRN Scorer will work under the direct supervision of the Director of Clinical Relations, who operates under the guidance of the Medical Director

What success looks like:

Clinical Scoring and Analysis

• Analyze physiological data from HST monitoring devices, including EEG, respiratory signals, and oximetry, to identify sleep stages and respiratory events

• Interpret sleep architecture and patterns, arousal frequency, sleep efficiency and REM latency to support the diagnosis and management of sleep disorders

• Accurately read, compute and evaluate statistical metrics from a sleep interpretation report

• Identify and report pertinent clinical observations from raw data for clinical correlation by the interpreting sleep physician

• Accurately score assigned Home Sleep Test (HST) studies within two business days of receipt of uploaded study, barring technical issues. Monitor scoring queue daily

AASM Standards of Practice

• Score all HST studies in accordance with the most current version of the AASM Scoring Manual for the Scoring of Sleep and Associated Events: Rules, Terminology and Technical Specifications, applying the HST Recommended rules for sleep staging and respiratory events

• Review and edit all computer-assisted scoring on an epoch-by-epoch basis in compliance with the current AASM Scoring Manual

• Maintain scoring proficiency through ongoing participation in the AASM Inter-Scorer Reliability (ISR) program

Quality, Compliance, and Communication

• Uphold HIPAA and privacy requirements and adhere to all company policies and procedures

• Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, accreditation standards and quality assurance protocols related to HST testing and scoring

• Troubleshoot technical issues with sleep monitoring equipment and software, escalating to the Director of Clinical Relations or technical support as needed

• Communicate effectively with team members through encrypted email and approved internal platforms

Credential and License Maintenance

• Maintain an active RPSGT credential and all required state licenses without lapse, including submitting renewal documentation and fees to the appropriate state agency in a timely manner, and notify Beacon immediately of any lapse in licensure for the state(s) in which you were hired

• Obtain and manage continuing education credits in accordance with BRPT standards, and forward all CEU certificates to the Director of Clinical Relations

What you will bring:

Experience

• Minimum of five years of experience as an RPSGT performing in-lab polysomnography

• Minimum of 1-2 years of experience analyzing and scoring Home Sleep Apnea Tests (HSAT/HST)

Education

• High school diploma or equivalent required; two years of college coursework preferred

Credentials and Certifications

• Active Registered Polysomnographic Technologist (RPSGT) credential in good standing with the Board of Registered Polysomnographic Technologists (BRPT)

• Current CPR/BLS certification through the American Heart Association or an equivalent provider

• Current state license where required by the applicable state jurisdiction

• Completion of 30 CEUs within a rolling 36-month period

Knowledge

• Familiarity with, or ability to quickly learn, Beacon SV software and related policies and procedures for HST scoring

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with consistent follow-through

• Sound critical thinking and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision

• A collaborative, team-oriented approach and positive working relationships with colleagues

• Maintain a secure, reliable, high-speed home internet connection and a dedicated, HIPAA-compliant workspace

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant, Advisory
jobs.description:
Job Description

AECOM Advisory is seeking a dynamic Senior Consultant to support our growing global Advisory business line. We are seeking talented management consultants to join AECOM Advisory who are mission-driven for the role of our clients in supporting economic, environmental and social vibrancy. We are recruiting for this role in the following locations: Los Angeles, CA; San Francisco, CA; Sacramento, CA Denver, CO; Chicago, IL.

Building off AECOM’s considerable expertise in infrastructure design and implementation, AECOM Advisory is a trusted adviser to senior level clients and executive teams on their most pressing enterprise and strategic needs. Projects range from supporting the City of LA adopt their Citywide Housing Incentive Program (CHIP) Ordinance, developing SCAG’s Regional Resilience Toolkit, and conducting an Integrated Human Resources Plan for LADWP’s Power System.

We serve the full value chain of clients active in infrastructure, the built environment, and community vibrancy, including: national governments, regulatory entities, city agencies, utilities, transit agencies, infrastructure operators and investors. Our team of 400 staff globally comprises business and policy analysts, economists, commercial strategists, technology architects, as well as human capital and change management practitioners. We help our clients develop their strategy, improve their operational performance, and integrate digital systems to generate value for their stakeholders and impact for their communities.

We are a new category of consulting firm; one that builds off true operational and technical expertise of our broader platform to bring industry depth and capability-driven insight to the clients we serve.

You will join a fast-paced and supportive team of diverse consulting professionals. We pride ourselves on our strong culture of mentorship and collaborative problem-solving, our mission of addressing our client’s most complex and impactful problems, paired with career pathways that nurture professional development and personal growth.

Role:

As a Senior Consultant in AECOM Advisory, your day-to-day role will be to define, lead and manage multiple tasks within a workstream as part of a larger engagement. These tasks will include, but not be limited to:

• Applying existing and hypothesizing new solution frameworks to deconstruct, dimensionalize, and analyze client problems.
• Leveraging AI tools to conduct baseline assessments and secondary research.
• Conducting stakeholder interviews, including with C-suite clients and senior management stakeholders.
• Conducting business modelling (market sizing, segmentation, penetration, adoption) and investment analysis by building custom discounted cash flow (DCF) Excel models to calculate revenue, cost-benefit analyses (CBA), EBITDA, NPV, IRR, CAGR for client’s policies, projects and programs.
• Leveraging analytical and data visualization tools (e.g., ArcGIS, Costar, IMPLAN, Python, Tableau) to derive patterns, trends and insights from client and third-party datasets to inform client recommendations.
• Outlining, supervising and providing quality control over analytical tasks assigned to junior team members.
• Creating highly-polished executive-ready decks as you work, to build buy-in and convey emerging data-driven insights.
• Synthesizing multiple inputs into coherent insights across a variety of formats; slide decks, written narrative, playbooks, dashboards and toolkits.

In addition, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to business development, through:

• Solutions architecture and framework development to meet our clients’ needs.
• Technical writing and long-form narrative development.
• Creating pitch decks and defining AECOM Advisory’s value proposition.
• Bringing commercial acumen around client needs, budgetary requirements, researching client contexts.
• Supporting logistical and administrative processes to ensure risk management and compliance.

Required competencies include:

• Curiosity about our clients, their business, and the industries they operate in.
• Strong interpersonal skills, client-service mindset and ability to act as a trusted adviser to clients.
• Work in a high-tempo, high-context client-facing environment, with the ability to maintain poise, maturity and work well under pressure.
• Able to be self-directed, anticipatory and responsive to iterative feedback.
• Outstanding attention to detail.
• Exceptional numerical reasoning and quantitative skills.
• Sharp analytical, logical reasoning and structured problem-solving skills, employing abstraction techniques to solve ambiguous client problems, and ingest and parse out large volumes of client information.
• Strong commercial acumen and willingness to have an informed point-of-view, grounded in an interest in enterprise challenges (people, process, technology) and developing understanding of client industries and their context.
• Solid verbal communication and narrative development skills, with the ability to summarize and convey key insights to C-suite and senior management audiences.
• Collegial team-player who can work within a small, motivated team of diverse consulting professionals.

Desired competencies include:

• Functional experience in at least one of the following areas desired, but not required:
• Proficiency with data science analytical techniques and familiarity using multiple public datasets including BLS, BEA, NAICS data, ACS and other geographically-defined socioeconomic datasets.Proficiency with geospatial datasets and software e.g., ArcGIS.Proficiency with input-output or general equilibrium economic modelling tools such as Esmi, IMPLAN or REMI.Proficiency with Stata, R, Python and other programming languages.Proficiency with data visualization techniques, such as with PowerBI or Tableau.
• Domain expertise in at least one of the following areas desired, but not required:
• Corporate or enterprise/organizational assessment.Project finance and/or infrastructure investment appraisal.Sustainability, climate change, net zero and ESG strategies and frameworks incl. non-financial valuation methodologies.Economic development, industrial policy and market transformation.

Required:

• A Bachelor’s degree (preferably in a STEM discipline) and a minimum of 3 years of management consulting or related experience (e.g., technical consulting, analyst roles in business, public policy, economics research, private equity, investment banking or corporate strategy experience).

Preferred:

• MBA, or other Master’s degree in Operational Research, Management, Management Science, Finance, Economics, Systems Engineering and/or related fields

• This position does not offer sponsorship now or in the future.
• Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Account Director (US Remote, EST Hours)
jobs.description:
ABOUT KYRA

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

Campaign Director
📍 EST hours. Reports to the Chief Strategy Officer who oversees the entire delivery team.


🎯 The role
You own a portfolio of client accounts and the team that delivers them. On the client side you are the senior point of contact, accountable for net revenue retention: renewals, expansion, and revenue at risk. On the delivery side you build and lead a team of Campaign Managers and own what they produce: quality, timelines, margin, and the standards they work to.


🔑 What you own

 - Net revenue retention across your portfolio: renewals, expansion, revenue at risk.

 - The senior client relationship, from day-to-day marketing contacts up to budget holders.

 - Campaign delivery across the portfolio: on time, in scope, against KPIs.

 - Building the Campaign Manager team: hiring, onboarding, standards, coaching and progression.

 - Gross profit margin and cost management on your accounts.
   

📊 The numbers you carry

 - Gross profit margin on every account, against target.

 - Team utilisation and throughput per head.

 - Cost per brief, and the direction it’s moving.

 - Renewal rate and expansion revenue on your portfolio.
   

🤝 Owning the client

 - Map stakeholders across functions and regions.

 - Own all communications.

 - Set account strategy: the roadmap, the expansion case, the renewal plan.

 - Own commercial terms, scope and budget.

 - Own executive reporting, QBRs and EBRs.

 - Manage account risk.
   

👥 Leading the team

 - Hire well and onboard fast. You build the team, you don’t just inherit it.

 - Set the production standard: casting, negotiation, brief workflow, escalation.

 - Track Campaign Manager performance against clear, measurable expectations. Coach, give regular feedback, own progression and performance conversations.

 - Plan resourcing and workload.

 - Own the numbers behind delivery: budgeting, forecasting, reconciliation, GPM, throughput per head.

 - Set influencer strategy: casting direction, negotiation and rates, re-engagement of high performers.

 - Act as senior escalation on complex campaign and influencer issues.
   

🔁 Reporting and working across Kyra

 - Lead post-campaign analysis, internal post-mortems and PCA decks.

 - Work with Sales, Legal, Product and Strategy to keep priorities aligned, and represent campaign delivery at a senior level internally.

 - Feed client needs, pain points and feature requests back to Product.
   

🏆 What success looks like

 - Your accounts renew, several grow, and NRR trends upward.

 - Margin holds or improves as volume rises. Cost per brief comes down.

 - Delivery holds without constant escalation.

 - Your Campaign Managers get faster and more independent, and they stay.

 - Recurring problems get fixed at the cause, not re-managed every quarter.
   

🔍 What we are looking for

 - Senior ownership of $500,000+ accounts, with multiple stakeholders and workstreams. You have held the number on those relationships, and you can name accounts you grew and say how.

 - Held margin and contribution targets on that portfolio, not just a revenue number. You can say what you did when the margin slipped.

 - Hands-on influencer campaign experience. At least 7 years in influencer marketing, covering casting and production. Strong platform fluency.

 - Built and led a team. You have hired, developed and retained Campaign Managers or equivalent, and you can show what happened to their performance and retention under you.

 - AI in your daily work, with proof. You can name a process you changed with it and what the result was.

 - Commercial sharpness (agency economics, margin, resourcing), operational strength so you build systems not workarounds, clear communication at every level, and high standards with low ego.
   

🌍 The role is EST based and works with a team spread across three continents.

Kyra reserves the right to add to or modify the duties of this role as the needs of the business change.

💟 Support

If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. Please note that when you submit an application or resume, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy https://www.bamboohr.com/legal/privacy-policy.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
WE'RE LUMA HEALTH.

Needing healthcare can be hard — getting care shouldn’t be.

We built Luma Health because we are all patients. We believe it should be easy to see and connect with our doctor. To get the care we need, when we need it.

So, we’ve created solutions to fix this problem. Our technology makes messaging easier, scheduling appointments more efficient, and it modernizes care delivery from beginning to end.

Sales Engineer

• Provide technical guidance and support to the sales team in understanding and addressing customer needs.

• Conduct product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the value proposition of our solutions.

• Assist in the development of customized solutions tailored to meet the unique requirements of healthcare clients.

• Collaborate with the product development team to ensure seamless integration of our solutions with existing healthcare systems.

• Work closely with the sales, marketing, and product development teams to ensure a cohesive and effective go-to-market strategy.

• Collaborate with key stakeholders to gather feedback and continuously improve our offerings.

Who You Are:

• 5+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer in healthcare technology

• In-depth knowledge of one or more major EHR systems (Epic, Cerner/Oracle Health, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, MEDITECH) including integration architecture, not just workflow familiarity

• Proven experience with patient access and engagement workflows including scheduling, intake, referral management, and patient communication platforms

• Solid understanding of Revenue Cycle Management concepts including eligibility verification, prior authorization, referral workflows, and billing processes

• Comfortable discussing API and integration concepts such as HL7, FHIR, and webhooks with both technical and non-technical audiences

• Experience responding to RFPs and RFIs independently

• Strong discovery skills with the ability to map current-state workflows and connect pain points to product value

• Excellent presentation and demo delivery skills across clinical, operational, and IT stakeholders

• Actively uses AI tools to drive personal productivity and find efficiencies in day-to-day work

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

• Previous experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment preferred

• Familiarity with AI-powered voice and messaging products, workflow automation tools, and patient engagement platforms with the ability to demo and position these solutions within complex healthcare organizations is a plus

We Take Care of You!

• Competitive Health Benefits: Luma Health covers 99% of the employee and 85% of the dependent premium costs.

• Work Life Balance

• Flexible Time Off

• Wellness Programs

• Discounted Perks

• 401(k) and Company Equity

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Luma Health we are dedicated to building an inclusive workplace so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align  with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Luma Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We believe in order to thrive, businesses need a diverse team and leadership. We welcome every race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Everyone is welcome here.

Come join us if you want to make a difference in health care.

jobs.title: VP, Global Health, Beneficial Deployments
jobs.description:
OpenEvidence is the most widely used medical AI platform in the world.

In just over a year, our usage has grown to >65% of US clinicians via product-led word of mouth adoption. We are a $12B company with a 30 person engineering team from MIT, Harvard, and Stanford. We believe world-changing products come from a small group of exceptional, autonomous builders, organized along focused objectives and empowered to take individual ownership and run fast. We are now bringing OpenEvidence to the clinicians and health workers who need it most: those working in low- and middle-income countries, in low-connectivity and resource-constrained settings, where access to high-quality medical expertise is scarcest and the stakes are highest. If you are a world-class operator in global health who wants to put the best medical AI in the world into the hands of the people delivering care where it is hardest to deliver, we want to talk.



Culture

We believe work is something that should be engaged with at a world-class level. Building 0->1 and scaling 1->1000 are professional sports, and uncompromising excellence is the bar. We believe building things that haven't existed is only possible with end to end ownership. We don't have separate program managers or account teams; you are responsible for landing flagship deployments and demonstrating their impact. Important things are accomplished when an individual decides to accomplish them.



We believe that work should be hard. We believe good work is precise and intentional. Doing something a certain way just because that's how others have done it before guarantees mediocrity. We believe the quality of the product is paramount and the smallest details matter most, including in a rural clinic with intermittent connectivity. At the same time, velocity is essential. The best operators know how to jump right to the hardest part of the problem and build an intuitive experience for health workers. We believe your job is to complete and announce important deployments and demonstrate their impact.



Who are you?

If you are looking to manage a portfolio of partnerships that someone else assembled, this job is not for you. If you are looking to write reports and attend convenings, this job is not for you. If you are looking to lean in and get your hands dirty, bruised, and bloody building a global health program from nothing, personally put OpenEvidence in the hands of health workers across the Global South, and impact hundreds of millions of lives, this job might be for you.



The ideal candidate is a brilliant builder with deep roots in global health. They are smart, ambitious, scrappy, autonomous, precise, motivated, hard-working, and low-ego. They have 10+ years in global health, international development, or related fields, 5+ years managing external partnerships, grantmaking, or multi-stakeholder initiatives, and they have built programs or organizations from scratch. They know the key players at the major NGOs, foundations, and ministries of health, and those people take their calls. Does that sound rare? It is rare, and we would like to find them.



The role

You will be the primary relationship owner for our flagship global health deployments, working with governments, international NGOs, foundations, and innovators strengthening care in low-resource settings. You will grow the partnerships we have, identify and onboard the ones we need, and translate partners' clinical and operational needs into deployment plans that actually work in low-connectivity, low-bandwidth, and offline environments. You will bring on-the-ground insight back to the product, clinical, and research teams and use it to make OpenEvidence best-in-class for global health, including in local languages. You will run structured programs such as accelerators and cohort-based engagements, support funder and ecosystem engagement to sustain the work, and set a research agenda for measuring OpenEvidence's impact on health outcomes in low-resource settings, partnering with external organizations to study efficacy. You will represent OpenEvidence at global health convenings, help shape how the team works as it scales, and spend roughly 25% of your time at partner sites across the Global South.



Skillsets

Specific skillsets are secondary to the builder profile above, but some important spikes for different facets of this work are:



Global health relationships

 - You have deep credibility in the global health ecosystem. You have worked directly with organizations in low- and middle-income countries and have a nuanced understanding of what deployment actually looks like in low-connectivity, low-resource environments.

 - You may have language skills relevant to Sub-Saharan Africa, or Latin America, or a background in clinical or public health settings.

Technical fluency

 - You can engage credibly on AI concepts, understand what LLMs can and cannot do, and partner effectively with engineers and scientists. You might come from a healthtech company, an AI organization, or a product-adjacent role.

Programs and funders

 - You have built and run structured programs from scratch, likely at a startup or in a founding role, and you have worked with philanthropic foundations on global health initiatives.

 - You are comfortable managing a high volume of partnerships and opportunities and ruthless about prioritizing among them.

Impact and evidence

 - You have an analytical mindset and use data to inform strategy and measure impact. Evaluation and quantitative proof are tools you constantly seek to deploy.

 - You are familiar with global health research and evidence-based interventions, and you want to prove, not assert, that OpenEvidence improves outcomes.



We work in-person in Miami and SF, and this role travels extensively (~25%) to partner sites across the Global South. We believe in creating an environment that optimizes for focus and productivity, including providing meals, transport, and anything else you need to move quickly.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
jobs.description:
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT TO THE CEO

Role Overview

As the Executive Assistant to the CEO, you are the ultimate force multiplier for our Chief Executive Officer. In a hyper-growth Series A environment, the CEO’s time is our most critical asset. We are not looking for a traditional administrator; we are looking for a highly strategic, AI-native partner who thrives at a 24/7 pace and possesses an aggressive growth mindset. You will act as a gatekeeper, business operations engine, and personal life manager, seamlessly turning stray thoughts into prioritized, trackable actions. Your mandate is to build deep context into the CEO's work and life, anticipating roadblocks and solving them with extreme velocity so the CEO can focus purely on leading and scaling Zania.



What you'll do



 - Multiply Output with AI: Be unapologetically AI-native. Utilize tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity daily to 10x your output—whether drafting communications, researching specialists, synthesizing meeting transcripts, or building operational workflows.
   
   

 - Drive Business Operations: Step far beyond calendar management. Build and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), track CRM pipelines, source and negotiate with vendors, assist with light finance/invoicing, and support hiring by screening candidates and coordinating onboarding.
   
   

 - Ruthless Time & Inbox Management: Own the CEO’s calendar and inbox end-to-end. Triage incoming requests, draft high-quality, AI-enhanced responses in the CEO's voice, track action items from daily stand-ups, and relentlessly drive tasks to closure without requiring an additional layer of project management.
   
   

 - Manage Personal Wellness & Health: Protect the CEO's physical and mental stamina. Oversee biometric and health data tracking, coordinate meal planning and fitness schedules, manage medical appointments and insurance claims, and curate sleep, recovery, and wellness resources.
   
   

 - Household & Family Logistics: Blur the lines between business and personal to give the CEO total peace of mind. Manage household vendors, coordinate personal errands, plan family travel and events, handle gift research, and oversee home maintenance so the CEO never has to worry about the details outside the office.
   
   

 - Meeting & Board Prep: Ensure the CEO is fully briefed and prepared for all engagements. Build agendas, compile investor pre-read materials, and proactively design playbooks that make execution feel seamless.
   
   

What You Have



 - Experience: 4+ years of experience supporting a C-level executive, Founder, or CEO in a high-growth, fast-paced startup environment, with a proven track record of handling both business operations and complex personal logistics.
   
   

 - AI-Native & Tech Forward: You are fluent in modern AI tools and naturally look for ways to automate, optimize, and leverage technology to work smarter and faster.
   
   

 - 24/7 Startup DNA: You possess a relentless work ethic and thrive in a high-intensity, always-on environment. You have a massive growth mindset and love building structure out of ambiguity.
   
   

 - Extreme Proactivity: You do not just execute tasks; you think three steps ahead. When a problem arises—whether a delayed flight or a vendor dispute—you have already executed the solution before the CEO is even aware of the issue.
   
   

 - Unwavering Discretion & Polish: Absolute confidentiality, high emotional intelligence, and written communication skills that are polished enough to represent the CEO to Tier-1 investors, enterprise clients, and personal medical professionals alike.
   
   

 - Location: Based in (or willing to relocate to) Palo Alto, working in-person with the team five days a week.
