jobs.description:
About Us

We are Sila, a next-generation battery materials company. Our mission is to power the world’s transition to clean energy. To create this future, our team is building a better lithium-ion battery from the inside out today. We engineer and manufacture ground-breaking battery materials that significantly increase the energy density of batteries, while reducing their size and weight. The result? Smaller more powerful batteries that can unlock innovation in consumer devices and accelerate the mass adoption of electric cars to eliminate our dependence on fossil fuels. We're tackling one of the biggest challenges of our time every day, and together we're redefining what's possible. Are you ready to be a part of a team committed to changing the world?

Who You Are

As a  Sr Product Manager, you won't just manage products; you'll shape the future of Sila's groundbreaking battery materials. You'll operate at the critical intersection of market demand, customer needs, and our advanced R&D and engineering capabilities. Your primary objective will be to translate a visionary understanding of the battery landscape into tangible product roadmaps, driving the most impactful development decisions for our next-generation materials.

You're a highly analytical, data-driven, and structured problem solver who thrives in complex, evolving environments. You excel at providing strategic clarity and direction, adeptly synthesizing diverse data points into actionable insights. An exceptional communicator and active listener, you possess a profound passion for Sila’s technology and its potential to revolutionize the energy storage sector.

Responsibilities and Duties

• Define and Champion Product Strategy: Develop and articulate a compelling product vision and comprehensive roadmap for Sila's next-generation battery materials, including new and emerging product lines beyond our existing Titan Silicon anode material. This includes aligning product initiatives with overarching market trends, technological advancements, and strategic business objectives.

• Drive Market & Customer Intelligence:

• Cultivate deep, strategic relationships with key customers (OEMs and cell manufacturers) to intimately understand their evolving technical requirements, performance gaps, and future material needs.

• Conduct rigorous competitive analysis, evaluating industry-leading battery materials across critical performance metrics to identify Sila's unique value proposition and areas for strategic differentiation.

• Thoroughly document the full customer evaluation process for new battery materials, including specific requirements, testing protocols, and decision-making criteria across diverse customer segments.

• Translate Requirements into Actionable Development:

• Translate complex OEM/cell maker requirements (in their final form factors) into precise internal test protocols and success metrics that can be rigorously evaluated within Sila’s labs and with development partners.

• Define the necessary internal capabilities Sila must develop—including specific form factors, advanced test methodologies, and scale-up processes—to accelerate product development and meet future market demands.

• Prioritize and Lead Product Initiatives:

• Strategically prioritize internal development initiatives, balancing company priorities, critical customer needs, and current Sila technology gaps.

• Develop and present comprehensive business cases for new product initiatives in conjunction with the Strategy team, including market opportunity analysis, financial projections, technical feasibility, and competitive landscape, for executive evaluation and decision-making.

• Lead focused investigations into key material metrics, synthesizing customer feedback, defining clear and actionable targets for development teams, and tracking progress against strategic objectives.

• Develop Technical Marketing & Commercialization Assets: Create compelling technical marketing materials and sales enablement tools. Provide a data-rich narrative that effectively communicates Sila's unique value proposition, performance advantages, and technological differentiation to a diverse range of customers and strategic partners.

Knowledge and Skill Requirements

• Minimum of 5-8 years of experience in Product Management or a closely related technical role within a hard-tech company, ideally a leading battery cell manufacturer or a battery materials company supplying top-tier battery manufacturers.

• Demonstrated success in defining, launching, and managing products, preferably within the advanced materials or energy storage sectors.

• Technical understanding of battery chemistry, cell design, manufacturing processes, and the critical performance requirements for advanced battery materials (e.g., silicon anodes, cathode materials, electrolytes).

• In-depth knowledge of the product development lifecycle for novel materials, including the unique challenges and opportunities associated with scaling from lab to commercial production.

• Proactive, adaptable, and results-oriented, with a strong bias for action in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with diverse internal teams

• Bachelor's degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field. An advanced degree (Master's or Ph.D.) is highly preferred.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

• Operate a computer and other office equipment, such as a laptop, copier/printer, etc. in a fixed location

• Move long distances (such as from building to building) and be stationary for extended periods of time

The starting base pay for this role is between $172,000 and $215,000 at the time of posting. The actual base pay depends on many factors, such as education, experience, and skills. jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

ASIC DESIGN ENGINEER (SILICON ENGINEERING)

At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.

We are seeking a motivated, proactive, and intellectually curious engineer who will work alongside world-class cross-disciplinary teams (systems, firmware, architecture, design, validation, product engineering, ASIC implementation). In this role, you will be developing cutting-edge next-generation FPGAs and ASICs for deployment in space and ground infrastructures around the globe. These chips are enabling connectivity in places it has previously not been available, affordable or reliable. Your efforts will help deliver cutting-edge solutions that will expand the performance and capabilities of the Starlink network.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design ASICs and/or FPGAs for Starlink projects, implementing complex SoC blocks and SoC integration tasks using Verilog/System Verilog

• Optimize designs for power, performance and area

• Participate in the full ASIC/FPGA design lifecycle for Starlink projects, from high-level conceptual and architectural discussions through microarchitecture, design partitioning, and collaboration with backend/implementation teams, and assist in lab bring-up and validation

• Contribute to continual improvements to our designs by building physical and digital tools to analyze data collected on orbit and in the lab

• Engage in high-level architectural design for test systems to support FPGA/ASIC validation, generational interoperability, and integration with DSP/communications subsystems for comprehensive lab and on-orbit verification

• Collaborate with software engineers in developing production software for your designs

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or Physics

• 1+ years of experience in RTL Design using SystemVerilog, Verilog or VHDL

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• ASIC/FPGA system integration experience

• Proficiency in Python, C/C++, and Bash

• Experience in designing DSP, digital communication system datapath blocks, and/or modem design

• Experience with EDA tools such as HDL simulators (e.g. VCS, Questa, IES), HDL Lint tools (e.g. Spyglass), FPGA tools (e.g. Xilinx Vivado, Altera Quartus II)

• Experience and understanding of AXI/AHB/APB protocols

• Strong foundation in electrical engineering fundamentals

• Experience debugging complex PCBs containing Microprocessors and FPGAs in the lab using equipment such as oscilloscopes and spectrum analyzers

• Ability to work in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements

• Team-player, can-do attitude and ability to work well in a group environment while still contributing on an individual basis

• Demonstrated ability to work in a highly cross-functional role

• Enjoys being challenged and learning new skills

• Master’s in Electrical/Computer Engineering or related field

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to work extended hours or weekends as needed for mission critical deadlines

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:

Level 1: $135,000.00 - $175,000.00
Level 2: $155,000.00 - $210,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. jobs.title: Strategic Business Development, Life Sciences
jobs.description:
ROLE: STRATEGIC BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT, LIFE SCIENCES

Department: GTM & Partnerships

Location: Boston

Location Type: Hybrid

Employment Type: Full-time



About Liquid AI

Liquid AI’s mission is to build efficient, general-purpose intelligence at every scale. Founded out of the Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (CSAIL) at MIT in 2023, we build small, efficient, and incredibly fast foundation models that can run directly on the devices all around us—phones, cars, and laptops—with no internet needed. We are scaling and need exceptional people to drive our growth.



About the role

We are seeking a strategic business development lead to build our life sciences business. You will turn our early work in drug discovery and biology into long-term partnerships and revenue with pharmaceutical, biotech, and research organizations. Our partnership with Insilico Medicine has already produced LFM2-2.6B-MMAI https://www.liquid.ai/press/liquid-ai-insilico-medicine-partnership for drug discovery and LFM2 Longevity models https://www.liquid.ai/blog/longevitybench for aging research. You will drive adoption of Liquid Foundation Models across life sciences, help shape how our scientific and bio models are built and taken to market, and run deals from the first conversation to close.

Technical fluency and life sciences expertise is central to this role. Our counterparts are heads of AI, computational chemistry and biology leaders, and R&D executives at pharma and biotech companies. They want to know how a model performs on their data and tasks, where it falls short, and what it takes to deploy on their private infrastructure. You need to be able to drive these conversations credibly, work alongside our research team and engineers on evaluations and deployments, and bring what you learn back into our model and product roadmap.

You will be our first business development hire in life sciences and will work directly with the founders and business leadership. This role suits someone who wants to build the playbook while closing first-of-a-kind deals.



Responsibilities

 - Own deals end to end, from identifying and prioritizing pharma, biotech, and research partners through negotiation, close, and delivery. You are accountable for the revenue.

 - Source opportunities across drug discovery and life sciences R&D through your network and outreach.

 - Manage and expand our existing life sciences partnerships, including our work with Insilico Medicine.

 - Negotiate first-of-a-kind agreements that combine licensing, revenue sharing, co-development, and roadmap commitments.

 - Lead technical and scientific conversations with heads of AI, computational scientists, and R&D leaders, and work with our scientists and engineers on technical deep-dives, proofs of concept, benchmarks, and deployment planning.

 - Be the voice of the market internally. Bring back objections, competitive intelligence, pricing feedback, and emerging use cases that should influence our product, model roadmap, and positioning.

 - Build our life sciences GTM engine. Define how we evaluate and qualify partners, shape our external messaging, and develop the infrastructure and operating cadences that will let our team and business scale.



Desired experience

 - 10+ years in business development, partnerships, or corporate development in pharma, biotech, or life sciences technology, with a record of deals that moved revenue.

 - Recent deal experience bringing AI/ML, computational platforms, or data products into pharma and biotech R&D.

 - Deep knowledge of drug discovery and development, and of how pharma and biotech companies evaluate, buy, and partner on R&D technology.

 - High technical and scientific fluency. You understand what foundation models can do and how that translates into R&D workflows, and you can work credibly with scientists and engineers on both sides of the table.

 - Demonstrated success structuring and personally negotiating complex agreements with senior executives, such as R&D collaborations or platform licensing deals, including multi-year deals with interlocking terms, often several at once.

 - Experience leading cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Legal, and Finance to bring an agreement from structuring through signature and delivery.

 - Relationships with R&D, computational, and data science leaders at pharma and biotech companies, and a record of sourcing your own opportunities.

 - Experience at an early-stage or growth-stage company where you helped build the motion rather than run an established one.
   
   

What we offer

 - Compensation: Competitive base salary + variable compensation with equity in a unicorn-stage company

 - Health: We pay 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for employees and dependents

 - Financial: 401(k) matching up to 4% of base pay

 - Time Off: Unlimited PTO plus company-wide Refill Days throughout the year

jobs.title: Account Engineer
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Account Engineer is a high-impact, cross-functional role designed to accelerate the customer journey from initial acquisition to successful platform adoption and expansion on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. You will contribute to this mission by driving initial utilization, leveraging modern AI-powered tools and coding agents to ensure technical success.

This role bridges the critical gap by helping new and early-stage customers achieve rapid implementation, quick value, and a world-class experience on the Snowflake platform. You will be the dedicated customer technical partner, responsible for driving technical enablement and supporting the overall activation and adoption of our customers initial use cases.

This is a fantastic opportunity for technical professionals to develop deep expertise in cloud data architecture, make a measurable impact on customer success, and contribute to one of the fastest-growing technology companies.



Key Responsibilities and Deliverables

 - The Account Engineer manages a critical portfolio of new and early-stage customers, and is accountable for accelerating their time-to-value and achieving sustained platform growth. Operating as a Full-Stack Technical Resource, this role blends deep hands-on expertise with the strategic acumen of a business leader.

 - Strategic Ownership and Value Creation

 - Lead Your Account Micro-Business: Take ownership of the technical success and consumption trajectory within your assigned portfolio, driving adoption metrics in your assigned accounts, acting as a single point of contact for all customer needs.

 - Driving Outcome-Based Utilization: Apply an outcome-based selling mindset to customer engagements, focusing on how the Snowflake AI Data Cloud helps them solve complex data challenges and unlock maximum business value—not just product features.

 - Strategic Advisory and Guidance: Serve as a trusted strategic advisor immediately following the initial contract close, providing guidance on data strategy, technology stack integration, and ensuring a swift, successful activation of Use Cases.

 - Deliver Technical Value with AI: Deliver technical value efficiently by leveraging cutting-edge AI-powered development tools and automation to accelerate solutions and implementation guidance, helping customers move faster to production.

 - Technical Execution and Collaboration

 - Architectural Leadership: Provide customers with critical, Snowflake-specific foundational guidance, including Architectural Best Practices, Workload Isolation & Warehouse Utilization, Resource Monitoring & Alerts, Budgeting, and RBAC/Security Setup.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with the Account Team to highlight risks and establish and nurture trusted relationships with internal Snowflake teams (e.g., Professional Services, Support) and external partners to ensure seamless resource orchestration.

 - Develop Scalable Programs: Create and deliver reusable, high-impact programs, such as Hands-on Labs (HoLs) and webinars, to educate a wide customer audience on specific platform features and industry best practices.

 - Technical Feedback Loop & Innovation: Act as a key feedback loop from the field to influence future product development, working closely with Product Management and Engineering teams.

 - Expert Support and Triage: Efficiently triage a broad array of incoming customer inquiries, assisting the field team with demos, troubleshooting, and identifying opportunities to qualify potential business value for the Expansion team.

Required Qualifications

 - We are seeking highly skilled and motivated technical professionals eager to launch their next career chapter with us.

 - Technical Aptitude: Hands-on experience with SQL is required.

 - Data & Cloud Knowledge: Strong foundational understanding and experience with data architecture, data analytics, and the core concepts of major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

 - Growth Mindset: A strong desire to learn, grow your technical skills, and become an expert in the Snowflake platform.

 - Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively to diverse audiences.

 - Professional Skills: Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and possess Project Management skills to track, manage, and drive customers to an agreed-upon timeline.

 - Education: University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or related fields, or equivalent practical experience in a technical role.

 - What Sets You Apart (Preferred Qualifications)

 - SnowPro Core certification.

 - Proficiency in additional coding languages, particularly Python, Java, or Scala, especially in a data or application development context.

 - Experience with modern data technologies (e.g., CI/CD tooling, orchestration tools) or a basic understanding of Data Science concepts.

 - Prior experience or strong interest in leveraging AI-powered development tools and coding agents to increase solution delivery efficiency.

Performance Assessment & Career Path

 - This role is designed as a direct path to a successful career within the Snowflake Solution Engineering organization.

 - Impact Metrics: Performance is primarily assessed on customer success and platform adoption metrics:

 - Consumption: Driving new customer consumption for the initial contract period.

 - Use Cases: Documented success of helping customers move Use Cases to Production.

 - Growth: Measured via customer retention and growth within the managed portfolio.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Traveling Leasing Manager, Salt Lake City
jobs.description:
Redstone Residential is a national student and multi-family housing operator, managing more than 38,000 beds across 20 states. We are one of the largest third-party student housing management companies in the U.S. - and we're just getting started.

Our rapidly growing conventional housing portfolio reflects our ambitious, forward-thinking approach to real estate management. Headquartered in Provo, Utah, we combine industry-leading systems with a high-energy culture to deliver exceptional property performance and resident experiences.

Redstone's purpose is "to empower our people and elevate communities." We achieve our purpose by embodying our core values:

• We Are Believers

• We Communicate Authentically with Care

• We Stay The Course

• We Drive Performance

Traveling Leasing Manager – Salt Lake City Metro

CLASSIFICATION: Full-Time, Non-Exempt

COMPENSATION: $22.00 per hour

LOCATION: Salt Lake City Metro Area, Utah

SCHEDULE: Full-time, including up to two Saturdays per month. On weeks when a Saturday is scheduled, you'll receive one weekday off.

BENEFITS:

• Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance

• 15 days of PTO and 10 paid holidays

• 3 Paid Service Days

• Paid Parental Leave

• 401(k) Plan with up to 6% Matching

• Continued Education Program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Short-Term Disability Insurance

POSITION SUMMARY

Love sales, meeting new people, and helping people find their next home? We want to meet you!

Redstone Residential is looking for a Traveling Leasing Manager to support our apartment communities throughout the Salt Lake City area.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys sales, likes a little variety in their workday, and wants to build a career in property management.

You'll work at different Redstone communities, helping teams with leasing, touring apartments, following up with prospective residents, and filling coverage gaps. Every community is a little different, giving you the chance to meet new people, learn new skills, and find out what kind of property and team are the best fit for you.

We're looking for someone who enjoys a challenge, loves reaching goals, and isn't afraid to pick up the phone, start a conversation, or ask someone to apply.

Our goal is simple: We want to help you grow into the job you want. You'll receive hands-on experience, training, and support as you prepare for your next permanent position with Redstone.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Every community is different, and so is the support they need! We're looking for someone who can adapt quickly, take initiative, and recognize where they can make the biggest impact. Your main focus will always be the same: maintaining strong occupancy, keeping residents happy, and helping our team succeed.

• Travel between Redstone apartment communities throughout the Salt Lake City area, stepping in where needed and taking ownership of leasing performance and daily occupancy priorities.

• Give engaging apartment tours, build relationships with prospective residents, and confidently ask for the sale.

• Take ownership of lead follow-up through calls, texts, and emails, turning interest into applications and signed leases.

• Set goals, track progress, and take initiative to achieve daily, weekly, and monthly leasing targets.

• Manage lease renewals by proactively connecting with residents, following up on upcoming expirations, and encouraging residents to stay.

• Create engaging social media content, plan resident events, and bring fresh marketing ideas that attract new residents and build a sense of community.

• Deliver world-class customer service by taking ownership of resident needs, following through, and creating positive experiences.

• Support daily property operations, including using Entrata, maintaining accurate resident accounts, assisting with collections, and working alongside onsite teams.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong customer service and sales skills, with a genuine enjoyment of meeting new people and working toward goals.

• Friendly, confident, and comfortable starting conversations, building relationships, and asking for the sale.

• Self-motivated, organized, and able to take ownership of responsibilities with minimal supervision.

• Creative and comfortable using Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and Canva to create engaging content, including photos and short-form videos.

• Adaptable, flexible, and able to manage changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Comfortable working with different teams and willing to learn new skills and take on challenges.

• Proficient computer skills, including Microsoft Office and the ability to learn property management software such as Entrata.

• Previous sales, leasing, hospitality, or customer service experience preferred.

• Reliable transportation and willingness to travel between communities throughout the Salt Lake City area.

• High school diploma or GED equivalent required; college experience preferred.

WHY REDSTONE?

We believe the best way to grow is by getting experience, trying new things, and learning from the people around you.

As a Traveling Leasing Manager, you'll get to know different Redstone communities, work with experienced managers, and build the skills to take the next step in your career.

Maybe you want to become a Leasing Manager at your own community. Maybe you see yourself becoming an Assistant Community Manager or Community Manager someday. Whatever your goal, we want to help you work toward it.

We don't just want to hire you for the job you can do today. We want to help you grow into the job you want tomorrow.

If you love working with people, enjoy the excitement of making a sale, have a creative side, and are ready to learn and grow, we'd love to meet you!

At Redstone Residential, we’re committed to creating a workplace where people thrive. We believe in elevating communities, starting with our own team. Whether you’re just beginning your career or looking to grow in a fast-paced, purpose-driven environment, we’d love to hear from you.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

As an early mover in the in-space transportation and infrastructure services, Momentus is at the forefront of the commercialization of space. With an experienced team of aerospace, propulsion, and robotics engineers, Momentus has developed a cost-effective and energy-efficient in-space transport system.

OUR PEOPLE

Daring problems require daring solutions.  We boldly charge into uncharted territory knowing that no matter the outcome we will benefit from the journey and move closer to our goals no matter what. Our teams know that working at Momentus means more than building innovative technology, it means creating entirely new markets in the space economy. We are level-headed, business-minded strategic thinkers intent on providing immediate value to our customers today while simultaneously preparing for the vast possibilities of the future. If this sounds like you, we should talk.

JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking a Senior DevSecOps Engineer to operate the cloud infrastructure our engineering teams depend on today and to build its successor from the ground up. The current environment spans AWS, Kubernetes, and CI. The next one is a new AWS GovCloud organization defined entirely as code, with the networking, identity, and software supply chain that a regulated engineering organization needs.

You will keep the existing environment healthy while the new one takes shape, then move workloads into it. You will also run the tooling that gives our engineers governed access to AI models and coding agents. This is a building role on a small team, and the scope is broad by design. You will not maintain a compliance binder; you will turn security requirements into code that produces its own evidence.

Preference for this role to be onsite but will consider hybrid and remote candidates.

Key Responsibilities

• Operate and improve our existing AWS environments, Kubernetes clusters, and CI platform, and migrate workloads into the new organization as it comes online

• Build a new multi-account AWS GovCloud organization as code

• Build and operate segmented network planes: Transit Gateway, Firewalls, IPAM, PrivateLink, and VPNs to our facilities

• Deliver secure environment ingress / egress

• Own the software supply chain from commit to cluster: CI/CD runner fleets, FIPS-validated images, signed artifacts, replicated registries, private PKI

• Partner with security and compliance to translate NIST SP 800-171 and CMMC controls into automated guardrails and evidence, and to triage and burn down security findings

• Write clear design notes, merge request reviews, and runbooks, and help improve the shared AI-assisted workflows the team uses every day

• Roll out and support AI developer tooling (Claude Code and similar) with managed settings, and review, harden, and operate the MCP servers and agent runtimes our teams depend on

Required Skills and Experience

• Production Terraform or OpenTofu: reusable modules, state management, imports and refactors, and careful plan review

• Proficiency in Python and/or Go, plus shell scripting

• Clear, concise technical writing

• Deep hands-on AWS experience in a multi-account organization: IAM policy evaluation, Organizations and service control policies, and Identity Center or equivalent federation with an external IDP

• Cloud networking you can debug under pressure: VPC design, Transit Gateway routing and segmentation, firewalls and inspection, DNS, PrivateLink, and site-to-site VPN with BGP; you can answer “why can’t X talk to Y” across accounts

• CI/CD and container supply chain experience, including image builds, signing and verification, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning

• Hands-on experience running access to a hosted model service (Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, or similar) or an LLM gateway

• Experience with AI coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent), with a working understanding of its risks: prompt injection, excessive agency, token and secret exposure, and untrusted tool servers

Desired Skills and Experience

• AWS GovCloud experience, or work inside FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-171, CMMC, or ITAR-controlled environments

• Greenfield landing-zone or account-vending work, including AWS Network Firewall and IPAM

• Private PKI (for example AWS Private CA), HSM-backed key management, and mTLS

• Service mesh (Istio or similar) and GitOps tooling (Argo CD, Flux, or similar)

• LLM gateway operations (LiteLLM or equivalent), per-user cost attribution, and model invocation logging

• Building or securing MCP servers and agent workflows

• Shared AI workflows you built that other engineers adopted: hooks, commands, rules files, skills, or agent pipelines

• Operating Kubernetes in production, preferably EKS

• FIPS 140-3 validated cryptography and hardened container images

• Experience in aerospace, defense, or other export-controlled programs

• Previous experience working on DoD and other USG development and deployment programs

• Ability to hold and maintain a USG Security Clearance

Education & Work Experience

• BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

• 7+ years in infrastructure, platform, security, or site reliability engineering, including 3+ years building on AWS with infrastructure as code

Compensation:

Annual Base Salary Range: $190,000.00 - $225,000.00/per year

Base pay is one part of our total compensation package (base+bonus+equity) and is determined within a range. Your actual base salary will be determined on job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.  Our benefit plans include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k retirement plan, short and long term disability and life insurance. We also offer flexible PTO, along with 11 paid holidays, sick time and paid parental leave.

This is a full-time position in San Jose, California. This position requires access to export-controlled commodities, technical data, technology, software, and services. U.S. citizenship, U.S. legal permanent resident status, or protected person status under 8 U.S.C. Â§ 1324b(a)(3) is required.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

To all recruitment agencies: Momentus does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our employees or any company email. Momentus will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Quality Systems
jobs.description:
At Alamar, we are passionate about enabling our customers to make scientific discoveries that translate into clinical outcomes and benefit patients. Our team is growing quickly as we develop innovative approaches to measure critical protein biomarkers from liquid samples that can enable the earliest possible detection of disease. We believe the next frontier in biology is enabled by measuring proteins at higher sensitivity in highly multiplexed assays at the push of a button, which is something only Alamar can do. As we build our team, we seek collaborative, driven, intellectually curious people committed to solving complex challenges. Our culture rewards accountability and cross functional teamwork because we believe this enables the kind of breakthrough thinking that will accelerate our mission.

The Sr. Manager, Quality Systems owns the , ongoing compliance ,  and continuous improvement of the company's Quality Management System (QMS) for medical device and IVD products. The role keeps the QMS compliant with FDA's Quality Management System Regulation (21 CFR Part 820, aligned with ISO 13485:2016 since February 2026), ISO 13485, EU MDR/IVDR and MDSAP, and makes it scalable as the company grows.

This leader is the primary host for regulatory inspections and notified body audits, and partners with R&D, Operations, Regulatory Affairs and commercial teams to embed quality into every stage of the product lifecycle.

Key responsibilities

QMS ownership and strategy

• Responsible for maintaining compliance of the Quality Management System, Quality Manual and Document hierarchy; keeps it compliant with 21 CFR 820 (QMSR), ISO 13485:2016, ISO 14971, EU MDR/IVDR and MDSAP requirements.

• Works with VP/Head of Quality to build a multi-year QMS roadmap that scales with new products, sites and markets.

• Lead gap assessments when regulations or standards change, and drive remediation to closure.

• Select, implement and administer the electronic QMS (eQMS) and keep it validated (CSV/CSA, 21 CFR Part 11).

Core quality processes

• Own document and record control, training management, CAPA, nonconformance, deviations, internal audit and change control.

• Run the CAPA Review Board; ensure investigations use sound root-cause methods and effectiveness checks.

• Oversee complaint handling, MDR/vigilance reporting interfaces and post-market surveillance inputs to the QMS.

• Partner with Design Assurance on design controls, risk management files and design history files.

Audits and inspections

• Plan and execute the internal audit program; manage auditor qualification.

• Serve as delegate host and front-room lead for FDA inspections, notified body, MDSAP and customer audits.

• Assists with responses to FDA 483s, audit nonconformities and customer findings, with on-time closure.

• Support supplier quality with audit scheduling, supplier qualification and Approved Supplier List controls.

Management review and metrics

• Run quarterly Management Review; compile quality data, trends and actions for executive leadership.

• Define and report QMS KPIs (CAPA aging, audit findings, training compliance, document cycle time, complaint trends).

Leadership

• Hire, develop and lead the Quality Systems team; set goals and manage performance.

• Build a quality culture through cross-functional training and clear, practical procedures.

• Act as Management Representative or deputy when designated.

Required qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, life sciences or a related technical field.

• 8 + years in quality within medical device or IVD, including 4+ years leading teams and managers.

• Deep working knowledge of 21 CFR 820 (QMSR), ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 14971; working knowledge of EU MDR/IVDR and MDSAP.

• Direct experience hosting FDA inspections and notified body audits, and writing successful 483 or nonconformity responses.

• Hands-on ownership of CAPA, document control, training, internal audit and management review processes.

• Experience implementing or administering an eQMS (e.g., MasterControl, Greenlight Guru, Veeva, Arena, Qualio).

• Strong writing skills: clear, audit-ready procedures and investigation reports.

Preferred qualifications

• Advanced degree (MS, MBA or PhD).

• ASQ CQA, CQE or CMQ/OE certification; ISO 13485 Lead Auditor certification.

• IVD or diagnostics experience, including IVDR transition and MDSAP inspections.

• Experience scaling a QMS at a growth-stage company through a first 510(k), De Novo or PMA and commercial launch.

• Familiarity with IEC 62304 (software), IEC 62366 (usability) and ISO 15223 (label symbols) where applicable.

• Lead Auditor Training

jobs.title: Engineering Co-op
jobs.description:
Engineering Co-op

About Us

Salient Motion is building a modular motion and actuation platform that is redefining how aerospace, defense, and industrial systems are designed, built, and deployed. We move fast, operate with high ownership, and expect real contribution from every member of the team. Co-ops are treated like engineers, not observers. You will own real work, ship to production hardware, and leave with a body of work you can point to.

Role Overview

As an Engineering Co-op, you will embed with our engineering team across mechanical, electrical, software, manufacturing, and systems-level work for six months or longer. Unlike a short summer internship, this role is designed for students who want to take a project from specification through qualification, see a full product cycle, and operate as a contributing member of the team.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced startup environment. You will be expected to ramp quickly, take ownership of a defined workstream, and ship work that goes into customer programs.

What You Will Do

• Own a scoped engineering workstream from design through test and release, with support from a senior engineer

• Design, build, and test electro-mechanical systems and subassemblies on active customer programs

• Build, maintain and improve test fixtures, data collection infrastructures

• Firmware bring-up, design validation tests for electronics boards

• Lead prototyping, assembly, and hands-on lab and shop work

• Plan and execute engineering tests, collect data, and present results to the team

• Drive manufacturing and supplier activities including part preparation, first-article inspection, and validation

• Build and improve engineering and documentation processes that outlast your co-op term

• Partner with senior engineers and program leaders, and present progress in design and program reviews

What We Are Looking For

• Enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field, with the ability to commit to a minimum 6-month co-op rotation

• Available for a full-time term, whether a full academic semester, summer plus a connecting semester, or two consecutive semesters

• Strong curiosity and willingness to work across disciplines

• Comfortable in a lab or shop environment with hardware and tools

• Clear communicator who can document work, present results, and ask thoughtful questions

• Prior hands-on experience through projects, labs, clubs, personal builds, or a previous internship or co-op is a strong plus

What You Will Gain

• Ownership of real production-bound hardware over a long enough window to see it ship

• Exposure to aerospace and defense engineering standards and practices through a full program cycle

• Mentorship from experienced engineers and direct access to founders and program leadership

• A portfolio of shipped work and a reference from a startup that moved on your contributions

• Co-ops completing 9+ months in good standing are evaluated for a full-time return offer at graduation

Co-op Details

• Full-time, paid co-op, with pay tiered by commitment length:

• 6-month rotation: $28 to $34/hr

• 9 to 12 month rotation: $34 to $40/hr

• Minimum 6-month commitment; 9 to 12 month rotations preferred

• Start dates flexible to align with your school's co-op calendar. Common cadences include January to June, July to December, and July to June for full-year rotations

• Onsite in Torrance, CA; relocation support includes a $1,200/month housing stipend for students relocating more than 50 miles

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Cisco IOS-XE (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 10/29/2026

This role requires to be onsite in a hybrid model 4 times a week in our Milpitas office.

MEET THE TEAM

Our team serves as the engine of innovation, dedicated to building software that simplifies complex networking challenges through a user-centric, Design Thinking approach. We operate at the critical intersection of product management and engineering, ensuring our solutions provide seamless connectivity for a global customer base. Our group consists of high-performing, collaborative experts who thrive on transparency and a culture of continuous learning. We are most excited about pushing the boundaries of scale and velocity while directly shaping the future of Cisco’s software ecosystem. This high-impact environment offers a unique opportunity to influence both the architectural direction and the user experience of our most advanced networking platforms.

Welcome to the heart of Cisco’s enterprise networking innovation. We are the IOS-XE Image Install engineering team, a group of passionate systems software professionals dedicated to powering the infrastructure that connects the world.

OUR MISSION & IMPACT

In today's digital landscape, network downtime is simply not an option. Our team owns the critical Image Install component of Cisco IOS-XE, the operating system running across Cisco's industry-leading enterprise switching, routing, and wireless portfolios. We architect and deliver the software lifecycle management mechanisms that allow millions of enterprise devices to upgrade, provision, and recover seamlessly. From automated zero-touch provisioning to robust in-service software upgrades (ISSU), our code ensures mission-critical networks remain secure, resilient, and always online.

ENGINEERING EXCELLENCE & CULTURE

We operate at the intersection of deep systems programming and modern software engineering. Our work requires a rigorous understanding of Linux kernel mechanics, flash file systems, bootloaders, and high-availability architecture. We believe that true reliability begins with elegant design, rigorous automated testing, and a culture of continuous learning. As a team, we champion technical ownership, collaborative problem-solving, and a relentless drive for quality.

WHY JOIN US AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER?

This is a unique opportunity to shape the foundational architecture of Cisco’s next-generation networking platforms. As a Software Engineer on our team, you will not just write code; you will architect robust, low-level systems that handle complex failure scenarios gracefully and scale to meet the demands of global enterprises. You will work alongside seasoned industry experts who are eager to mentor, collaborate, and push the boundaries of what is possible in network operating systems.

If you have a passion for low-level systems engineering, a commitment to reliability, and the drive to impact how the world communicates, we invite you to build your career with us at Cisco."

YOUR IMPACT

Design, develop, and maintain high-quality code by applying advanced C/C++ and Linux systems programming to solve complex networking challenges. Lead technical features from initial conception through production delivery to ensure our software remains robust, scalable, and secure. Drive the software development lifecycle by integrating Design Thinking principles to optimize system reliability and performance in high-availability environments. Mentor junior engineers and collaborate across functional teams to advocate for product innovation that creates long-term customer value. Identify technical risks early and conduct rigorous code reviews to maintain the integrity of our distributed systems and networking infrastructure.

"Drove innovation within the IOS-XE software packaging and installation pipeline, modernizing the software lifecycle management framework. Delivered highly modular and resilient upgrade solutions that scaled effortlessly across diverse enterprise routing, switching, IIOT, and wireless platforms, directly improving customer operational efficiency and network uptime."

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree plus 7 years of related experience, Master’s degree plus 4 years of related experience, or PhD plus 1 year of related experience.
• Application of C for memory management, concurrency, and multithreading.
• Experience with Linux systems programming, including POSIX IPC, sockets, and process lifecycle management.
• Experience in distributed system architecture, specifically control plane and data plane separation.
• Experience with debugging tools including GDB, Linux tracing utilities, and post-mortem crash analysis.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Demonstrated ability to lead medium-scale technical features from initial design to successful production deployment.
• Proven experience mentoring peers and junior engineers to foster technical growth and team excellence.
• Exceptional cross-functional communication skills, including technical writing, presentation, and stakeholder management.
• Experience with threat modeling and production monitoring to ensure system security and high availability.
• Ability to thrive in a collaborative environment and advocate for user-centric innovation using Design Thinking.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.description:

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to
innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and committed support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

The Amazon Web Services (AWS) sales organization is looking for an experienced Solutions
Architect Leader to grow and lead a team of Solutions Architects who support our largest SWAT
customers. In this role you and your team will partner with sellers as part of an account team,
to drive business outcomes for your customers. You will lead, motivate, and coach your team in
developing relationships with technical executives, guide customers in using architecture best
practices, partner with product teams to invent new solutions on behalf of your customers,
develop internal processes. You will also coach your team in scaling their learnings through
internal and external publications and speaking engagements.

Your customers consist of the largest public and fastest growing software companies who provide
solutions for enterprises, processing billions of transactions per day. Come join AWS in
inventing the future of cloud computing in partnership with some of the most technologically
advanced companies (SWAT). It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be
part of our diverse teams of thinkers and doers.

Key job responsibilities
- Hire, on-board, train, and develop new Solutions Architects including Principal Solutions
Architects.
- Coach Solutions Architects in the skills needed to work with SWAT customers to transfer deep
technical knowledge.
- As a key member of the solutions architecture team, ensure success in building, migrating and
modernizing applications, software and services on AWS.
- Ensure you and your team deliver software solutions on AWS that lead to business outcomes,
including migrations to AWS and global expansion of existing customer services.
- Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural
discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud.
- Partner and coach your team to partner with supporting specialist and service teams in
developing solutions.
- Develop relationships with your customers' key technical executives and decision makers.
- Contribute to ideation discussions with your customers, making them aware of the AWS service
capabilities.
- Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS Solutions Architect community.
- Coach your team to share their learning internally and externally both written and through
speaking engagements.
- Act as a technical liaison between customers, Service Teams and Support.
- Leverage your strong writing skills to produce high quality documents that propose new
processes or inventions.
- Become an expert in AWS leadership principles and coach your team to become role models.

Speed is of essence at AWS. You'll will lead your team prioritizing and quickly acting on customer initiatives, leveraging all applicable programs, resources, and teams. You will stay on top of new AWS services. Finally, you'll set time aside for strategic thinking and writing.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Tech, Fulfilment by Amazon, Selling Partner Services
jobs.description:
Amazon's inventory identity system was built two decades ago for a simpler world — one product, one barcode, one country, one tracking number. That assumption now constrains some of the largest strategic bets Amazon is making: a global inventory pool that lets sellers stock once and sell everywhere, multi-box fulfillment for products like furniture and gym equipment  and a cross-border fulfillment network that treats inventory as truly fungible across regions.

We are looking for a Senior PMT to drive the vision for FBA Identity — a foundational transformation of how Amazon identifies, tracks, and fulfills physical products. You will own the product strategy and execution for globalizing inventory identity, decoupling barcodes from tracking numbers, and enabling a single product to be represented as multiple independently fulfillable units. This is not an incremental feature. It is a platform shift that touches 600+ downstream systems, requires sustained alignment across four engineering organizations (FBA, AFT, Catalog, SCOT), and directly unlocks billions in combined addressable opportunity across multiple programs.

You will work directly with Principal Engineers, Senior Principal Engineers, and VP-level leaders across Amazon's supply chain to define the architecture, run experiments in live fulfillment centers, and ship changes that compound across every program built on top of inventory identity. If you want to work on infrastructure that reshapes how Amazon's entire fulfillment network operates — and see your decisions show up in the experience of millions of sellers — this is the role.

Key job responsibilities
Own the product vision and roadmap for modernizing how Amazon identifies and tracks physical products across its global fulfillment network. Translate a multi-year platform transformation into concrete, shippable milestones that deliver incremental business value at each stage — unlocking new product categories, new geographies, and new fulfillment models along the way.

Drive cross-organization alignment across four engineering organizations that each own critical pieces of the architecture. You are the person who ensures they move together, resolves competing priorities, and keeps the program on track through a cross-org governance model with leadership.

Design guardrails, reversible rollout plans, and structured pilots that let us move fast without breaking the network.

Write the business case and technical requirements to quantify trade-offs across seller experience, fulfillment cost, and operational complexity, make recommendations, and present to leadership for investment decisions.

Shape the AI-accelerated execution strategy. This program leverages AI for discovery, deduplication, anomaly detection, and inference across complex product hierarchies. You will identify where AI compresses timelines and where human judgment remains essential.

Represent FBA in cross-VP goal-setting during OP planning. You will author the goal proposals, defend the investment asks, and ensure partner organizations formally commit resources.

A day in the life
You start with a design review alongside Principal Engineers, debating how a proposed change impacts fulfillment center tooling — and pushing back when a solution adds seller complexity.

Mid-morning, you review pilot results from two FC types, draft a remediation plan for newly discovered system dependencies, and escalate one issue to the relevant stakeholders.

After lunch, you present the quarterly roadmap to Directors and VPs, walking through sequencing trade-offs and landing a decision on what ships first.

You close the day writing a one-pager that translates a technical architecture choice into the business case leaders need to fund.

About the team
FBA powers commerce for millions of sellers and hundreds of millions of customers. The Identity team sits at the intersection of catalog, fulfillment, and supply chain — the layer that determines what a product is to Amazon's network, how it moves, and where it can be sold. Amazon's supply chain is evolving from regional networks into a single global system. Multi-box products, cross-border fulfillment, virtual multipacks, and inventory sharing all depend on a modernized identity layer. This team is building it. The decisions made here remove constraints that block billions in opportunity across the organization.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables.

Job Summary

Kairos Power is seeking an Instrumentation, Controls and Electrical (IC&E) Engineer to support the design, development, implementation, and optimization of instrumentation, controls and automation systems for the Kairos Power Fuels program. In this role, you will perform IC&E engineering activities for prototype and production systems supporting TRISO fuel fabrication, including equipment and instrumentation selection, design integration, system implementation, commissioning, and troubleshooting.

Responsibilities

• Perform IC&E design and engineering activities for prototype and production systems supporting TRISO fuel fabrication.

• Implement and configure process automation solutions in coordination with process, mechanical and other engineering disciplines based on defined process requirements, control narratives and safety design requirements.

• Develop equipment and instrumentation specifications and select appropriate IC&E components, including instrumentation, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), variable frequency drives (VFDs), motors, controllers, and input/output (I/O) components, based on process, control and operational requirements.

• Develop and review IC&E engineering requirements, equipment and instrumentation lists, data sheets, and related technical documentation.

• Review and contribute to piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs) and other process documentation to support the development and integration of IC&E designs.

• Interpret Cause-and-Effect (C&E) diagrams and translate defined control requirements into control sequences and associated IC&E implementation.

• Participate in design reviews to evaluate mechanical and process designs for IC&E integration and define cabling, instrumentation, electrical interface, and equipment-control requirements.

• Coordinate with CAD and other design personnel to develop cable routing and instrumentation and electrical interface requirements for process equipment and skid designs.

• Provide hands-on engineering support for the fabrication, assembly, installation, integration, and checkout of controls and instrumentation for assigned systems.

• Develop and support execution of commissioning plans, procedures, functional tests, and associated test documentation for instrumentation, controls and process equipment.

• Support checkout and verification of instrumentation and control system inputs, outputs, alarms, interlocks, control sequences, scaling, and calibration in accordance with approved design requirements.

• Interface with vendors and suppliers to support technical evaluation, selection, procurement, and integration of equipment and instrumentation.

• Collect, review and analyze system and operational data to identify opportunities to improve IC&E design, system performance, reliability, maintainability, safety, and operational efficiency.

• Troubleshoot process automation, instrumentation, controls, and equipment issues during fabrication, commissioning, startup, and operations and support development and implementation of appropriate technical solutions.

• Participate in process hazard analyses and design and operational safety reviews, including HAZOP and What-If analyses, as applicable.

• Prepare and review IC&E engineering reports and other technical documentation related to assigned systems and engineering activities.

• Collaborate with facility operations and engineering teams to implement, optimize and sustain TRISO fuel fabrication processes and associated automation and control systems.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related engineering discipline; an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be considered.

• 4+ years of relevant experience in instrumentation, controls, electrical, process automation, or related engineering work in a chemical, pharmaceutical, industrial, manufacturing, or similar process environment.

• Experience developing or implementing instrumentation and control solutions for industrial or process equipment.

• Experience reading, interpreting and working with engineering documentation such as PFDs, P&IDs, equipment lists, instrumentation data sheets, control narratives, and Cause-and-Effect diagrams.

• Experience specifying or selecting instrumentation and controls equipment based on process and operational requirements.

• Experience supporting the installation, integration, testing, commissioning, or startup of instrumentation, controls, automation, or process equipment.

• Experience working with hazardous processes or chemicals and applying appropriate engineering and safety controls.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Rockwell / Allen-Bradley platforms (Studio 5000, CompactLogix or ControlLogix), including Add-On Instruction development and version management is preferred.

• Experience with Ignition or a comparable modern SCADA platform is preferred.

• Experience with EtherNet/IP remote I/O and IO-Link device architectures is preferred.

• Experience in nuclear, radiological or other regulated manufacturing environments, including their documentation and traceability expectations is preferred.

• Experience with modular skid design, fabrication and field integration, and with process unit operations such as powder handling, thermal processing, coating, compaction, or solvent recovery is preferred.

• Exposure to TRISO fuel, advanced ceramics, graphite and carbon-based materials, or high-temperature process systems is preferred.

• Experience scripting or automating engineering tasks (for example, Python or VBA) to generate controls code, tag databases, or test documentation is preferred.

• Experience with 2D or 3D design software (AutoCAD, SolidWorks or equivalent) sufficient to produce and mark up fabrication and installation drawings is preferred.

• Familiarity with process hazard analysis methods and functional safety concepts is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Knowledge of instrumentation and process control principles, including measurement, control loops, alarms, interlocks, control sequencing, and basic process automation concepts.

• Knowledge of industrial controls equipment and components, including PLCs, VFDs, motors, controllers, I/O, process instrumentation, and associated electrical interfaces.

• Ability to apply instrumentation scaling and calibration principles during system design, checkout, commissioning, and troubleshooting.

• Ability to troubleshoot instrumentation, control and automation system issues using engineering documentation, system data, equipment information, and observed system performance.

• Ability to support functional testing and verification of instrumentation, controls and process equipment in accordance with approved design requirements and test procedures.

• Ability to analyze technical and operational data and use findings to support engineering decisions and system improvements.

• Ability to prepare clear and accurate engineering documentation, requirements, reports, plans, and test records.

• Ability to communicate technical information effectively and collaborate across engineering, operations, EHS, quality, and vendor or supplier teams.

• Ability to manage multiple engineering activities and priorities while maintaining accuracy, documentation quality and attention to technical requirements.

• Ability to apply established safety requirements and practices when working with process equipment, instrumentation, controls, and hazardous processes.

Physical Conditions

• Ascending or descending ladders, stairs, scaffolding, ramps, scissor lifts, articulated boom lifts and the like.

• Moving self in different positions to accomplish tasks in various environments including tight and confined spaces.

• Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.

• Moving about to accomplish tasks or moving from one worksite to another.

• Adjusting, moving, transporting, installing, positioning, or removing objects up to 10 pounds in all directions.

• Communicating with others to exchange information.

Environmental Conditions

• General office environment.

• Noisy environments.

• Odors or fumes from chemicals or chemical reactions.

• Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned.

• High-concentration, demanding and fast-paced.

Safety and PPE

• Reading and interpreting hazardous warning signs.

• Reporting issues with equipment or unsafe conditions.

• Wearing proper PPE, to include face mask, face shields, gloves, safety footwear, and other PPE as required.

Travel

• Some travel may be required, up to 5%

Additional Requirements

• Seldom requires working weekends.

• Occasionally requires schedule flexibility.

• Seldom requires extended hours to support launch and critical project timelines .

Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Opportunity: Grow Your Career

Responsible for delivering a highly satisfied customer experience proven by engaging and interacting with all customers, embodying customer experience principles and philosophy, and maintaining a clean and organized store environment. Adheres to all operational, merchandise, and loss prevention standards. May be cross-trained to work in multiple areas of the store in order to support the needs of the business.

• Possesses strong communication and organizational skills with attention to detail

• Capable of lifting heavy objects with or without reasonable accommodation
• Works effectively with peers and supervisors
• Retail customer experience preferred

Job Description:

DePuy Synthes, the orthopedics business of Johnson & Johnson, is recruiting for a North America Transport Operations Lead (M1), preferably based in Raynham, with remote as an alternative location in North America.

Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate its Orthopedics business to establish a standalone orthopedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal and regulatory requirements. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes, and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans.

Purpose of the Position

The North America Transport Operations Lead (M1) is a key member of the global supply chain function, responsible for operational management of the transportation network across the North America region, including importation from global sites in other regions.

The role ensures the reliable, cost-efficient, and fully compliant movement of products — from manufacturing sites and regional hubs into local distribution centers, hospitals, and distributors — while safeguarding adherence to customs and international trade regulations across all operating countries.

This is a single regional leadership position that brings together two closely related disciplines: how products physically move (transportation networks, carriers, logistics providers) and how they cross borders compliantly (customs, import/export, trade documentation). The role partners closely with regional and global stakeholders enable uninterrupted product flow, mitigate risk, and drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive value across North America through optimized regional transportation flows for both inbound freight (from manufacturing sites and global hubs to regional hubs, and from hubs to local affiliates and distributor warehouses).

• Manage relationships with third-party and fourth-party logistics providers (including global Control Tower partners) through performance metrics, strategic direction, and continuous improvement programs.

• Support further deployment, development and maturity of the Global control tower in the North America region

• Lead performance measurement of transport reliability through critical metrics aligned with regional Plan, Make, and Deliver operations teams; provide input into executive performance reviews.

• Deliver on annual cost improvement and productivity targets through operational improvements while protecting service, quality, reliability, and compliance.

• Translate regional inventory strategy and business requirements into innovative transportation solutions; support transportation set-up for manufacturing network changes and new product launches.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner with regional and global supply chain, Trade Compliance operations, Quality, finance, and legal teams to enable compliant product movement and rapid issue resolution.

• Represent transportation in end-to-end supply chain forums, projects, and sales and operations planning discussions; drive process alignment and trade-off decisions.

• Actively collaborate with the regional Deliver lead, distribution operations, and demand & supply planning teams to optimize capacity planning, reliability, and adherence to service commitments.

• Support product launches, network changes, and supply chain transformations by assessing and managing transportation impacts.

Key Objectives / Metrics

• Transportation cost and continuous improvement savings delivery.

• Transportation reliability — manufacturing/hub to distribution center, and distribution center to customer.

• Logistics provider (Control Tower) performance against agreed service levels and value creation targets.

Qualifications

Education

• Bachelor's degree required (Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, International Trade, or related field).

• Master's degree or MBA preferred.

Required Experience and Skills

• 6–8 years of progressive experience in supply chain, transportation, trade compliance, logistics, or related operational roles, aligned with a manager-level position.

• Strong working knowledge of international trade, customs regulations, and import/export operations within North America.

• Solid expertise across core transportation, planning, and carrier / logistics-provider management, including familiarity with control-tower operating models.

• Excellent analytical skills and an affinity for numbers: ability to support budgeting, financial reconciliation, and identify cost-saving opportunities in transportation.

• Good understanding of the order-to-cash process and end-to-end supply chain mindset.

• Experience partnering with global stakeholders and operating within a matrixed, multinational organization.

• Proven ability to manage complex operational issues, assess risk, and drive compliant outcomes.

• Effective communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills across cultures and geographies.

Preferred Experience and Skills

• Experience in medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or other highly regulated industries.

• Familiarity with global trade systems, transportation management systems, enterprise resource planning platforms, and transport & trade visibility & automation tools.

• Demonstrated experience leading regional or global process standardization initiatives.

• Understanding of good distribution practice and a quality-first approach.

• Lean or continuous improvement certification is a plus.

• Demonstrated awareness of artificial intelligence concepts and responsible / ethical use, with experience generating effective prompts to boost productivity.

Other

• Language: English required; additional languages are a plus.

• Travel: Up to 25–30% regional and international travel.

jobs.title: HSE Specialist (Occupational Health)
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Location: Durham, North Carolina, United States

Imagine serving as the Lead for the Occupational Health Program for a dynamic manufacturing and laboratory campus while helping protect associates and strengthen a proactive safety culture. As the HSE Specialist, you will develop and continuously improve critical programs such as chemical hygiene, hazard communication, respiratory protection, ergonomics, hearing conservation, confined space, and occupational medical. You will collaborate across site departments, provide technical HSE expertise for changing operations and equipment, support regulatory compliance and inspection readiness, and help ensure the successful implementation of Novartis Health, Safety, and Environment standards across the site.

#LI-Onsite

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

·   Develop, manage, and continuously improve Occupational Health programs, including Chemical Hygiene, Hazard Communication, Respiratory Protection, Ergonomics, Hearing Conservation, Confined Space, and Occupational Medical programs.

·   Serve as the Chemical Hygiene Officer, overseeing chemical inventory management, risk assessments, control implementation, and employee training.

·   Partner with manufacturing, laboratory, warehouse, facilities, and support functions to develop and continuously improve HSE programs and services.

·   Provide HSE technical expertise for new equipment, changing operations, product transfers, and site change management activities.

·   Support the development and delivery of HSE training programs while promoting a strong, proactive, and enabling safety culture across the site.

·   Lead inspections, investigations, audits, and regulatory activities, ensuring effective corrective actions, audit readiness, and compliance with HSE requirements.

·   Analyze HSE performance trends and drive continuous improvement initiatives that advance site HSE excellence and business performance.

·   Assist with implementation of emergency preparedness and response activities.

Essential Requirements

·   BS degree or higher in Occupational Health & Safety, Chemical Engineering, or related field, with 5+ years of HSE program development and management experience in a manufacturing or laboratory environment, preferably within the biopharmaceutical industry.

·   Strong technical knowledge across Health, Safety, and Environment disciplines, including occupational health programs and regulatory compliance.

·   Demonstrated proficiency in chemical and biological risk assessments, including development and management of effective risk control programs.

·   Experience supporting regulatory inspections, audits, and compliance activities within a regulated manufacturing or laboratory environment.

·   Strong influencing, collaboration, and relationship-building skills with the ability to work effectively across a matrixed organization.

·   Excellent communication and technical writing skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Desirable Requirements

·   Professional HSE certifications such as Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) or Certified Safety Professional (CSP), or a desire to attain them.

·   Experience supporting biopharmaceutical manufacturing operations and laboratory environments.

The salary for this position is expected to range between $89,600 and $166,400 per year. The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors. Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards. US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits.
