jobs.title: Incoming & Manufacturing Quality Technician
jobs.description:
About Mendaera, Inc.

Mendaera is developing technology that will enable all healthcare providers to do more for their patients. Our platform combines real-time imaging, robotics, and artificial intelligence to make precise and consistent intervention more accessible. Our aim is to eliminate barriers in the patient journey, accelerate recovery, delight customers, and reduce cost of care.

About the Opportunity

The Incoming & Manufacturing Quality Technician is responsible for ensuring the quality and compliance of incoming materials, manufacturing processes, and production documentation in support of medical device manufacturing. The role performs incoming inspections, in-process quality inspections, documentation review, equipment and calibration support, and nonconformance processing to ensure products meet company, regulatory, and customer requirements.

Salary Range: $95,000 to $115,000 (this is an hourly position)

About You

We are looking for candidates who thrive in fast-paced environments, embrace ambiguity, can support the development of frameworks and work products, are willing to engage in both detailed and broader-level analysis, possess critical and systems-thinking abilities, and are detail-oriented.

Responsibilities Include

• Perform incoming inspection of purchased materials, components, and assemblies using approved inspection procedures and sampling plans.

• Review supplier documentation, engineering drawings, specifications, and acceptance criteria.

• Conduct visual, dimensional, and functional inspections using calibrated inspection equipment.

• Support manufacturing through in-process and in-line inspections to verify compliance with approved procedures and quality standards.

• Review Device History Records (DHRs), travelers, Manufacturing Process Instructions (MPIs), and related production documentation for accuracy and completeness.

• Identify, document, and segregate nonconforming materials; initiate and support Nonconformance Reports (NCMRs) and Material Review Board (MRB) activities.

• Coordinate equipment calibration, preventive maintenance, and equipment status while maintaining calibration records.

• Support product release activities, rework verification, engineering builds, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Ensure compliance with FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 13485, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and Good Documentation Practices (GDP).

• Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, and Regulatory Affairs to resolve quality issues and support production.

• Fulfill any other duties as assigned.

Required Skills and Experience

• Minimum 2+ years of quality inspection experience in a regulated manufacturing environment.

• Working knowledge of common inspection tools.

• Experience working with MS Office and Excel or Google Docs and Sheets.

• Experience in medical device manufacturing preferred.

• Ability to read engineering drawings for inspection/acceptance requirements and use precision measuring equipment.

• Knowledge of ISO 13485, FDA QMSR, GDP, GMP, and AQL sampling.

• Experience with eQMS and ERP systems.

• Process-oriented with the ability to plan and perform work.

Physical Demands

• Able to work in a fast-paced production environment.

• Ability to lift and handle objects up to 20 pounds.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Analyst
jobs.description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than  3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About the Role

At Roo, the Growth team works alongside the VP of Data to define the objectives of our company initiatives and ensure we are able to measure their impact. The team has 4 major goals -

• Prototyping new data-driven workflows designed to unlock growth.

• Helping teams/initiatives/projects define and dashboard their North Star.

• Helping teams/initiatives/projects run trusted experiments that attempt to improve a Roo Equation metric.

• Helping teams identify interesting trends and perform deep dive analysis

We are data driven and focus on a first principles approach. The team is involved in the full lifecycle of major product initiatives: leveraging data to identify opportunities, co-leading initiatives, investigating and sizing them, facilitating measurement of the impact of our efforts and developing/maintaining dashboards to report on our progress.

This role reports directly to the Head of Growth and while the role will operate on a remote basis, you will be required to occasionally be onsite in our San Francisco coworking space for meetings and team events.

Responsibilities

• Partner with the Head of Product and Initiative Leads to set and monitor objectives and core metrics for all product initiatives.

• Develop and maintain dashboarding to help cross-functional teams and leadership monitor the progress of each independent workstream.

• Partner with the Go To Market team to identify opportunities for and measure impact creation/improvement of “levers”.

• Translate insights into a clear and effective execution direction for product teams.

• Partner with the Head of Product to investigate and size new opportunities.

Qualifications

• You have years of experience running ad hoc investigations on datasets using SQL, that lead to actionable insights.

• You have a deep understanding of typical marketplace metrics and ecosystem dynamics. Ideally, you’ve spent 5+ years in a product or analytics role at a fast-growing marketplace startup.

• You feel comfortable expressing relationships with mathematical equations.

• You are always looking for ways to simplify instead of further complicate.

• You have exceptional written and verbal communication skills, able to in the right situation either deeply explain or make totally accessible complex topics.

• Exceptional leadership and emotional intelligence with the ability to inspire and motivate cross functional stakeholders through influence over authority.

• You’d move mountains (or wash dishes) to drive successful outcomes.

jobs.title: Senior Brand & Integrated Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than  3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Brand & Integrated Marketing Manager to build the big moments that define Roo's brand. You'll lead the launches, campaigns, and stories that shape how veterinary professionals and animal hospitals experience Roo. Your work will build awareness, trust, and affinity while supporting Roo's broader growth through strong strategy, storytelling, execution, and measurement.

Responsibilities

Integrated Campaigns & Launches

• Lead Roo's biggest launches and company-level brand campaigns end-to-end: audience insight, narrative, briefs, channel planning, cross-functional orchestration, execution, and measurement.

• Own Roo's brand campaign calendar and measurement standard, partnering with brand, product marketing, lifecycle, partnerships, and other functions so every campaign feels like Roo.

• Lead brand research and benchmarks that show how campaigns move awareness and perception, and use them to guide where brand investment goes next.

• Turn industry moments (conferences, recognition weeks, and seasonal moments) into signature Roo moments.

• Bring strong creative ideas and storytelling to every campaign, including new formats and channels.

• Lead a steady cadence of co-marketing campaigns with Roo's strategic partners, and turn customer and success stories into integrated campaigns, press, and thought leadership.

• Lead brand growth in new markets, adapting campaigns, PR, and industry presence for each market as Roo expands.

• Own and track campaign and PR agency budgets, and build repeatable systems for campaign planning, briefing, and measurement.

Thought Leadership & PR

• Partner with our PR agency on earned media, trade media, and sponsored content, turning Roo's proof points into stories that strengthen our credibility.

• Build Roo's thought leadership program, bringing Roo's point of view on the future of veterinary work to the industry through research, content, and speaking opportunities.

• Elevate the voices of veterinary professionals, hospital leaders, and Roo's executives so Roo's story is told by the people who live it.

Qualifications

• You have deep experience in integrated, brand, or campaign marketing, including leading major multi-channel launches from strategy through measurement.

• You bring cross-functional teams together around a shared plan and keep complex launches on track.

• You've managed PR agencies or earned-media programs and built thought leadership that lands with a professional audience.

• You've owned brand research, budgets, and agency relationships, and make smart trade-offs with each.

• A strong storyteller with creative judgment and a clear point of view on how to measure whether a campaign worked.

• Thoughtful about where AI and emerging tools improve how marketing teams work, and where human judgment matters most.

• Experience in veterinary medicine, healthcare, tech, marketplaces, labor platforms, or mission-driven companies is a plus.

While we are a remote first company, if you are based in San Francisco this will be a hybrid role.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. You Will:

• Own the design, implementation and landing of features to prevent, detect and mitigate account takeovers.

• Collaborate cross-organizationally with partner teams in InfoSec, Economy, User, and the broader Roblox Safety org.

• Help define how goals get accomplished and have real influence over product direction.

• Instrument and analyze user interaction data (A/B tests, usage metrics) to inform design decisions and maximize product impact.

• Own implementation end to end across the stack, contributing in GoLang, Python, Typescript and Lua as projects require, using AI tools wherever possible.

You Have:

• 3+ years of experience in Software Engineering/Computer Science

• Experience working on user facing applications or services

• Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as GoLang, Python, C#, and Javascript.

• Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product stakeholders to define requirements and deliver technical solutions.

• A strong commitment to designing, implementing, and maintaining systems that prioritize user safety, data integrity, and compliance with safety policies.

jobs.title: Staff Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Hardware Platform Organization is Anduril's central hardware engineering org. We build the shared technologies, tools, and infrastructure that power hardware development across every Anduril division, from actuators and propulsion to batteries, avionics, rocket motors, and test operations. Our teams set engineering standards, run development manufacturing and test sites, and develop core technology products that ship across multiple product lines.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Motor Control Algorithm Development
•       Design and implement field-oriented control (FOC), six-step commutation, and direct torque control algorithms for BLDC and PMSM motors
•       Develop sensorless rotor position estimation techniques (back-EMF observer, sliding-mode observer, high-frequency injection) for applications where Hall sensors or encoders are not viable
•       Design current, speed, and position control loops with rigorous bandwidth, stability margins, and disturbance rejection specifications
Modelling & Simulation (MIL / SIL / HIL)
•       Build high-fidelity motor and inverter plant models in MATLAB / Simulink, including magnetic saturation, iron losses, and thermal coupling
•       Develop controller models and validate performance through Model-in-the-Loop (MIL) simulation against requirements
•       Execute Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) testing using Embedded Coder auto-generated C code to verify fixed-point scaling, quantisation effects, and code-generation fidelity
•       Support Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) integration with real-time simulators (dSPACE, Typhoon HIL, or equivalent) for full controller board validation
•       Integrate Simulink auto-coded algorithm modules with the microcontroller RTOS, peripheral drivers, and application framework
Firmware & Embedded Systems
•       Implement motor control firmware in C on microcontrollers (e.g., STM32, TI C2000, NXP S32K) with hard real-time constraints
•       Configure and optimise motor control peripherals: PWM timers, ADC synchronisation, encoder/Hall interfaces, comparator-based overcurrent protection
•       Architect firmware for deterministic control loop execution — interrupt prioritisation, DMA pipelines, and minimal-jitter scheduling
•       Implement fault detection, diagnosis, and safe-state management in firmware (overcurrent, overvoltage, overtemperature, sensor loss, stall, phase loss)
•       Develop communication interfaces (CAN, SPI, UART, RS-485) for command, telemetry, and diagnostics

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

•       Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, or equivalent hands-on experience
•       10+ years of professional experience designing and implementing motor control algorithms (FOC, Trapezoidal, or equivalent) for BLDC or PMSM motors
•       Strong foundation in classical and modern control theory — PID tuning, frequency-domain analysis, state estimation, observer design
•       Proficiency in MATLAB / Simulink, PLECS for control design, motor modelling, and auto-code generation (Embedded Coder or equivalent)
•       Deep experience writing production-quality embedded code on  microcontrollers with hard real-time motor control loops
•       Perform Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) integration with real-time simulators
•       Working knowledge of power electronics: three-phase inverter operation, PWM schemes, dead-time compensation, DC bus dynamics, and loss estimation
•       Hands-on experience with motor control peripherals — ADC triggering, encoder/Hall/resolver interfaces, PWM complementary outputs, hardware overcurrent comparators
•       Familiarity with communication protocols: CAN, SPI, I²C, UART, RS-485 etc
•       Strong bench skills — oscilloscope, current probe, frequency response analyser, dynamometer or motor test stand
•       U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export-controlled data (ITAR / EAR)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

•       Master's or PhD with thesis work in motor control, power electronics, or electric machine design
•       Experience with sensorless control techniques at low speed and standstill (HFI, pulsating voltage injection)
•       Experience with SiC or GaN power device integration and high-switching-frequency inverter design
•       Experience with real-time simulation platforms (dSPACE, OPAL-RT, Typhoon HIL) for HIL validation
•       Background in defense, automation, automotive, aerospace,  or robotics motor control applications — actuators, gimbal drives, electric propulsion
•       Experience with thermal modeling of motors and inverters, I²t protection, and derating algorithms
•       Active or ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance

US Salary Range

$191,000—$253,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Head of Brand & Communications
jobs.description:
About Goodfire

Goodfire is an AI interpretability research lab. We build interpretability agents and infrastructure to understand, monitor, and align AI models.

We believe that AI is the most consequential technology of our time. Yet AI models are trained by trial and error today, with limited understanding of what drives their behavior. Our goal is to advance the research and technology needed to fully understand and align AI so humanity can trust superintelligence.

Goodfire is a public benefit corporation founded by researchers who helped pioneer the field of interpretability at OpenAI and Google DeepMind. We are headquartered in San Francisco and have raised over $200M from leading investors including Lightspeed, Menlo, and B Capital.

About the role

We’re hiring a Head of Brand & Communications to own how the world understands Goodfire. Our mission is to solve interpretability and alignment, build frontier safety infrastructure, and deploy our technology to the world. It's your job to make this mission impossible to ignore

You’ll set the strategy for telling our story everywhere it matters: X, press, blogs, executive communications, and in everyday conversations. Your work will shape how the field sees Goodfire, earning trust and attracting world-class researchers, engineers, and partners to us. You have a deep fluency in the AI landscape, exceptional storytelling ability, excellent taste, and high agency. You’ve shaped companies’ narratives, built an influential public presence, and produced public communications you’re proud of.

Key responsibilities

• Own Goodfire's brand and communication strategy. Define our narrative, positioning, and voice. Decide what we say, where we say it, and how we establish Goodfire as a leader in AI interpretability and alignment

• Own Goodfire’s social media strategy and execution. Build a distinctive, high-credibility presence that increases awareness of Goodfire and our capabilities

• Turn complex research into threads, essays, blog posts, and explainers that technical audiences love to read, in topics from from core research breakthroughs to applied work with our partners in areas like life sciences.

• Lead communications across every channel. Own how we show up across social, press, blogs, our website, and other external touchpoints.

• Drive measurable inbound demand and recruiting interest through brand and content efforts

• Shape Goodfire's external narrative: how we talk about our capabilities, why it matters, and where the field is going

• Lead agency partnerships and build relationships with journalists, researchers, and influential voices across the AI community

• Partner with founders and researchers to amplify their voices, helping them develop their social presence and translating their thinking into public-facing content

Our values

Goodfire is looking for individuals who embody our values and share our deep commitment to making interpretability accessible. We are building a team first and foremost.

Put mission and team first

All we do is in service of our mission. We trust each other, deeply care about the success of the organization, and choose to put our team above ourselves.

Improve constantly

We are constantly looking to improve every piece of the business. We proactively critique ourselves and others in a kind and thoughtful way that translates to practical improvements in the organization. We are pragmatic and consistently implement the obvious fixes that work.

Take ownership and initiative

There are no bystanders here. We proactively identify problems and take full responsibility over getting a strong result. We are self-driven, own our mistakes, and feel deep responsibility over what we’re building.

Action today

We have a small amount of time to do something incredibly hard and meaningful. The pace and intensity of the organization is high. If we can take action today or tomorrow, we will choose to do it today.

Where we work

We are hiring for this position in our San Francisco office who’d be onsite 5 days a week.

What we offer

This role offers market competitive salary, equity, and competitive benefits.

The expected salary range for this position is $250-400k.

This role reports to our CEO.

Most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to join a vital mission at an important point in its trajectory — we are developing groundbreaking technology with a world-class team on the critical path to ensuring a safe and beneficial future for humanity. If you want to do your life’s work with us, even if you believe you do not meet every single requirement, apply now.

jobs.title: Power Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril is seeking an experienced Power Controls Engineer to develop and implement advanced control algorithms for high-performance power electronic systems. We're looking for someone with deep expertise in control system modeling and simulation — particularly in Simulink and PLECS — who can take a controls concept from simulation through hardware validation. This individual will own the control architecture for DC/DC converters, inverters, and motor drives built around discrete SiC and GaN power stages, and will work closely with power hardware and firmware engineers to deliver tightly integrated, high-reliability systems for defense and aerospace applications.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Design, simulate, and validate closed-loop control algorithms for switch-mode power converters and inverters using Simulink and/or PLECS.

• Controls for 3-phase AC systems, with and without a switched Neutral

• Develop plant models and controller architectures (voltage-mode, current-mode, sensorless FOC, etc.) for multi-kW power stages utilizing discrete SiC and GaN FETs.

• Perform stability analysis, loop shaping, and compensator design to meet transient response, efficiency, and EMI targets.

• Collaborate with power hardware engineers on gate drive tuning, dead-time optimization, and switching-loss characterization of wide-bandgap devices.

• Support model-based code generation workflows and work with firmware engineers to translate control designs into embedded implementations.

• Define and execute hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and power-hardware-in-the-loop (PHIL) test plans to validate control performance against system requirements.

• Contribute to trade studies on converter topology, modulation strategy, and control bandwidth as they relate to size, weight, power, and thermal constraints.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• BS in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, or related discipline.

• 5+ years of experience designing and tuning digital control loops for power electronic converters (DC/DC, DC/AC, or motor drives).

• Proficiency in Simulink and/or PLECS for control system modeling, simulation, and analysis.

• Strong foundation in control theory — z-domain and s-domain design, bode analysis, state-space methods, and discrete-time implementation considerations.

• Hands-on experience with discrete SiC and/or GaN FET-based power stages in the multi-kW range.

• Familiarity with military or aerospace environments and standards such as MIL-STD-461, 464, 810, or DO-160.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• MS/PhD with a focus in power electronics controls or control systems.

• Experience writing embedded firmware (C/C++) for microcontrollers or DSPs used in power converter control (e.g., TI C2000, STM32).

• Familiarity with auto-code generation from Simulink (Embedded Coder) or similar model-based design toolchains.

• Experience with real-time HIL platforms (e.g., Typhoon HIL, dSPACE, OPAL-RT).

• Knowledge of advanced modulation techniques (SVM, DPWM) and their impact on switching losses in wide-bandgap devices.

• Design-for-Reliability practices including DFMEA.

• Experience with EMI mitigation strategies at the controls and layout level.

US Salary Range

$129,000—$171,000 USD

Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own a core part of our supply chain orchestration product. You'll work with customers whose operations depend on orders, shipments, and partner transactions moving correctly across companies and systems. Your job is to find where those workflows break down, decide what to build, and deliver products that measurably improve how our customers operate.

This is a senior, individual-contributor role. You'll own a product area from discovery through adoption, make prioritization calls across customer, platform, and commercial needs, and bring roadmap decisions and results to executive leadership. You'll go deep on technical details with engineering, and you'll apply AI where it clearly helps: diagnosing exceptions, guiding resolution, and removing manual work.

You'll work with Engineering, UX, Architecture, and Data Scientist in product development, and with Sales, Customer Success, Services, and Marketing to bring products to market.

What You Will Be Doing

Lead supply chain product strategy

• Own the product strategy and roadmap for supply chain orchestration, prioritizing by customer problem, business value, and fit with the platform.

• Develop a deep understanding of workflows such as order-to-cash, order fulfillment, shipment execution, and supplier and customer collaboration, including the exceptions that occur across organizational boundaries.

• Run discovery with operations users and business leaders. Turn workflow gaps into scalable product capabilities, and separate reusable opportunities from customer-specific customization.

• Define and track the outcomes your product should improve, such as order cycle time, on-time delivery, exception resolution time, manual effort, and trading partner onboarding time.

• Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Services, and Marketing to validate demand, position launches around customer value, enable field teams, and drive adoption after release.

Drive technical product decisions

• Define requirements for workflows spanning ERP, WMS, TMS, and trading partner systems, including APIs, EDI transactions, and business events.

• Work with engineering and architecture on data models, integration behavior, observability, security, reliability, and design tradeoffs.

• Turn strategy into clear requirements, prototypes, acceptance criteria, and phased releases, and lead build, buy, or partner decisions.

Apply AI where it creates measurable value

• Identify and prioritize AI use cases, such as exception diagnosis, guided resolution, and workflow automation, based on customer value, feasibility, and data readiness.

• With engineering, define how each AI capability will be evaluated and when a person needs to review or approve its actions. Measure task success, reliability, adoption, cost, and business impact.

Your Qualifications

Required

• 5+ years of product management experience, including significant time owning an enterprise or B2B SaaS product area end to end.

• Supply chain expertise in workflows such as order-to-cash, fulfillment, shipment execution, or trading partner collaboration, gained in product, consulting, or operations roles. You understand the users, the exceptions, and the metrics.

• A track record of taking products from discovery through launch and adoption, with measurable business results.

• Strong technical fluency in APIs, EDI, enterprise integration patterns, data models, and SaaS architecture. You can discuss tradeoffs with engineers in depth.

• Practical understanding of what modern AI, including LLMs and agent-based workflows, can and can't do, and the ability to define fit-for-purpose evaluations with technical partners.

• Sound judgment on priorities, the ability to influence without authority, and a record of presenting decisions and results to executives.

• Clear writing and communication, including explaining technical and AI concepts to business audiences.

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, supply chain, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred

• Experience serving manufacturing, distribution, retail, or 3PL/logistics customers.

• Working knowledge of EDI standards (X12, EDIFACT) and common ERP, WMS, or TMS platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics).

• Experience with B2B integration, iPaaS, or supply chain execution software.

• Has shipped at least one AI-enabled capability, such as LLM-based features, agentic workflows, or human-in-the-loop automation.

• Familiarity with responsible AI practices that matter to enterprise customers, such as auditability, explainability, and human approval controls.

• ASCM/APICS certification (CSCP, CPIM, or CLTD).

Travel

• 10–15% travel to visit customer sites and operations, meet partners, attend industry events, and join team planning sessions.

Why Join Us

• Shape the AI strategy and roadmap of a fast-growing company at a defining moment in the AI industry.

• High-visibility role with direct exposure to executive leadership and top customers.

• Work with a talented, cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and designers building the future of intelligent software.

• $130,000 to $150,000 base salary + annual bonus opportunity

We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in certain stages of our recruitment process, such as resume screening and candidate matching. These tools are designed to support fair and consistent evaluations. If you have questions about this process or would like to request an alternative assessment method, please contact us at hr@cleo.com.

Cleo Communications US, LLC is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
A Note From the Founder
Citizen has spent ten years building the only live network of what is happening in American cities right now. For most of that time it was a consumer product. It is now also the fastest way for the people responsible for protecting others at scale, stadiums, hospitals, corporate security teams, to see what is unfolding before anyone calls them. We have customers who will tell you that. What we do not yet have is a sales team built to find the next hundred of them. That is this job. You will work directly with our Director of Sales, with the founder closely involved and with a set of agents that do the research so you can spend your day in conversations.

The Role
Citizen is the #1 safety app in the U.S. Every day, thousands of videos are captured live at the scene of real incidents and distributed in real time to people in every major American city. No other consumer product has this. It is a live network, a newsroom, and a safety tool at once, and it is growing again.

Behind the consumer product, we work with hospitals, venue operators, and corporate security teams to give them better visibility, faster response times, and direct access to critical incident data. Our Enterprise offering gives real-time situational awareness to teams responsible for protecting people at scale, from stadiums like MSG to emergency departments to nationwide corporate footprints.

We are adding Account Executives to the enterprise team to build the outbound motion alongside our Director of Sales. This is a new-business, full-cycle role: you find the customer, you run the conversation, you close. No account management; once a customer is live, it moves to the team that serves them.

How We Work
Citizen is building an AI-native company: humans and agents working together. For this role that is concrete. Agents build the account lists, enrich the contacts, draft the first touch, and prep the call. You spend your time where it counts: on the phone, in the room, and in the follow-up that moves a deal. You should already be using tools like this and have a clear view of where they help and where they get in the way.

What You Will Own

 - The full new-business cycle: target list, first touch, discovery, demo, proposal, negotiation, close.

 - A pipeline you build and keep at seven figures, roughly half self-sourced through prospecting and events, half from inbound and partner leads, using Apollo, Sales Navigator and HubSpot.

 - The conversation with security directors, operations leads and executives: what they are protecting, what they see today, and what Citizen adds.

Requirements

jobs.title: Senior Data Researcher
jobs.description:
BUILD A SAFER WORLD.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM's Insights team publishes the original research that shapes how journalists, policymakers and investigators understand illicit finance and the crime behind it. As Senior Data Researcher, you will take a topic from question to published piece: gather and pressure-test the evidence, find the story and write it. Few roles anywhere combine intelligence across crime types with full ownership of the public narrative.

The impact you will have:

 - Publish original investigative research on the threats that matter most: fraud and scams, sanctions evasion, ransomware and cybercrime, terrorist financing, drug and human trafficking, and the financial networks behind them. Your work holds up under scrutiny from top-tier press and policymakers.

 - Use AI heavily in everything you do. TRM is an AI-native investigative company, so expect to use Claude, ChatGPT and agent-based tools to research, analyze data, stress-test methodology, draft and package each finding for every channel.

 - Lead original research that answers the biggest open questions about crime and the financial networks that power it. Combine TRM's blockchain intelligence with non-crypto sources (sanctions lists, court filings, corporate records, open-source and threat intelligence) to find patterns no one else has connected, then turn them into evidence that holds up.

 - Extend the research beyond the blog. Turn findings into training content for investigators and compliance teams, and pass emerging threat intelligence back to TRM's product and intelligence teams.

What we're looking for:

 - 5 to 8 years combining research or data analysis with published writing, including at least one high-impact investigation you led from evidence-gathering to final piece.

 - Strong analytical skills across varied sources (financial, open-source, court and regulatory records, structured datasets), using AI to speed up and check the work.

 - A public portfolio of investigative or research-led work with measurable reach (major media pickup, citations, audience growth). Investigative journalists, financial crime and threat intelligence researchers, and research-focused writers who do their own analysis have all done well in roles like this.

 - Deep AI fluency: you already rely heavily on AI across research, analysis, drafting and packaging, and you're comfortable running and quality-checking an agent-based production workflow. Experience in financial crime, sanctions, cybercrime, national security or crypto is a strong plus.

About the Team:

 - Insights is the public voice of TRM's research. It connects TRM's intelligence on illicit finance and crime with the press, policymakers and the wider industry.

 - The work is research-led, focused on the story, fast-moving and AI-native.

 - You'll work closely with Marketing, Communications, TRM's intelligence and investigations teams, product teams, and TRM Academy.

 - The team is small and opinionated, and it owns some of the most visible work TRM produces. Distributed, not distant.

Team Operating Rhythms:

 - Weekly Insights research review to set priorities and look at work in progress.

 - A weekly working session with Marketing to plan distribution and timing.

 - Async by default for drafts and methodology review. Meetings are for editorial decisions and launch planning.

 - The research and content workflow runs continuously, and you manage it day to day and week to week.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

 - Measurable example #1: Within 30 days, you publish your first piece of original data-backed research on TRM's blog, with a Marketing push behind it.

 - Measurable example #2: Within 60 days, you take a topic you picked through the full cycle (research, narrative, distribution) and show measurable gains in media coverage.

 - Measurable example #3: Within 90 days, you run the research and content workflow end to end, and your research feeds weekly training sessions for TRM Academy instructors.

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

 - Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

 - The estimated base salary range for this role is $160,000 - $180,000

 - Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

 - Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Work Week Travel: This role requires participation in in-person R&D work weeks, typically 1–2 times per quarter, at a TRM hub or other designated location. Work weeks may be scheduled with as little as 14 days’ notice, and some roles may require additional travel based on team and cross-functional needs. TRM coordinates and covers approved travel, lodging, and workspace. Accommodations are available for legitimate caregiving, health, immigration, and similar constraints.


APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.




INTERVIEWING WITH TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

 - Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

 - Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

 - First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

 - Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

 - References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

 - Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

 - Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.




AI FLUENCY AT TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

 - Accelerate repeatable workflows

 - Structure and solve problems

 - Improve output quality

 - Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.




LIFE AT TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

 - Priorities and targets to change quickly

 - Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

 - A high level of personal ownership and accountability

 - Close collaboration across teams and functions

 - Frequent, high-touch communication

 - Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

 - A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 




LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

 - Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

 - Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

 - Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.





JOIN OUR MISSION

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. 





PRIVACY POLICY AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy https://www.trmlabs.com/policies/privacy-policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Revenue Operations Manager at GitLab, you'll own work the whole go-to-market organization relies on: the policies and processes that govern how we sell and book deals, our global forecasting process, and the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) operating cadence. You'll report to the Senior Manager, Sales Operations, and work closely with sales leadership, other Revenue Strategy & Operations teams, Finance, Deal Desk, Product, and Data.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll bring experience running a forecast process day to day and a practical understanding of how a sales organization works. You'll work independently to take a problem from "something looks off in the numbers" to a fix that sticks.

GitLab is all-remote, and most of our work happens in writing. Clear, concise documentation is a big part of this job.

What you’ll do

• Own the policies that define how deals are booked, credited, and forecasted, including bookings rules, opportunity netting, and sales stages and exit criteria. Write them, get them approved, and make sure the field understands what changed and why.

• Identify process problems before they affect the numbers. Validate and size the problem with data, find the root cause, and drive the fix with the right team, whether that's Revenue Systems, Deal Desk, Enablement, or compensation.

• Partner with Revenue Systems to build policy into system rules, validations, and alerts, reducing manual reviews and after-the-fact corrections.

• Improve forecast methodology by tracking actual results against the forecast, explaining variances, and changing processes that aren't working. Partner with Finance and Revenue Analytics to reconcile the field forecast with the finance outlook.

• Own the weekly forecast readout for the CRO and sales leadership, keeping it short and focused on decisions. Bring the forecasting and policy perspective into annual planning.

• Coordinate the CRO organization's weekly, monthly, and quarterly reviews, metrics, and follow-ups. Measure their impact on pipeline hygiene, data quality, forecast accuracy, and bookings, and change the cadence where it isn't working.

• Work with other Revenue Strategy & Operations teams, Finance, Product, Data, and Enablement to deliver changes from the first draft through field adoption. Keep cadence documentation current so the organization knows what happens when, who owns it, and what's expected.

• Mentor others on the team and improve how we document and run our processes.

What you’ll bring

• Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, management consulting, or a similar role, including running a forecast process day to day in a business-to-business (B2B) subscription business.

• A practical understanding of how a sales organization runs, including pipeline stages, deal bookings and crediting, bookings and annual recurring revenue (ARR) definitions, and how compensation influences sales representative behavior.

• Strong data and analysis skills. You're highly proficient in Excel or Google Sheets, can build a model from scratch, and check your own numbers before sharing them.

• The ability to work independently, identify what needs to be done, and work with stakeholders to get it done. You involve your manager when you need a decision or hit a blocker.

• Clear, concise writing. You can turn a complex issue into a short document or Slack message that a senior leader will read and act on.

• Comfort working with senior leaders, including taking feedback from a CRO and turning it into a better process or a more useful readout.

• Systems thinking and the ability to learn new tools and domains quickly. You understand how customer relationship management (CRM), quoting, billing, and compensation systems connect, and how a change in one affects the others. How you think matters more to us than which forecasting tool you've used.

• Helpful, but not required: experience rolling out bookings, crediting, or deal policies; forecasting consumption or usage-based revenue; using tools such as Clari and Salesforce reporting; or a consulting, strategy, or structured problem-solving background.

About the team

The Sales Strategy & Operations team sits within Revenue Strategy & Operations at GitLab. We're a small team working closely with Finance, Deal Desk, Revenue Systems, Revenue Analytics, and sales leadership. We work asynchronously first, keep our documents short, and focus on practical solutions that make the field's job easier.
