jobs.title: Senior Power Electronics Control Engineer
jobs.location: Reno, Nevada, United States; San Francisco, California, United States; Sunnyvale, California, United States
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.

We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.

And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Amperesand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.

We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.

Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy, dramatically smaller and more efficient, and capable of supporting modern, dynamic energy needs for tomorrow’s most demanding energy consumers.

Scalable in-house advanced manufacturing capability is our foundation for meeting timeline and quality expectation to serve infrastructure customers around the world.

Amperesand is led by breakthrough energy hardware development veterans and funded by top tier investors who share our vision of building a category-defining energy technology company.

With hubs in San Francisco, Reno, and Singapore, our global team is laser focused on building foundational technology to solve the most pressing problems in power infrastructure at scale.

Join us in building the power foundation of the future!

Role Summary

As our Senior Power Electronics Control Engineer you will focus on control and system behavior of advanced power converters, including AC-DC and DC-DC topologies, used across low-voltage and medium-voltage power conversion systems. The role emphasizes multilevel power converter architectures and resonant power conversions used in solid-state transformers (SST). You will work hands-on across control design, modeling, analysis, laboratory debugging, and validation, and collaborate closely with hardware, firmware, and system engineers to bring robust power electronics solutions from concept through validation.

Responsibilities:

• Design and implement digital control algorithms for advanced AC-DC and DC-DC power converters across low- and medium-voltage applications.

• Develop small-signal and large-signal models to support stability analysis, loop compensation, and transient optimization.

• Support development of control strategies for advanced power conversion stages, including multilevel or resonant topologies and AC-DC / DC-DC stage interactions.

• Implement real-time control algorithms on DSP/MCU/SoC platforms.

• Lead hands-on debugging and root-cause analysis across simulation, firmware integration, hardware bring-up, and lab testing.

• Collaborate with hardware and firmware teams to optimize sensing, protection, and control-loop performance.

• Support validation activities including loop stability measurement, transient response testing, and fault handling verification.

• Own complex control subsystems and contribute to system-level design under technical leadership.

Qualifications:

• Technical degree or equivalent industry experience in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field, with a strong focus on power electronics and control systems.

• 3+ years of experience designing and deploying digital control for power converters, with demonstrated ability to own and execute complex technical tasks.

• Strong understanding of resonant power conversion principles and their control implications across isolated and non-isolated power converter architectures.

• Solid foundation in control theory, including loop compensation, stability margins, frequency-domain and time-domain analysis, and nonlinear system behavior.

• Proven experience implementing real-time control algorithms on embedded platforms.

• Hands-on laboratory experience debugging power converters.

• Ability to translate theoretical control concepts into practical, robust implementations.

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to work through technically ambiguous challenges.

• Familiarity with modeling and simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink and PLECS.

• Proficiency in embedded C for real-time control implementation and debugging.

Bonus Qualifications:

• Exposure to medium-voltage power electronics systems.

• Exposure to bidirectional power conversion and power flow control.

• Experience supporting products from R&D through validation and deployment.

Please note: This role requires working on-site 5 days a week. We do not offer hybrid or remote options.

Onsite Collaboration Rationale:

Given the highly collaborative and cross-functional nature of hardware, embedded systems, and product development, in-person partnership across engineering and product teams is critical to enabling rapid execution, technical alignment, and successful development outcomes.

Why Join Amperesand

• Work on next-generation power infrastructure systems

• High ownership and visibility

• Cross-functional collaboration

• Opportunity to shape future products and infrastructure

• Fast-moving startup environment

SF Pay Range

$170,000—$200,000 USD

Reno Pay Range

$150,000—$180,000 USD

Candidate Confidentiality & Information Protection

As part of our commitment to protecting confidential and proprietary information, candidates should not disclose or provide Amperesand with any confidential, proprietary, or trade secret information belonging to a current or former employer or any other third party during the application or interview process.

Please do not submit or present employer-owned source code, schematics, designs, technical documentation, internal presentations, customer information, prototypes, or other confidential materials. Candidates should discuss their experience and accomplishments at an appropriate level and use only information and materials they are authorized to share.

Pay Disclosure & Benefits

Compensation will be determined based on experience, location, and other factors permitted by law.

The benefits outlined below apply exclusively to employees located in the United States.

• Competitive Salary + Incentive Stock Options

• Medical, vision, and dental benefits for employees and their dependents, effective from the start of hire

• Company paid Basic Life, AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance

• 401k retirement savings plan through Empower

• Employees receive paid time off (PTO), paid sick days, and paid company holidays

• Commuter Benefits

• 100% paid maternal leave (12 weeks) and paternal leave (6 weeks)

Singapore-based employees receive benefits in accordance with local government provisions.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Amperesand is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Amperesand is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

jobs.title: Director, Supply Planning
jobs.description:
BUILT ON FLAVOR.  FUELED BY PEOPLE.

What’s it like to work at Kinder’s? Well, there’s a lot of snacking and geeking out over what we all cooked over the weekend. Beyond that, there’s also plenty of hard work. Because we don’t just like flavor, we’re obsessed with it.

With over 100 products sold nationwide, we’re now a top-five brand in multiple flavor categories at Costco, Walmart, Whole Foods, and more. We’re not your typical CPG company. Privately held and founder-led, we like to think of ourselves as a pirate ship in a sea of cruise ships. Our crew is adventurous and fearless. We chart our own course and chase big ideas to make food unforgettable.

As we expand globally and approach $1 billion in revenue, we need more smart-and-scrappy, flavor-obsessed people to come aboard. If you’re looking for a place where you can see the real impact of your work... this is it! Every day, you’ll be part of a journey to add flavor to millions of meals and lives.

About The Role

As the Director of Supply Planning, you will oversee supply chain functions, including inventory management, production planning, and cost-effective deployment to distribution centers to improve customer fill rates. You will lead efforts to enhance cross-functional collaboration, drive efficiencies, and foster a seamless connection between S&OE and IBP processes. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, such as sales, finance, and operations, as well as external partners, ensuring that supply chain strategies support the overall business goals and growth objectives while embodying Kinder's values.

Key Responsibilities

Culture, Leadership & Strategy:

• Champion a "Fail Forward" mindset that encourages learning from setbacks and fosters a culture of continuous improvement, in line with Kinder's values of Humility and Curiosity

• Develop and execute the supply chain strategy aligned with the company's fast-growth trajectory, ensuring scalability and flexibility while promoting a Builder Mindset that balances long-term vision with immediate needs.

• Lead a high-performing supply chain team, fostering an environment of Collaboration, accountability, and continuous growth. Encourage diverse perspectives and build solutions collectively to achieve the best outcomes.

• Promote a servant leadership approach, leading by example and valuing team contributions in decision-making.

• Collaborate with C-suite executives and cross-functional leaders to integrate supply chain initiatives into the broader business strategy.

• Drive the integration of S&OE (Sales & Operations Execution) and IBP (Integrated Business Planning) to create a unified, end-to-end planning process.

• Facilitate ongoing communication and alignment between supply chain, sales, finance, commercialization, and operations teams, ensuring a cohesive, data-driven approach to planning and inventory optimization.

• Champion the use of advanced planning technologies and tools to improve customer fill rates, speed to market for innovation, renovation, and migration projects, and enhance decision-making.

Operational Excellence:

• Collaborate deeply with procurement, production, inventory management, and distribution teams, fostering an environment of shared ownership and mutual respect that reflects our commitment to Humility and Collaboration

• Monitor supply chain KPIs and inventory metrics to track performance, identify risks, and implement corrective actions where needed, driving a culture of continuous improvement.

• Lead initiatives to optimize processes, reduce costs, and improve service levels while encouraging a mindset that sees obstacles as creative opportunities for Innovation

S&OE and IBP Bridging:

• Create and maintain a robust, integrated planning process that supports both tactical day-to-day execution (S&OE) and long-term strategic planning (IBP).

• Develop supply chain models that bridge short-term operational decisions with the long-term business plan, balancing agility with strategic foresight.

• Set ambitious goals to align demand forecasts with supply chain capacity, ensuring the ability to support rapid growth while continuously pursuing excellence and minimizing disruptions.

Master Data and Off Shelf Secondary Units:

• Own the management of supply chain master data, including SKU and contract manufacturing attributes, in partnership with Finance, Contract Manufacturing, and Supply Chain leadership.

• Develop strategies for optimizing retail fulfillment of secondary placements, such as PDQs (Pre-Distributed Quantities), DRUs (Display Ready Units), and pallet programs.

• Drive rapid response on these programs by implementing Make-To-Order (MTO) and Make-To-Stock (MTS) approaches for work-in-progress (WIP) items to ensure efficient supply chain responsiveness.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with contract manufacturers and suppliers, ensuring reliable sourcing of materials and services at the best quality and cost.

• Monitor supplier performance, implement contingency plans to manage risk, and uphold Integrity by prioritizing long-term success over short-term gains.

• Collaborate with warehouse and logistics partners to ensure improved customer satisfaction through efficient inventory deployment.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

• Lead cross-functional meetings, including weekly S&OE and monthly S&OP reviews, to align performance, develop consensus plans, and drive action plans for continuous improvement.

• Foster an inclusive atmosphere where cross-functional teams are empowered to contribute, building solutions collaboratively rather than operating in silos.

• Actively seek out and implement innovative solutions, continually resetting the standard for supply chain efficiency while embodying Kinder's relentless drive for Results and passion for Innovation

• Encourage a culture where asking the right questions is as valued as having the right answers, demonstrating a commitment to Curiosity

• Drive the adoption of advanced analytics, AI, and automation tools to optimize inventory management, production planning, and decision-making.

• Proactively identify and mitigate risks within the supply chain, ensuring business continuity through planning and contingency strategies that prioritize long-term success over short-term gains.

• Implement strategies to navigate supply chain disruptions, including demand volatility, supplier shortages, and logistics challenges, always striving to do what is right for the business, customers, and partners.

What You Bring to the Table

• Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, business, operations, or a related field (MBA preferred).

• 10+ years of progressive experience in supply chain management, with a strong focus on collaborative planning, S&OE, and IBP.

• Proven experience in managing supply chains within fast-growing companies or dynamic environments.

• Strong leadership and team-building skills, with the ability to inspire and drive cross-functional collaboration.

• Expertise in supply chain planning software (e.g., Blue Yonder, SAP IBP, Kinaxis) and data analytics tools.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization.

• Demonstrated ability to lead and manage change in a rapidly evolving environment.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of driving continuous improvement.

Location and Travel

The position will be based out of our office in Walnut Creek, CA. We strongly believe in the power of culture and community and have a hybrid work structure with 4 days in the office on a weekly basis to encourage collaboration and personal connections that will allow us to better serve our customers and consumer and to have more fun. Fridays are flex days with employees having the opportunity to choose to be either in the office or to work from home based on what makes most sense for them.

Pay Transparency

The expected starting salary range for this role is $215,000- $240,000 per year. The salary range posted for this role reflects the good-faith base pay range Kinder’s reasonably expects to offer at the time of posting and may vary based on the location of the role. Individual compensation within the posted range will be determined based on factors such as relevant education, experience, qualifications, skills, and business needs.

SEASONED FOR SUCCESS:

• No two days here are the same.

• We try to be good team members and good communicators, but we don’t live by hierarchy and structure – everyone is a difference maker here.

• We make a lot of decisions in the face of incomplete information – our team embraces ambiguity and tries to make good decisions fast rather than great decisions slow.

• We believe our job is to take smart risk, not to eliminate risk.

• We believe in growing our skills and becoming a better company with more managerial expertise, but we are an entrepreneurial company at heart.

• We aren’t trying to be average – we want to do exceptional things, and we are willing to work hard to achieve them.

BENEFITS THAT BRING MORE TO THE TABLE:

We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, 401k, bonus / incentive eligibility, equity grants, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits, including parental leave. Kinder’s benefits vary based on eligibility and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.

OUR RECIPE FOR BALANCE:

We believe great culture starts with people. We’re a people-first company built on connection, collaboration, and balance. Most of our work happens in the office to spark creativity and community, but we also offer flexibility so team members have the autonomy to work outside the office when needed to support their work-life balance and personal commitments.

WHERE EVERY INGREDIENT MATTERS:

Kinder's is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, citizenship, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, veteran status, as well as any other legally-protected characteristic. If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar law, and you need any accommodation during the application process or to perform these job requirements, please reach out to us at careers@kinders.com

jobs.title: Senior Director of Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

Every year, millions of people start the search for a home online. Where they land, who they trust, and which agent they call shapes one of the biggest decisions of their lives. We're looking for the person who makes sure that search leads to Compass.

Compass International Holdings Overview

Compass International Holdings is a global real estate services company empowering real estate professionals with everything they need to realize their entrepreneurial potential. With a presence in every major U.S. city and approximately 120 countries and territories, Compass International Holdings serves millions of buyers and sellers through a portfolio of some of the most recognized and iconic brands: @properties, Better Homes and Gardens® Real Estate, CENTURY 21®, Christie's International Real Estate, Coldwell Banker®, Compass, Corcoran®, ERA®, and Sotheby's International Realty®. In addition to brokerage services, Compass International Holdings offers integrated services, such as mortgage, title, insurance, escrow, and relocation.

• NYSE: COMP

• 340,000 Real Estate Professionals

• 2,000+ independently owned and operated brokerages

• 120 countries and territories

Why Now

Compass International Holdings is moving fast:

• A new consumer experience. We just launched See It First™, the biggest Compass.com redesign in a decade, giving buyers early access to more homes.

• Marketing. Our 3-phased marketing strategy gives sellers more choice in how to market their homes. The market has responded with 56% YoY traffic growth on compass.com.

• Global reach. The new Compass Global Division connects U.S. clients with vetted international advisors.

• Record results. We posted record Q2 2026 results.

The platform is bigger, the product is sharper, and the opportunity to win the consumer has never been larger.

Role Overview

This is a rare seat: a senior, highly strategic individual contributor role with direct influence on how one of the largest real estate platforms in the world grows.

As Head of Performance Marketing, you'll own the strategy and the execution behind how consumers find Compass. You'll set the vision, own the numbers, influence the product, and remain hands-on in the campaigns yourself. You'll work alongside senior leadership as a trusted growth advisor, and your recommendations will shape where we invest and how fast we move.

You'll also be in on the ground floor. As performance marketing scales across our brands, you'll help define what the function looks like, how it measures success, and who joins it next. This is your chance to build something inside real estate, not just inherit it.

What You'll Do

• Set the strategy and run it. Build the performance marketing plan for Compass.com and drive execution across paid search, paid social, display, video, and emerging acquisition channels. You'll be both the architect and the operator.

• Connect every dollar to outcomes that matter. Tie media performance to transaction conversion, agent lead quality, and unit economics, not just clicks and impressions. In real estate, the lead that becomes a closed home is the only metric that counts.

• Build a measurement practice that leadership trusts. Bring rigor through media mix modeling, incrementality testing, multi-touch attribution, and automated bidding to continuously improve CAC and LTV efficiency.

• Own and scale a major media budget. Manage a significant paid media portfolio in one of the most competitive search categories online. Reallocate quickly and confidently based on the data.

• Be the voice of growth in the room. Present priorities, results, and investment recommendations to the executive team and cross-functional partners across product, brand, and technology.

• Shape the future of the function. Help define the operating model, tooling, and talent strategy for performance marketing as it grows across CIH's brands.

Who You Are

• Built at a marketplace. You have 10+ years in marketing, ideally including 3–4+ years leading performance marketing at a top real estate or high-volume marketplace portal.

• Strategist and builder. You can design a multi-channel growth strategy in the morning and be deep in campaign structure and bidding logic by afternoon. You'd rather own the work than delegate it.

• Executive-ready. You're comfortable with the C-suite. You bring a point of view, back it with data, and influence decisions.

• Measurement-obsessed. You have deep, practical experience with media mix modeling, incrementality testing, attribution, and paid acquisition channels.

• Energized by the mission. Helping people find their place in the world, and helping 340,000 agents grow their businesses, is something you care about.

• Technical Expertise: Deep experience in media mix modeling, incrementality testing, paid acquisition channels, and attribution models.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you've gone deep on the business. You understand how Compass.com acquires consumers today, where spend is working and where it isn't, and how leads move from first click to closed transaction. You've built trusted relationships with leadership and key partners across product, brand, data, and technology, and you've delivered an early point of view on the biggest opportunities.

By six months, your performance marketing strategy is in the market. You've established a measurement framework the executive team relies on, launched your first incrementality tests, and made confident budget shifts based on what the data shows. Leadership comes to you for the answer to "what's driving growth?"

At 12 months, you've measurably improved acquisition efficiency and lead quality, and paid media is clearly connected to transactions and agent outcomes, not just traffic. You've built a testing culture that keeps the program getting smarter. You've shaped the roadmap for how performance marketing scales across CIH's brands, including the tools, operating model, and talent the function needs next. And you're seen as one of the most important growth voices in the company.

Compensation:

The base pay range for this position is $185,000 - $205,000 annually; however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Bonuses and restricted stock units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location. Minimum wage for the position will always be met

Perks that You Need to Know About:

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

Do your best work, be your authentic self.

At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive.  Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer competitive compensation packages, robust benefits and professional growth opportunities aimed at helping to improve our employees' lives and careers.

jobs.title: Group Account Manager
jobs.description:
GROUP ACCOUNT MANAGER

Remote — United States | Full-Time


ABOUT FREED

Doctors are overworked, burnt out, and leaving the profession at alarming rates.

At Freed, we combine clinician love with the latest AI technology and intense execution to create products that make clinicians happier.

Our first product is an AI scribe that automates medical documentation.

Since May 2023, we have:

 - Acquired over 28,000 paying clinicians who love our product.

 - Generated over 70,000 patient notes daily and more than 2 million monthly.

 - ⁠Made thousands of clinicians happier https://love.getfreed.ai/b2xGQ1.

With the backing of Sequoia Capital and other world-class investors, we’re rapidly expanding our product offerings. Patient-facing assistants, patient insights, EHR integrations, and other products are being built and used by thousands of clinicians every day.

We’re looking for entrepreneurs: fast, ambitious, and smart individuals who want to take care of the people who care for our health. Expect intense, clinician-focused, and interesting coworkers who want to win.

Freed is headquartered in San Francisco, with team members working remotely and in person across the United States. This position is remote, with close collaboration across teams and time zones.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Group Account Manager at Freed, you’ll be responsible for managing, retaining, and expanding our growing portfolio of B2B healthcare customers.

You’ll primarily support small medical practices and micro-clinics, typically consisting of 2–5 providers, with the potential to manage a portfolio of hundreds of accounts as our business scales.

This is a high-volume account management role that combines customer relationship management, operational efficiency, and commercial ownership.

You’ll oversee the customer journey from onboarding and adoption through renewals and expansion, ensuring that clinicians receive exceptional value from Freed’s products.

Success requires balancing proactive customer engagement with scalable processes, identifying accounts that need attention, and uncovering opportunities to expand product adoption.

We’re looking for someone who can operate independently, bring established account management best practices, and thrive in a fast-moving environment where processes are continually evolving.

Above all, your responsibility is to help Freed deliver on our promise: to be the most clinician-friendly company in the world.


HOW YOU’LL HAVE IMPACT

 - Own a high-volume portfolio: Manage relationships across a large portfolio of SMB healthcare customers, prioritizing engagement based on customer needs, account health, and growth opportunities.

 - Drive retention and renewals: Proactively identify at-risk accounts, address customer concerns, and implement strategies that improve customer satisfaction and retention.

 - Identify expansion opportunities: Analyze product usage, customer needs, and account potential to uncover and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

 - Improve customer adoption: Partner with customers to ensure successful onboarding, training, and continued product utilization.

 - Build scalable processes: Apply proven account management strategies to streamline workflows, improve customer engagement, and support portfolio growth.

 - Use data to prioritize: Leverage CRM systems, customer health indicators, and usage insights to identify trends and determine where your efforts will have the greatest impact.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Support teams to resolve challenges and improve the customer experience.

 - Own customer outcomes: Take initiative, solve problems independently, and ensure customers feel supported throughout their relationship with Freed.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 5–8 years of relevant experience in account management, customer success, or a related customer-facing role, preferably within B2B SaaS.

 - Demonstrated success managing a high-volume portfolio of SMB or small-to-medium business accounts.

 - A proven track record of improving customer retention, driving renewals, and identifying expansion opportunities.

 - Experience developing or improving scalable account management processes and customer engagement strategies.

 - Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret customer data, prioritize accounts, and identify actionable opportunities.

 - Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, including the ability to navigate challenging customer conversations.

 - Comfort operating independently in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with evolving processes.

 - A strong sense of ownership, accountability, adaptability, and commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.


NICE TO HAVES

 - Previous experience at an early-stage or high-growth technology company.

 - Experience working with healthcare providers, medical practices, or healthcare technology products.

 - Familiarity with AI-powered tools and products.

 - Experience with CRM and productivity platforms such as HubSpot, Gong, Slack, Google Workspace, or similar tools.

 - Experience working effectively with distributed teams in highly collaborative, asynchronous environments.


WHAT WE WILL BRING

 - Competitive compensation and equity in a high-growth company.

 - The opportunity to make an immediate impact on a rapidly growing product that improves clinicians’ lives.

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for eligible U.S.-based employees.

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - A 401(k) plan to support your long-term financial goals.

 - A collaborative, ambitious team committed to making healthcare better.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Clinical Data Management
jobs.description:
Each of us cares about someone who will need medicines. That’s why our vision is to repeatedly beat the odds to deliver breakthrough medicines to patients who need them. We pursue truth and scientific rigour and have the courage to work at the edge of the unknown.

We’re looking for an experienced Clinical Data Management leader to join us as Senior Director, Clinical Data Management. Reporting to the VP of Biometrics, you’ll define and execute our global clinical data management strategy, build and grow a high-performing team, and safeguard data integrity across every phase of clinical development. As both a strategic and hands-on operational leader, you’ll drive data quality, standardize processes, and keep us inspection-ready at all times. If you’re energized by building something from the ground up and want your work to directly shape the quality of our clinical programs, we’d love to hear from you.

How you might spend your days

• Building and scaling a high-performing Clinical Data Management team; driving team performance, resource allocation, and talent development to support a rapidly growing pipeline of early and late stage programs in women’s health, oncology, and endocrinology

• Actively planning and managing full-lifecycle clinical data quality and integrity across all trials (including eCRF builds, edit checks, external data integrations, reconciliations, data cleaning, database locks, and submission readiness)

• Driving strict compliance with global regulatory standards and internal SOPs while supporting regulatory audits and maintaining inspection readiness

• Cultivating strong cross-functional partnerships with Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Quality, and Biostatistics, and representing Clinical Data Management in key cross-functional forums and enterprise initiatives

• Leading the selection, oversight, and performance management of CROs and specialty vendors, establishing governance, performance metrics, and communication processes to ensure high-quality execution and accountability

• Managing vendor budgets and identifying cost-effective solutions without compromising quality or compliance

• Serving as the primary escalation point for clinical data management issues affecting study quality, timelines, or regulatory readiness

We’d love to hear from you if

• You have an advanced degree (Master’s) in Life Sciences, Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field with at least 10 years of industry experience and at least 5 years as a people manager

• You have expertise in building and leading clinical data management teams, including experience in resourcing global registrational studies

• You have deep experience leading end-to-end data management for clinical trials, including database design/build/UAT (User Acceptance Training), edit checks/validation, review/reconciliation, database lock, and the design, validation, and maintenance of DM (Data Management) deliverables using relevant Clinical Data Manager platforms and enabling technologies

• You have a deep understanding of data structures and integrations across EDC (Electronic Data Capture) and connected systems (e.g., labs, IRT [Interactive Response Technology], eCOA [electronic Clinical Outcome Assessment], imaging), with a demonstrated ability to triage and resolve complex study-level issues to maintain data integrity across internal systems and service providers

• You have a comprehensive knowledge of the clinical development lifecycle, data flow, and cross-functional dependencies (Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Safety, Data Standards, Regulatory), supported by a deep understanding of clinical practice and medical terminology

• You have an advanced proficiency in CDISC (Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium) standards (CDASH [Clinical Data Acquisition Standards Harmonization], SDTM [Study Data Tabulation Model], Define-XML), metadata management, and controlled terminologies (e.g., LOINC [Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes]) to ensure consistency and submission readiness

• You have a working knowledge of SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), ICH-GCP (International Council for Harmonization – Good Clinical Practice), 21 CFR Part 11/Annex 11, and privacy expectations, applying risk-based, data-driven approaches (RBQM [Risk Based Quality Management]) to prevent or mitigate issues

• You have a desire to contribute to a culture that reflects AbCellera’s values by acting with integrity, accountability, and a team-first mentality

What we offer

In addition to a competitive base salary, we offer equity, an annual bonus dependent on individual and company performance, and a 6% 401K contribution.

You will have a USD $1,500 annual Active Lifestyle Allowance, annual vacation, professional development opportunities, and comprehensive health benefits. And you’ll find a strong sense of community and connections across AbCellera through our work.

About AbCellera

Creating medicines is the most important work we can do.

We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on discovering and developing antibody-based medicines in the areas of endocrinology, women’s health, immunology, and oncology. We have built a platform for advancing antibody drug programs from target to clinic, and we are using it to build our internal pipeline.

Today, our pipeline includes two drug candidates in clinical development, two preclinical development candidates (DCs) in Investigational New Drug (IND)-enabling activities, and more than 20 active discovery programs across multiple modalities and indications.

We believe that when tenacious people share a vision and work together, they can truly have a positive impact. That’s why we hire for character and intelligence, not just for CVs or experience.

We look for people with drive and energy. People we trust. People who need to know their days are being well spent. That their work really matters. In the end, our success will be measured by the impact of our medicines.

To apply

Please submit your application through our website and refer to Job ID 23418 in your cover letter. We receive a large volume of applications and are only able to contact those who are selected for an interview. All communication from our Talent Discovery team will come from an @abcellera.com email address.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for a Staff Technical Product Manager to own the roadmap for Oura's Business Technology Services (BTS) and Workato platform — the shared integration and automation infrastructure connecting our ERP, financial, commercial, and customer systems, feeding our Databricks data lakehouse and data mesh, and increasingly serving the AI agents that act on top of all of it. You'll partner directly with Business Technology directors and their stakeholders to turn underspecified platform demand into a single, clear, prioritized roadmap spanning both BTS and Workato. You'll bring real technical depth — enough to own the platform's API contracts, versioning, and integration-pattern decisions (Workato versus custom AWS-native build, sync versus event-driven) yourself — while partnering with Enterprise Architecture and the team's Staff Integration Engineer on deep systems design.

What You Will Do:

• Own and continuously prioritize the BTS platform roadmap across Business Technology domains, converting underspecified business asks into a clear, sequenced backlog that unlocks scale, international expansion, and NetSuite decoupling

• Align demand intake across BTS and Workato queues into a single structured, prioritized process, giving the team and its stakeholders one holistic view of integration/automation roadmap, planning, and priorities instead of disconnected backlogs

• Partner directly with Business Technology directors and stakeholders (Finance, Supply Chain, Member Experience, Commercial, Corporate) to elicit and structure platform demand, replacing ad hoc requests with a transparent intake and prioritization process

• Own the platform's API contracts, versioning, and integration-pattern decisions (Workato vs. custom build, sync vs. event-driven, batch vs. real-time) — technical enough to make and defend these calls yourself, partnering with Enterprise Architecture and the Staff Integration Engineer on deep infrastructure and systems design

• Build and defend the platform's narrative for executive and cross-functional audiences, translating technical trade-offs into what a given investment unlocks and what it costs

• Partner with Enterprise Architecture on platform-vs-domain scope calls, including how BTS integration flows feed the Databricks data lakehouse and support the broader data mesh

• Review and recommend the approach to requirements for MCP servers and AI agents supporting the BTS ecosystem, in partnership with AI Productivity

• Contribute to standing up the Integration & Automation Engineering team, partnering with the Director on team structure, hiring, and the transition from contractor-led to FTE-led delivery

This is a remote role based in the US.

What you'll bring

• 10+ years of technical product or platform management experience, including significant time owning infrastructure, integration, or API platforms rather than customer-facing features

• A strong technical background — comfortable writing or critiquing a spec (OpenAPI, event schema, contract) and defending a build-vs-buy or versioning call, while partnering with Enterprise Architecture on deep systems design

• Working knowledge of the core AWS services an integration platform is built on (API Gateway, Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS/SNS) — enough to make informed build-vs-buy and design calls and speak the same language as the engineers building on them, without needing to provision or maintain the infrastructure yourself

• Direct experience with iPaaS/integration platforms (Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, or similar) and with API design, versioning, and contract management

• A track record of working directly with business and operations stakeholders to turn vague or informally-articulated requests into clear, buildable requirements

• A track record of owning a platform roadmap that serves multiple internal consuming teams, including running intake and prioritization across competing demand and disparate backlogs

• Comfort negotiating sequencing and trade-offs directly with senior (Director and above) stakeholders who each believe their need is the priority

• Excellent written and verbal communication, with a demonstrated ability to translate technical trade-offs into business terms for executive audiences

• Demonstrated use of LLM assistants and agentic build tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable) in daily work — research, drafting, analysis, prototyping, and problem-solving — with sound judgment about when AI is and isn't the right tool, and a habit of verifying output

Nice to have:

• It's a plus if you also have:

• Experience standing up or governing an AI control plane, MCP gateway, or agent observability/policy layer

• Experience with ERP integration or decoupling (NetSuite or similar) in a growth-stage company

• Familiarity with data lakehouse or data mesh architectures (e.g., Databricks) and how upstream integration design affects downstream analytics and data products

jobs.description:
Knock is redefining the home buying and selling experience, and we’re only getting started! We’re a passionate team of industry experts who knew there had to be a better, simpler way for people to navigate the journey between homes. That people-first mindset is core to how we operate, and why Knock has been honored as one of Inc.’s Best Workplaces six times in the past seven years.

We bring that mindset into the work we do every day.  The Knock Bridge Loan™ empowers homebuyers to ‘buy before they sell’, by unlocking the equity in their current home, giving them greater convenience, certainty, and competitiveness.

Founded in 2015, Knock has grown into a trusted partner for thousands of homebuyers and a network of 60,000+ loan officers and agents across the country. Backed by top investors like Foundry Group, Trinity Capital, and the National Association of Realtors, we’ve built a reputation for innovation and trust, earning 900+ five-star Zillow and Trustpilot reviews and an A+ BBB rating.

Join our growing team and help shape the future of homebuying! To learn more, visit Knock.com

Closer/Funder

At Knock, we believe buying your next home should be exciting — not stressful. That’s why we created the Knock Bridge Loan™, giving homeowners the power to unlock the equity in their current home so they can buy before they sell. And now, we’re looking for a Closer/Funder to help bring those transactions across the finish line.

If you love working at a fast pace, thrive on details, and get satisfaction from delivering a flawless customer experience — we want to meet you!

💥 Why This Role Matters

The Closing Team is the final, crucial stop in our customers' journey — and you’ll be the person making sure their dream of a new home becomes reality. You’ll be the calm in the chaos, the detail-obsessed expert, and the friendly guide that keeps everything (and everyone) on track.

What You’ll Be Doing

✅ Prepare and send accurate Initial Closing Disclosures (ICDs) to borrowers — first impressions matter!

✅ Ensure everything complies with federal, state, and program guidelines.
✅ Partner with Loan Officers, Bridge Loan Specialists, Loan Assistants, and settlement teams to keep deals moving.
✅ Audit signed closing packages to guarantee accuracy before funds are released.
✅ Own your pipeline — manage 50–60 loans per month with precision and care.
✅ Be a mentor, collaborator, and knowledge-sharer — we grow together.
✅ Jump into special projects or support your team whenever needed — we’ve got each other’s backs.

What Makes You a Great Fit

✔ 3+ years of recent experience closing residential loans (cash-out refinance expertise = a huge plus!)
✔ You thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment — juggling 50–60 closings per month? You’ve got this.
✔ Details are your love language — you triple-check your work.
✔ You live for creating a “wow” experience for customers.
✔ You’re a proactive communicator — people never have to guess where things stand.
✔ You’re organized, self-motivated, and love working independently.
✔ Tech doesn’t intimidate you — you know your way around a LOS and other lending systems. We are use Meridian Link
✔ You’ve worked remotely before and can stay connected in a distributed team. *Note: this position is 100% remote but the job boards require us to list a location so we pick one but you are not required to live there.*
✔ You’re aligned with Knock’s values — people-first, open, courageous, and driven to make an impact.

⭐ Experience with additional lending platforms or tools.
⭐ A passion for mentoring and sharing your expertise.
⭐ Extra certifications or training in mortgage or compliance.

• High school diploma or equivalent required. (Higher education may be preferred based on candidate experience.)

🌍 Remote-first: Work from anywhere — stay connected with a supportive, nationwide team.
🚀 Startup energy: Fast-paced, high-growth, make-an-impact kind of vibe.

jobs.description:
Senior Counsel

Location: Santa Clara, CA

Job Term: Full-Time

Job Description:

Picarro seeks an experienced business attorney to support its growth initiatives worldwide.  The position will report to the General Counsel and have career growth potential.  The position will be responsible for drafting and negotiating a variety of commercial agreements.  The successful candidate will also have a broad business law background and be capable of counseling clients on business planning and compliance questions in diverse technology and legal subject matter areas.

About Picarro:

Responsibilities:

• Draft and negotiate diverse commercial contracts with sophisticated customers and business partners.

• Provide strategic legal advice for business development initiatives and new business opportunities.

• Contribute practical advice and leadership in support of contract review processes, workflow management, and continuous improvement of contract administration.

• Actively support the Company’s business presence worldwide, including the establishment, governance, and support of global subsidiary companies.

• Advise the Company in diverse compliance areas, including employment law, trade compliance, and privacy.

Required Skills and Experience:

• J.D. from an ABA-accredited law school and current bar membership in California is required.

• At least 6 years of relevant legal practice experience.

• Proven, hands-on experience in drafting and negotiating a wide variety of commercial contracts.

• Strong practical knowledge of business law applicable to technology companies (e.g., data privacy, employment, intellectual property, etc.).

• Strong moral compass and understanding of business and professional ethics.

• Excellent judgement and analytical skills, with the ability to think strategically and balance business needs with legal risks.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate legal requirements to non-legal audiences.

• Excellent organizational, planning, and management skills, with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.

• Ability to work collaboratively on cross-functional teams.

• Ability to work under time pressure while maintaining a good sense of humor.

• Ability to work onsite at our Santa Clara location.

Salary & Benefits:

The base salary range for this full-time position is $200K to $235K. Our total compensation packages includes base salary, bonus eligibility, and equity. Your base salary range and title will be determined based on the location, experience, qualification, skills, knowledge, level, and pay of employees in similar positions.

We offer a comprehensive benefit package including:

• Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) plans

• Life, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability Insurance

• Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

• Employee Referral Program

• 401K

• Social events (summer picnic, holiday party, team lunches, etc.)

• On-site Health & Wellness programs (fitness challenges, outdoor bootcamp, flu-shots, etc.)

About Picarro:

We are the world's leader in timely, trusted, and actionable data using enhanced optical spectroscopy. Our solutions are used in a wide variety of applications, including natural gas leak detection, ethylene oxide emissions monitoring, semiconductor fabrication, pharmaceutical, petrochemical, atmospheric science, air quality, greenhouse gas measurements, food safety, hydrology, ecology, and more. Our software and hardware are designed and manufactured in Santa Clara, California and are used in over 90 countries worldwide based on over 65 patents related to cavity ring-down spectroscopy (CRDS) technology and are unparalleled in their precision, ease of use, and reliability.

At Picarro, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, gender identity, social orientation, or disability. Recognized as one of BC's Top Employers (2025), SkyBox Labs is a game development studio that works on some of the world’s most iconic games. The studio is currently working on projects in the Minecraft universe, supporting the dev team at Bungie on Destiny 2, supporting development of Fallout 76, in addition to work on unannounced IP. jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Contract Recruiter to support at Crusoe. You’ll recruit across a variety of  GTM related roles likeSales, Solutions and Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Support, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Partnerships.



This role is designed for a highly autonomous recruiter who can run complex, high-bar hiring end-to-end, manage senior stakeholders, and operate as a true talent partner. You will inherit an active, high-impact requisition load and play a critical role in enabling the recruiting team to scale by taking ownership of execution while leadership focuses on strategy, planning, and org design.



This is a six month contract with potential to extend based on business need.



What You'll Be Working On:

 - Own full-cycle recruiting for GTM roles across Sales, Sales and Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Support, Marketing, RevOps, and Partnerships, from mid-level through director

 - Partner closely with hiring managers and senior leaders as a strategic advisor, not just an executor

 - Build and maintain strong pipelines through proactive sourcing and outreach into various talent pools

 - Run intake sessions, structure interview processes, and design role-appropriate technical and customer-facing assessments

 - Screen for the blend of technical depth and customer-facing skill these roles require, and calibrate the bar with hiring managers early

 - Conduct candidate interviews, provide timely updates, and lead compensation negotiations

 - Manage a high-volume, high-complexity req load independently with minimal oversight

 - Keep pipeline data, notes, and status current in the ATS so leadership can see progress without asking



What You'll Bring to the Team:

 - 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, mostly in GTM, across several functions such as Sales, Sales/Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, or Revenue Operations

 - Track record of hiring quota-carrying and customer-facing roles, plus a good grasp of how GTM teams are structured and measured

 - Proven ability to run senior and hard-to-fill searches from start to finish with limited support

 - Strong sourcing skills, including passive candidate outreach through LinkedIn and other tools

 - Ability to assess what makes someone successful in different GTM functions, from commercial acumen to technical fluency to customer empathy

 - Experience partnering with and influencing senior stakeholders, including hiring managers at director level and above

 - Experience recruiting in fast-paced, high-growth startup environments

 - Skilled in salary and equity negotiation

 - Proven ability to consistently meet or exceed hiring goals

 - Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills

 - Highly organized, with strong attention to detail and time management

 - Data-driven: you use recruiting metrics and market trends to guide hiring strategy

 - Experience keeping detailed documentation in an ATS

Compensation will be paid in the hourly range of $70.00 - $80.00. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

jobs.title: GTM Strategy & Activation
jobs.location: Bellevue, Washington; Chicago, Illinois; San Francisco, California
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Role Summary

Okta Secures AI is Okta's product line for agent identity—securing what AI agents can access and do across the enterprise.

This role owns GTM readiness across the full customer lifecycle, from first conversation through deployment, adoption, and expansion. Pre-sales, you ensure AEs, SEs, and FDEs can position, demo, differentiate, and win. Post-sales, you ensure Professional Services, partners, TAMs, CSMs, and FDEs can deploy, drive adoption, and expand.

This is a strategy role, not a traditional enablement role. You own the customer insight, messaging, positioning, competitive intelligence, and readiness strategy. You build from what you hear in customer conversations and see in live deployments, then partner with the teams that own enablement and delivery to scale it.

AI is moving weekly. The work needs to move just as fast.

Key Responsibilities

Pre-Sales Readiness

• Messaging and positioning: Build the narrative, value proposition, proof points, and persona-specific stories sellers use in live deals.

• Competitive readiness: Develop competitive positioning, objection handling, and talk tracks as the market evolves.

• Demo readiness: Equip SEs and FDEs with the stories, scenarios, and technical depth needed to demonstrate Okta Secures AI credibly.

• Launch and pricing readiness: Ensure the field understands what's new, what's changed, and how to take it to market.

• Field signal: Partner directly with sellers and SEs to identify gaps in live deals and turn those insights into reusable solutions.

Post-Sales Readiness

• Deployment readiness: Work with FDEs and Professional Services to turn real deployment patterns into repeatable use cases, reference architectures, and playbooks.

• Partner readiness: Help SI and implementation partners deliver Okta Secures AI deployments to the same standard as Okta Professional Services.

• Adoption and expansion: Equip TAMs and CSMs with health signals, use-case expansion paths, and messaging for renewal and growth conversations.

• Customer proof: Turn deployment and adoption outcomes into customer stories, proof points, and references that strengthen both pre- and post-sales.

• Feedback loop: Bring deployment and adoption learnings back into product, roadmap, pricing, packaging, and GTM decisions.

Strategic Scope & Influence

You will own the GTM strategy behind readiness—not the training channels themselves.

Your scope includes:

• Messaging architecture: Define what each audience needs to know and say while maintaining one consistent Okta Secures AI narrative.

• Buyer and persona insight: Understand how buying and adoption decisions differ across CIO, CISO, CTO, developer, and technical audiences.

• Competitive strategy: Help the organization win against competitors before the sale and defend the business after it.

• Launch readiness: Set the readiness bar for new products, releases, and pricing changes across the customer lifecycle.

• Customer evidence: Turn customer conversations, deployments, and outcomes into insights and proof the organization can use.

• Outcome ownership: Measure the impact on win rate, time to deployment, adoption, and expansion.

Note: You do not build a parallel enablement organization. Sales Enablement, Partner Enablement, Dev Enablement, Customer Success, and Professional Services own their channels and programs. You own the strategy, content, and customer signal that feeds those programs.

How You'll Work

• Stay close to customers: Join discovery calls, deal reviews, deployments, and post-sales conversations every week.

• Work directly with FDEs: See where customers get stuck and turn those patterns into better positioning, playbooks, and deployment guidance.

• Work across the field: Partner with sellers, SEs, consultants, TAMs, and CSMs to identify the highest-impact gaps.

• Scale through existing teams: Get your strategy and content into Sales Enablement, Partner Enablement, Dev Enablement, Customer Success, and Professional Services programs.

• Influence the business: Bring customer signal into product, roadmap, pricing, packaging, and GTM decisions.

• Build champions: Deliver key sessions yourself while developing field and partner leaders who can scale the message.

• Measure impact: Track whether the work improves readiness, win rates, deployment speed, adoption, and expansion.

Qualifications & Requirements

• Experience: 5+ years in product marketing, GTM strategy, sales engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services for a technical B2B product. Security or identity experience is a plus.

• Domain expertise: Strong expertise in messaging, positioning, personas, and competitive strategy, grounded in customer experience.

• Field experience: Experience driving readiness across both pre-sales and post-sales technical audiences.

• Technical acumen: Enough technical depth to learn quickly and explain complex concepts clearly—from the agent identity story to MCP, Cross App Access, and enterprise AI deployment.

• Customer centricity: Experience working directly with customers and deployment teams and turning real-world problems into scalable solutions.

• Cross-functional influence: A track record of influencing teams you don't own and getting your work adopted across an organization.

• Communication: Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to adapt to sellers, engineers, consultants, executives, and customers.

• Prioritization: Strong judgment and prioritization—you know what to build, what to reuse, and when to push back.

• Agility: Comfort operating in an early, rapidly changing market where products, pricing, competitors, and customer needs evolve quickly.

• Travel requirements: Willingness to travel for customer engagements, field events, QBRs, and partner sessions.

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Intern, PhD, Research, AV Planning
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The mission of the Waymo AI Foundations team is to develop machine learning solutions addressing open problems in autonomous driving, towards the goal of safely operating Waymo vehicles in dozens of cities and under all driving conditions. As part of our work, we also initiate and foster collaborations with other research teams in Alphabet. AI Foundations areas that we are currently focusing on include reinforcement learning, learning from demonstration, generative modeling, Bayesian inference, hierarchical learning, and robust evaluation.

Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship!

You will:

• Design, implement, and benchmark a system where LLM meta-agents generate, synthesize, and iteratively refine reward functions for autonomous driving planning policies

• Diagnose policy failure modes, reward exploitation, and multi-objective trade-offs, integrating findings back into the automated discovery loop

• Collaborate with scientists engineers to transfer validated reward formulations and tooling into planner recipes

• Document research outcomes, distill key design patterns, and prepare findings for internal tech transfers and potential conference publication

You have:

• Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field

• Strong hands-on experience in Reinforcement Learning (RL / RLFT) and training deep learning policies with PyTorch or JAX

• Demonstrated proficiency in Python and modern ML engineering practices

• Familiarity with autonomous vehicle planning, trajectory optimization, or sequential decision-making under uncertainty

We prefer:

• Track record of peer-reviewed publications at top AI/robotics conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICRA, IROS, CoRL, ICML, ICLR, CVPR)

• Experience with LLM-guided code generation, automated reward discovery (e.g., Eureka-like frameworks), or meta-RL methods

• Hands-on experience with RL or RLFT training in LLM/VLM/robotics

• Proven ability to independently drive an exploratory research problem from ideation to implementation and results

Note: This will be a hybrid onsite internship position. We will accept resumes on a rolling basis until the role is filled. To be in consideration for multiple roles, you will need to apply to each one individually - please apply to the top 3 roles you are interested in.

The expected hourly rate for this full-time position is listed below. Interns are also eligible to participate in the Company’s generous benefits programs, subject to eligibility requirements.

Hourly PhD Pay

About Altruist

Altruist is transforming the multi-trillion dollar wealth management industry by building an AI platform for wealth professionals. We partner with financial advisors nationwide, empowering them to grow, optimize time and resources, and deliver superior outcomes for their clients.

We're looking for exceptional talent to help us achieve our mission of making financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to all. If you're passionate about challenging the status quo and want to do the most important work of your life, we'd love to meet you!

But first, our values

Kindness - Kindness doesn’t just equal niceness. We listen to understand. We embrace, and encourage healthy debate and diverse perspectives. We approach conflict openly, honestly, and respectfully.

Brilliance - Humility is the skill we’re most proud of and possessing a growth mindset is always top of mind. We take ownership in everything we touch; regularly using our unique superpowers to reach a common goal as a team. We succeed and fail as one.

Grit - When challenges arise, we stay laser focused on achieving our mission and finding a way forward, even when it’s hard. We are nimble and maintain a sense of urgency, swiftly adapting to change and overcoming obstacles.

The opportunity

Altruist is in the midst of an exceptional growth phase and we're excited to hire a Sales Executive to join our growing Client Development team. In this role, you'll build a deep understanding of the Altruist platform and clearly position its capabilities to financial advisors. You'll use consultative selling to build trust, educate advisors, and guide them through the buying process to acquire, retain, and expand business. You'll also help create predictable, scalable growth by sharing advisor feedback, meeting sales service-level agreements, and continuously improving how the team works.

Your impact

• Deliver results and demonstrate our core values while achieving individual quarterly and annual quota and supporting the success of the broader sales team.

• Quickly develop a deep understanding of the Altruist platform and effectively position Altruist, the platform, and specific features such as the rebalancer and Model Marketplace.

• Leverage consultative selling skills to build trust with advisors, educate them, and guide them through the buying process to acquire, retain, and expand business.

• Systematically capture advisor feedback to help inform company priorities, including the product roadmap and marketing campaigns.

• Proactively identify ways to improve the sales team while meeting sales service-level agreements and maintaining accurate, complete records in Salesforce.

• Demonstrate coachability and a growth mindset by absorbing and applying feedback from sales leadership to increase effectiveness and efficiency.

What you bring

• Experience - At least 5 years of experience as a sales professional at a B2B financial services, fintech, or SaaS organization. A track record of meeting or exceeding quotas in a fast-paced environment. Strong consultative sales skills. The ability to quickly understand complex product features and articulate how they create value for customers.

• Education - Ideally, a B.A./B.S. degree in a relevant field such as Business, Marketing, Economics, etc.

• Securities licenses - Series 7 and 63 licenses

• Technical aptitude - Technologically savvy and able to quickly get up to speed on modern tech stacks, including AI and agentic workflows

• Ownership - You take exceptional pride in every aspect of your work and hold yourself accountable for delivering high-quality results.

• Superb communication - You practice intentional dialogue, listen thoughtfully, and share your perspective clearly with others.

• Resilience - You demonstrate unwavering determination to achieve success, even in the face of adversity.

• Assurance - You bring confident, ego-less judgment; a strong knowledge base; the ability to discover the unknown; and openness to differing perspectives.

• Creative problem solving - You look beyond identifying problems and bring an instinctively creative approach to overcoming roadblocks.

Compensation

This role has a target compensation range of $265,000–$285,000 OTE (base salary + variable compensation). Final level and compensation is individualized and will be determined based on overall experience, qualifications, and interview performance.

What we bring

Attracting and retaining top-tier talent is a priority. We are proud of the culture we’ve built and are cognizant of the ever-changing professional landscape. Our dynamic offering of perks and benefits are tailored for you to feel your best while doing your best.

• Stunning, amenity-filled office spaces in Culver City, CA, San Francisco, CA, and Dallas, TX. Our offices are intentionally designed for comfort, collaboration, and productivity.

• Competitive total compensation.

• Premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance plans (HMO and PPO).

• 401k savings plan with a 4% match and immediate vesting.

• 16 week paid parental leave after one year of employment.

• Professional growth and development opportunities including an employee mobility program and an annual L&D budget allocation for each employee.

• Company perks program (includes discounts on pet insurance, fitness, cell phone plans, and travel, etc.).

• Financial guidance program (includes counseling on navigating debt, tracking personal spend, saving and planning goals, home-purchasing preparedness, etc.).

• One month work from anywhere policy (with the exception of a few countries).

Total compensation includes a competitive benefits package, along with a bonus program for eligible roles. For salaried positions, a salary offer will be determined by a number of factors including experience, skill level, internal pay equity, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs regularly to ensure fair, equitable, and competitive pay. At Altruist, we are committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation by leveraging market data to inform our pay bands. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically in conjunction with performance review cycles. By evaluating compensation on a regular basis, we are able to reward high performance and ensure all employees have opportunities for growth.

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.

jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The mission of the Waymo AI Foundations team is to develop machine learning solutions addressing open problems in autonomous driving, towards the goal of safely operating Waymo vehicles in dozens of cities and under all driving conditions. As part of our work, we also initiate and foster collaborations with other research teams in Alphabet. AI Foundations areas that we are currently focusing on include reinforcement learning, learning from demonstration, generative modeling, Bayesian inference, hierarchical learning, and robust evaluation.

Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship!

• Able to use the feedback from the team members to adjust the setup, experiments, and research directions

You have:

• Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field

• Knowledge of pre-training and post-training of the large foundation models

• Hands-on experience of training modern AI models

• Good analytical skills and interpret experiments results and forming verifiable hypothesis

• Write a bug-free code, and able to implement correct software without much guidance

We prefer:

• Have a solid research background in robotics or self-driving cars

• Familiar with modern AI infrastructure and tooling such as pytorch, jax, and comfortable in working on cluster/server environments

• Have a strong research skill and publish several papers in top conferences

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Planning & Forecasting (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Sr. Director, Planning & Forecasting to lead the Planning function within Lakeshore’s Supply Chain business unit and guide our integrated business planning. In this role, you’ll own the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process end to end, driving alignment across demand, supply, inventory and revenue plans, and you’ll be a key voice in executive decisions on inventory investment, capacity commitments and business performance.

This is a high-visibility leadership role for someone who can turn market demand signals into a disciplined, data-driven operating plan for our multi-DC distribution network and retail stores. You’ll set the strategic direction for the Planning team while owning the department’s KPIs, leading six direct reports and a broader team of 20+ planning professionals responsible for item-level forecasting, PO creation, DC inventory positioning and safety stock strategy.

Reporting to the SVP, Planning, you’ll continue advancing our planning capabilities in SAP S/4HANA, evaluating and implementing automation, AI-enabled forecasting tools and advanced analytics that make planning decisions faster and sharper. We’re looking for a leader who is equally strong at analyzing scenarios, developing planning talent and presenting data-driven recommendations to senior leadership. It’s meaningful work: when the plan is right, classrooms and families get what they need, when they need it.

A day on the job looks like this:

• Leading the monthly S&OP process, from item-level demand forecast through the executive S&OP meeting, and driving alignment between the forecast, inventory targets and revenue plan
• Coaching and developing six direct reports and a team of 20+ while staying hands-on in daily operations, building the skills and bench strength the team needs to grow
• Overseeing all import and domestic inventory buys within Open-to-Buy (OTB) limits, and leading the domestic expediting team to deliver every buy on time and in full
• Managing item-level inventory availability across two distribution centers and all retail store locations to meet inventory and customer fulfillment goals, and recommending inventory investment strategy to senior leadership
• Defining and governing the inventory segmentation framework, including ABC classification, growth velocity tiering and lifecycle-based safety stock policy
• Driving cross-functional process improvement projects that move department and company KPIs
• Evolving planning capabilities in SAP S/4HANA by evaluating and implementing automation, AI-enabled forecasting tools and advanced analytics

Got the skills and experience? Here’s what we’re looking for:

Required:

• 10+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics or operations management
• 7+ years in a management role leading planning, inventory or buying teams
• Expertise in import and domestic buying of consumer packaged goods or finished goods
• Experience managing inventory across a multi-tier distribution network and global supply chain, including multi-channel fulfillment and retail allocation
• Advanced working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA
• Proven success leading continuous improvement projects

Preferred:

• Experience applying automation, AI-enabled forecasting tools or advanced analytics to demand and supply planning
