jobs.title: Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.




FORWARD DEPLOYED AT HADRIAN

We embed Forward Deployed teams on Hadrian’s largest, most critical programs with the U.S. Government, the Armed Forces, and major defense primes. The Forward Deployed team works alongside the Program team from scoping to execution.

Forward Deployed bends our product to fulfill customer needs. Sometimes that involves extending Opus, Hadrian’s AI-driven manufacturing autonomy platform, other times it involves taking a new product zero to one to make a program successful. Everything the Forward Deployed team learns working at the edge with our customers is fed back to our platform teams to improve Hadrian’s product for all customers.

Recent projects have included standing up Factories-as-a-Service for the Armed Forces and multiple primes, extending Opus into new manufacturing domains such as energetics, and taking a product that was built for a single program into a $B+ product line.

 

The Role

As Director, you lead the Forward Deployed team on one or more programs and own its technical outcomes. You’ll get to run the technical side of a program larger than most startups ever get, working directly with the government, customer’s, and Hadrian’s leadership.

The team is early and scope is rapidly growing with Hadrian. Directors will help scale the Forward Deployed team itself and be the tip of the spear on multi-billion-dollar programs:

 - Own the technical roadmap and delivery. Take the program from the first ambiguous conversation to running in production, decide what Opus covers, what gets built, and what we say no to, and hold the team to a very high execution bar. The program hits rate, quality, schedule, and cost in part because the software and systems behind it work; you own that part.

 - Bring program learnings on platform teams. Share program learnings at Hadrian to improve the product for all customers and decide which Forward Deployed products should become part of Opus.

 - Own the executive relationship on the technical side. Be the primary technical contact for customer program leadership, government stakeholders, and prime partners. Run technical reviews, have the hard conversations about scope and schedule yourself, and make the call when scope, schedule, and platform leverage pull against each other and the commercial stakes are real.

 - Build and lead the team. Hire and grow the engineers, product managers, and designers on your program. You set the standard for how they work, and they bring you their hardest scoping calls.

 - Stay hands-on. Early in a program that can mean building the v0 yourself. Later it means reviewing what your team ships closely enough to ensure it meets Hadrian’s quality bar.

 

What We're Looking For

 - Highly commercial technical leaders with excellent product judgement.

 - You have demonstrated history lead engineering and product teams and scaling a product from zero to one.

 - You are strong with external and internal executives. You have owned senior customer relationships and made commitments on behalf of a company that you then had to deliver on.

 - You have product taste. You know what’s worth building and what good looks like for the user, and you’ve shipped end to end enough times to back that up.

 - You are hands-on technical You are just as comfortable supporting your team with technical. You are just as comfortable supporting your team with architecture and review as you are taking your own idea from design to delivery.

 - You are AI-native, and relentless about it. You use AI to compress everything from discovery to execution, you can show us concretely how it already makes you multiples faster, and you’ve rebuilt how your whole team works around it.

 - You have hired builders into ambiguous roles and gotten them productive fast.

 - You are driven by the mission and the tempo. Rebuilding the industrial base matters to you, and you want to deliver at the pace our customers need.

 

What Will Set You Apart

 - Founder or founding-team experience, especially if you ran customer relationships and business decisions while still building.

 - Background in aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or anywhere hardware, software, and operations meet.

 - Forward deployed or solutions leadership at a product company.


BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 
   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

 


USE OF AI IN HIRING

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy https://www.hadrian.co/privacy-policy.

 


CONSIDERATION OF CRIMINAL HISTORY

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

 


HADRIAN IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental status, physical disability or any other legally protected status. When necessary, the Company also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled candidates and employees, including for candidates or employees who are disabled by pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions.

jobs.title: Manager, Complaints & Disputes Compliance
jobs.location: Phoenix, Arizona, United States, San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
Kikoff: The Fintech Powering Financial Security at Scale
Kikoff is a profitable, pre-IPO fintech company on a mission to empower everyone to achieve financial security. With record revenue growth in 2025 and a unicorn valuation, we've built a suite of products that help millions of people build credit, access liquidity, and save money.
We're scaling fast. Join us if you want to build something meaningful and help millions of people move forward financially.

Why Kikoff:

This is a consumer fintech startup, and you will be working with serial entrepreneurs who have built strong consumer brands and innovative products. We value extreme ownership, clear communication, a strong sense of craftsmanship, and the desire to create lasting work and work relationships. Yes, you can build an exciting business AND have real-life real-customer impact.

About the Role

Complaints and disputes are where Kikoff finds out what it is actually doing for its customers. They also arrive with a clock attached: the law, the regulators, and our bank partner each set deadlines, and none of them move. Reporting to the Head of Compliance, you will own the way we manage and respond to complaints and disputes.

This role brings dedicated ownership for a program that scales with our products and our customers. You will mature Kikoff's complaints and disputes framework, strengthen how it operates in the hands of the Customer Experience team who interact with our customers, and make it hold as volume grows. You start as an individual contributor and hire an analyst as volume requires. The work is equal parts operating discipline and investigation: hitting every deadline is table stakes, and the value is in what the pattern of complaints and disputes tells us to go fix.

What You'll Do

• Manage and mature Kikoff's consumer complaints and disputes program as we scale, covering taxonomy and classification, intake, routing, service levels, investigation and resolution standards, root cause coding, recordkeeping, and reporting.

• Partner with the Customer Experience team so the program works where customers reach us: complaint and dispute identification and coding in their workflow, training and calibration on what each one requires, and guidance on customer-facing responses.

• Handle escalated complaints across every channel they arrive on: the CFPB Company Portal, state attorneys general and regulators, BBB, bank partner escalations, executive and legal escalations, and app store and social media.

• Own disputes and error resolution against their regulatory clocks such as FCRA reinvestigation as a furnisher, Reg E error resolution, and Reg Z billing error handling. You will make sure a contact that is both a complaint and a dispute is classified by its legal trigger at intake and runs on both tracks.

• Scale the program with new products and volume growth: write the procedures, specify the tooling, and use AI to organize incoming volume, summarize records, and prepare draft responses for review, so throughput grows faster than headcount.

• Run root-cause analysis on individual matters and on themes, distinguish between one-off and systemic issues, and drive corrective actions with Product, Engineering, and Operations to verified closure.

• Own the reporting: the metrics, the themes, and the package that goes to Compliance leadership, our bank partner, and governance committees. Serve as the subject matter owner for complaints and disputes in regulatory examinations, bank partner reviews, and internal audit.

What We're Looking For

• 6+ years in consumer financial services, including 3+ years owning complaints, disputes, or consumer compliance operations at a bank, fintech, lender, or servicer.

• You have built or substantially rebuilt a complaints or disputes program and can walk through what you would do differently.

jobs.title: Senior Maintenance Technician
jobs.description:
About Us

We are Sila, a next-generation battery materials company. Our mission is to power the world’s transition to clean energy. To create this future, our team is building a better lithium-ion battery from the inside out today. We engineer and manufacture ground-breaking battery materials that significantly increase the energy density of batteries, while reducing their size and weight. The result? Smaller more powerful batteries that can unlock innovation in consumer devices and accelerate the mass adoption of electric cars to eliminate our dependence on fossil fuels. We're tackling one of the biggest challenges of our time every day, and together we're redefining what's possible. Are you ready to be a part of a team committed to changing the world?

Who You Are

Our fast-paced, high-tech manufacturing environment leverages advanced technologies to drive efficiency, precision, and operational excellence. We are seeking an experienced Senior Maintenance Technician to support the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of our production equipment.

As a Senior Maintenance Technician, you will play a critical role in ensuring the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of complex manufacturing systems. This hands-on position involves advanced troubleshooting, mechanical and electrical repairs, preventive maintenance, and equipment optimization. The ideal candidate brings strong mechanical aptitude, practical problem-solving skills, and a proactive approach to equipment reliability. Experience with machining, fabrication, and precision equipment repair is a valuable addition to this role.

Responsibilities and Duties

• Conduct routine inspections, lubrication, adjustments, and preventive maintenance on production equipment to minimize downtime and optimize performance.

• Diagnose and troubleshoot complex mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems, performing timely repairs to restore equipment reliability.

• Perform hands-on mechanical repairs, modifications, and fabrication of equipment components to support maintenance and operational needs.

• Utilize machining equipment, including manual mills, lathes, drill presses, and other shop tools, to repair, modify, or fabricate mechanical components as needed.

• Support precision machining and fabrication activities, including measuring, fitting, and modifying parts to meet equipment specifications and tolerances.

• Collaborate with production and engineering teams to identify equipment improvements, optimize machinery performance, and implement long-term reliability solutions.

• Respond promptly to equipment breakdowns and urgent repair needs, troubleshooting root causes and restoring operations efficiently.

• Assist with the installation, alignment, commissioning, and testing of new equipment or upgrades to existing systems.

• Interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and technical schematics to support troubleshooting, repairs, and equipment modifications.

• Maintain accurate maintenance logs, repair records, and parts inventories using computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS).

• Follow all safety protocols, including lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and ensure equipment complies with OSHA and company safety standards.

• Partner with engineers, machine operators, and fellow technicians to resolve technical challenges and develop preventive maintenance strategies.

• Share technical knowledge and provide hands-on guidance to junior technicians, promoting best practices in maintenance, troubleshooting, and equipment care.

• Work within a shift-based production environment, including weekends and overtime as operational needs require.

Knowledge and Skill Requirements

• High school diploma or equivalent required; vocational training or certifications in industrial maintenance, machining, mechanical technology, or a related field preferred.

• Demonstrated experience performing maintenance and troubleshooting in a manufacturing, industrial, or high-volume production environment.

• Strong understanding of mechanical systems, including hydraulics, pneumatics, gearboxes, bearings, motors, and power transmission components.

• Working knowledge of electrical systems, including wiring, motors, sensors, variable frequency drives (VFDs), and basic PLC troubleshooting.

• Proficiency with hand tools, power tools, precision measuring instruments, and diagnostic equipment.

• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, electrical schematics, and equipment documentation.

• Preferred: Hands-on machining experience using manual mills, lathes, drill presses, or similar machine shop equipment to fabricate, repair, or modify mechanical components.

• Preferred: Familiarity with machining fundamentals, including cutting tools, material selection, dimensional tolerances, and precision measurement techniques.

• Experience with welding, metal fabrication, or custom equipment modifications is a plus.

• Knowledge of industrial safety standards and regulations, including LOTO procedures and safe operation of shop equipment.

• Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills with the ability to work independently.

• Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to support and mentor other maintenance team members.

• Willingness to work flexible schedules, including shifts, weekends, and overtime as needed.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

• Pass a respirator fit test and be able to wear respiratory protection on a daily basis

• Wear personal protective equipment including, but not limited to, a lab coat, gloves, safety glasses, and steel toe safety shoes

• Move items up to 50 lbs with the assistance of lift equipment and carts

• Move long distances (such as from building to building) and be stationary for extended periods of time

• Reach low shelves or items on the floor

• Enter spaces narrower than 3 feet

• Climb stairs or over containment walls

• Precise and repetitive handling of a range of material quantities

• Operate a computer and other office equipment, such as a laptop, copier/printer, etc in a fixed location

The starting base pay for this role is between $47/hr and $37/hr at the time of posting. The actual base pay depends on many factors, such as education, experience, and skills. Base pay is only one part of Sila’s competitive Total Rewards package that can include benefits, perks, and equity.  The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for overtime.

We are proud to celebrate diversity and all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, national origin, or any other status protected by law.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Associate CQV Engineer is responsible for the service and support of laboratory equipment and instrumentation utilized in the Operations laboratory. The scope of support includes installation, calibration, maintenance, and repair of both simple (e.g., plate sealers) and complex (e.g., liquid handling robotics) instrumentation in the laboratory. The Instrument Service Engineer will be the primary point of contact for production lab personnel when equipment and instruments are not operating or not meeting operational specifications.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Work with other Instrument Support Engineers, and the Automation and laboratory teams to respond to instrument failures and ensure proper instrument function.

• Diagnose and troubleshoot any system concerns to minimize downtime.

• Install new laboratory equipment (e.g., liquid handlers, sequencers, plate sealers, etc.).

• Coordinate and/or perform instrument installations and qualifications per equipment protocols.

• Work with Quality Assurance to determine qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), calibration and preventive maintenance requirements for new incoming instruments, as needed, to comply with regulations.

• Maintain program for preventative maintenance (PM), routine maintenance, and calibration of all laboratory equipment.

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. jobs.title: Portfolio Lead
jobs.description:
Portfolio Lead Salesforce, Data & AI  |  Financial Services & Regulated Industries

Zennify is hiring a Portfolio Leader to sell our Salesforce, data, and AI solutions to financial institutions. This is a quota-carrying role. You own pipeline, forecast, and closed revenue across your territory, and you lead deals from first contact through close.

You understand our solutions and how they translate into outcomes for banks, credit unions, wealth firms, and insurers. You know them well enough to lead the conversation, and you quarterback the right team of solution architects and engineers to scope, estimate, and win the deal.

You work AI-first, using agents and AI tooling to research accounts, prepare for meetings, support discovery, and draft proposals. That frees up time for the customer relationships that move deals forward. You have either sold into financial services or worked inside it, so you understand how these buyers evaluate and make decisions.

This is a quota-carrying role with on-target earnings of $250,000 to $350,000. You own pipeline, forecast, and closed revenue across your territory, and you lead deals from first contact through close.

Primary Responsibilities

Own the commercial cycle

• Own pipeline, forecast, and closed revenue for Salesforce, data, and AI across your territory.

• Run the full sales cycle from prospecting through close, for both new-logo and expansion business.

• Keep an accurate forecast with clear stages, next steps, and close dates.

• Co-sell with Salesforce Account Executives and RVPs to source, advance, and close opportunities.

Sell AI-first

• Use agents and AI tooling to research accounts, prepare for meetings, support discovery, and draft first-pass proposals.

• Anchor each pursuit in ZennifyAccelerate, our AI-first deal process.

• Use the time AI saves to deepen customer relationships and sharpen deal strategy.

• Apply AI in line with each client's security and regulatory requirements.

Understand the solution and quarterback the deal

• Understand Zennify's Salesforce, data, and AI solutions well enough to explain how they translate into outcomes for financial institutions.

• Position the full portfolio: Salesforce, including Financial Services Cloud, Data Cloud, Agentforce, and Marketing, plus data and AI on Databricks and Snowflake.

• Quarterback solution architects and engineers to scope, estimate, and shape each deal.

• Bring the business context and customer outcomes that let the technical team scope accurately and price with confidence.

Required Qualifications

• 5 to 7 years in a quota-carrying sales role, including experience selling Salesforce or Salesforce consulting services, ideally through the partner ecosystem.

• Financial services experience, either selling into financial institutions or working inside one, such as banking, credit unions, wealth, or insurance.

• Familiarity with the Salesforce platform and how it is sold through the partner ecosystem, including clouds such as Sales, Service, Marketing, or Financial Services Cloud.

• Working knowledge of the data and AI ecosystem around Salesforce, including Data Cloud, Agentforce, Databricks, and Snowflake.

• Fluency using AI tools and agents in your own workflow.

• A consultative approach with strong discovery skills, and the ability to connect a business problem to the right solution and outcome.

• The ability to quarterback solution architects and engineers through scoping, estimation, and proposal development.

• Clear communication with stakeholders from admin to the C-suite.

• A track record of managing a pipeline, forecasting accurately, and hitting targets.

• Willingness to work as a remote team member and travel as needed, up to approximately 30% of the time

Preferred Qualifications

• Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Financial Services Cloud.

• Exposure to Databricks, Snowflake, or other data platforms.

• Experience with nCino for banking and lending.

• Experience with Twilio, including Flex, messaging, and customer engagement. Twilio is a plus, not a requirement.

• Experience co-selling with Salesforce Account Executives and RVPs.

• Prior time at a consulting firm or systems integrator serving financial services.

Qualities of the Ideal Candidate

• Brings grit and hustle, with strong follow-through.

• Forms a point of view and leads the conversation rather than reacting to a requirements list.

• Curious and quick to learn, especially with new technology and AI.

• Comfortable moving between technical detail and executive business value.

• Collaborative across sales, delivery, and partner alliances.

• Trusted with sensitive client data, and disciplined about security and compliance.

The full compensation package is based on candidate's experience and certifications.

Zennify pay range

$140,000—$165,000 USD

Rooted in care. Built for what’s next. At Zennify, you help people in regulated industries solve real problems at the intersection of data, AI, and customer experience. You will work across Salesforce, nCino, MuleSoft, Twilio, and Databricks, and you will deliver outcomes that hold up in production. You will join smart, kind, collaborative people who move with urgency and lead with care. We challenge each other, we support each other, and we keep expectations clear. Diverse perspectives make us better partners and better teammates, so we build teams where everyone can do their best work and feel like they belong.

How we work

• Fully remote, designed for flexibility, focus, and balance

• Paid training and certifications to support your growth

• Unlimited PTO so you can take the time you need

Benefits that support real life.  We offer strong medical, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits, plus mental health support. You will also have pet insurance, pawternity and pawreavement leave, and other programs that meet you where you are.

Belonging and equity matter here. We are committed to an inclusive and equitable workplace with equal opportunity, fair pay practices, and respect for every background and identity. Come for the mission. Stay for the people.

Pay Transparency. We believe that pay transparency helps to foster trust and open communication between employers and employees. It allows our team members to have a clear understanding of their earning potential and the expectations associated with their roles. We also believe that pay transparency promotes fairness, as everyone is compensated based on their experience and skills, regardless of factors such as gender, race, or ethnicity. We recognize that the skills and experience of our candidates may vary, and we are committed to compensating them accordingly. As such, we will evaluate each candidate's qualifications, experience, and performance to determine the appropriate compensation within the stated salary range. We hope that this transparent approach to compensation will provide our potential candidates with the information they need to make informed decisions about their career paths.

About Zennify. Zennify is a data engineering and customer experience consultancy built for industries where trust and precision matter, including financial services, healthcare, and utilities. We deliver strategy, implementation, and managed services with warmth, speed, and reliability. We have delivered 600+ Salesforce projects and 200+ data projects, with a 4.9/5 CSAT. Our team holds 750+ certifications, and we continue to grow our data and AI work as our fastest-expanding area. While our roots are in Salesforce, today we help clients build modern foundations that connect data, systems, and experiences, so teams can move faster, serve better, and scale with confidence. Zennify is privately owned and backed by Tercera and Salesforce Ventures. We invest in our people, our partnerships, and our purpose.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT NUMERAL:

At Numeral, we're building the future of tax by bringing together AI agents, human expertise, and global compliance.

We’re the largest and fastest-growing AI-native tax solution. Today, we serve more than 3,500 global businesses, including companies like Supabase, Eight Sleep, and Graza. We’ve grown quickly across our core e-commerce and software segments, more than tripled our revenue every year, and expanded into new industries, including manufacturing, distribution, and wholesale.

Numeral has raised over $157M from Insight Partners, Salesforce Ventures, Benchmark, Mayfield, Y Combinator, and many others.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re hiring a Strategic Finance Lead to help Numeral make better business decisions and carry them through to results. You’ll join a small finance team, work closely with the VP of Finance, and partner with leaders across the business.

This is a senior individual contributor role with ownership of defined areas of planning and selected strategic and systems projects. You’ll work alongside our existing strategic finance team to tackle questions that matter to the business, from the economics of a product launch to the rollout of a new planning platform. You’ll frame the problem, build the analysis, make a recommendation, and work across teams to put it into practice.

You’ll have direct exposure to leadership, meaningful influence over where we invest, and room to take on broader scope as the company grows.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Lead strategic projects through implementation. Own projects in areas such as pricing, new-product economics, go-to-market strategy, and capital allocation. Frame the problem, model the options, align teams on a recommendation, and help execute and measure the outcome.

 - Own key parts of planning and forecasting. Maintain driver-based forecasts, headcount and capacity models, and recurring KPI dashboards for your areas of responsibility. Contribute to the annual budget and long-range plan, explain monthly and quarterly variances, and recommend actions.

 - Understand what drives growth and profitability. Analyze the funnel, marketing returns, retention, gross margin, and customer economics. Test the assumptions behind the metrics and turn your findings into decisions about where to invest.

 - Partner with business leaders. Work directly with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations to set goals, evaluate hiring and investment proposals, and work through tradeoffs. Bring a clear finance perspective and stay involved as decisions are put into practice.

 - Make the business clear to leadership and investors. Own analysis and written narratives for selected board and investor materials, and support fundraising and diligence workstreams. Be precise about the numbers, the assumptions, and the implications.

 - Build and implement finance systems. Lead selected finance systems projects, including planning and reporting tools, from requirements and tool evaluation through implementation and adoption. Use AI and automation to improve speed and reliability, and partner with Accounting and Data to strengthen data quality.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - Relevant finance and operating experience. Typically 5–8 years combining rigorous analytical training in investment banking, investing, or a comparable role with operating finance experience at a B2B software company during rapid growth. We value demonstrated ownership and judgment over an exact career path.

 - Excellent financial modeling. You can build a clean, driver-based Excel model from scratch, keep it understandable, and work quickly without compromising accuracy.

 - High agency and follow-through. You can take a broad objective, figure out what matters, and drive it to completion. You get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar business problems and tools, find the resources you need, and keep people aligned without waiting for detailed instructions.

 - Strong commercial instincts. You understand SaaS metrics and unit economics, including ARR, retention, CAC, payback, and gross margin. You can question how a metric is defined and recognize when it may mislead.

 - Practical AI fluency. You use AI in your work and can point to an analysis or workflow you’ve improved or automated with it. You know how to validate the output.

 - Clear communication and integrity. You explain complex analyses simply and communicate findings candidly, including when the numbers challenge expectations. You raise issues early, challenge assumptions constructively, and build trust through a low-ego, collaborative approach.
   
   


NICE TO HAVES:

 - SQL and BI tools such as Hex, Looker, or Sigma.

 - Experience with pricing, sales compensation, or subscription and usage-based revenue models.

 - Exposure to fundraising, board reporting, or modern planning tools such as Pigment or Anaplan.




LOCATION:

 - This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our NYC office)




WHAT WE OFFER:

 - Competitive salary and equity - you'll share directly in the company's success

 - Full medical, dental, and vision coverage

 - Wellness perks like Headspace and the Peloton One App

 - 401(k) to help you build long-term financial security

 - Relocation assistance to NYC (if needed)

 - Lunch and snacks when you're in the office

 - Regular team offsites and company events as we grow

 - A culture built on ownership - your work matters and people will see it!

jobs.title: Associate Project Management Director-Retail Construction
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Associate Project Management Director leads a team responsible for delivering project management services for our retail client to help achieve strategic business objectives. The Associate PM Director operates as a player/coach, leading the day-to-day activities of a small group of remote Project Managers while directly leading retail construction projects and programs.

This job is part of the Project Management function responsible for the management of projects from initiation through completion. Role is on-site five days a week in Plano office and may require 10%-20% travel to project locations as required.

What You’ll Do

Refines project management standards, procedures, tools, and governance to improve consistency, efficiency, and delivery quality across the portfolio.

Partners with the client, internal business lines, architects and engineers, general contractors, vendors, and other stakeholders to deliver projects efficiently in accordance with scope, schedule, budget, quality, and contractual requirements.

Provide formal supervision to employees, including recruiting and hiring, onboarding, training and development, performance evaluations, coaching, mentoring, recognition, and retention.

Lead the day-to-day activities of a small group of remote Project Managers. Establish priorities and work schedules, assign tasks, balance workloads, cross-train staff, remove obstacles, and set and track individual, project, and departmental deadlines.

Lead and oversee all facets of construction project management including planning, design, procurement, contracting, construction, occupancy/turnover, and closeout, with accountability for budget, schedule, quality, risk, and client objectives.

Ensure contract procurement, negotiation, execution, administration, change management, and closeout are accurate, timely, compliant, and aligned with client requirements.

Establish and maintain strong project controls and documentation governance. Ensure project data, forecasts, purchase orders, invoices, commitments, reconciliations, and reporting are accurate, timely, coordinated, and aligned with company and client requirements.

Monitor project and account financial performance, including budgets, billing, accounts receivable collection, expenses and staffing.

Identify complex project and program risks, lead reviews, and develop mitigation, contingency, and backup plans to protect schedule, budget, quality, and business continuity.

Lead third-party project delivery resources, including design consultants, general contractors, vendors, and other partners; establish expectations and monitor performance and deliverables.

Lead by example and model behaviors consistent with company values. Communicate complex information clearly and influence stakeholders with shared and differing interests to reach effective decisions and agreements.

Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical and operational issues, and understand the broader impact of project and operational decisions across the client account.

What You’ll Need

• Bachelor's Degree preferred with 3-5 years of relevant PM Director level experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. LEED AP, PMP, and CCM designations preferred.
• Experience leading construction projects from initiation through closeout, with retail construction, renovations, fit-outs, refresh programs, rollouts, or multi-site programs strongly preferred.
• Prior AEC, owner’s representative, or commercial real estate project management experience is beneficial.
• Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention is preferred.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint), MS Project, Kahua, or similar scheduling/project management software required. Smartsheet, Power BI, D365, SAP, or a similar ERP/project management platform is beneficial.
• Ability to read and understand architectural and construction drawings, and working knowledge of construction contracts, procurement, and construction practices.
• Leadership skills to motivate team impact on quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the job discipline and department.

*SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs*

jobs.title: Senior Digital Paid Ad Manager
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

What You’ll Do

We are seeking a Senior Digital Paid Ads Manager to own the strategy, execution, and optimization of Horizon3.ai http://Horizon3.ai’s paid digital advertising programs. This is a senior individual-contributor role responsible for turning audience intelligence, account priorities, campaign strategy, and creative direction into measurable pipeline and revenue impact.

You will lead paid media across channels such as LinkedIn, search, display, retargeting, programmatic, and account-based advertising platforms. You will build campaigns that reach the right accounts and buying groups with the right message at the right stage of the journey, while creating the measurement discipline required to understand what is working and where to invest next.

You will report to the Director, Digital Marketing and work closely with Demand Generation, ABM, Field Marketing, Product Marketing, Content, Marketing Operations, Sales, SDRs, and regional teams. You will serve as the senior operator for paid advertising—bringing strategic judgment, hands-on execution, rigorous testing, and clear performance reporting to a fast-growing marketing organization.

This is not a campaign trafficking role. It is a strategic and analytical role that combines paid media expertise, audience and account planning, creative experimentation, marketing technology fluency, and pipeline accountability.




WHAT YOU’LL DO


PAID MEDIA STRATEGY AND PLANNING

 - Own the paid digital advertising strategy across assigned segments, audiences, regions, products, and funnel stages.

 - Translate business, pipeline, and go-to-market priorities into paid media plans with clear audiences, investment levels, channel mix, messaging, offers, timing, and success metrics.

 - Build integrated paid media strategies across awareness, demand creation, account engagement, opportunity acceleration, and customer or expansion motions.

 - Recommend channel and budget allocation based on account opportunity, audience quality, intent, conversion, pipeline contribution, and efficiency.

 - Partner with the Director, Digital Marketing to establish paid media priorities, planning cadences, forecasts, and performance expectations.

 - Create scalable campaign frameworks that can be adapted across industries, segments, regions, and buying groups.


ACCOUNT-BASED AND AUDIENCE STRATEGY

 - Partner with ABM, Sales, SDR, and Demand Generation leaders to define and prioritize target accounts and buying groups for paid activation.

 - Build one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many paid plays based on account tier, segment, intent signal, buying stage, engagement, and pipeline status.

 - Translate account and persona insights into audience definitions, targeting strategies, exclusions, sequencing, and next-best actions.

 - Coordinate account-based advertising across LinkedIn, Influ2 or equivalent platforms, display, retargeting, and other paid channels.

 - Partner with ABM and Field Marketing to extend paid programs into events, executive experiences, CISO programs, and other high-value account plays.

 - Maintain strong alignment between paid audiences, CRM data, account lists, campaign membership, and lifecycle stages.

 - Monitor audience quality, reach, frequency, saturation, intent, and engagement to improve targeting over time.


CAMPAIGN EXECUTION AND OPTIMIZATION

 - Own end-to-end execution of paid campaigns, including briefs, audience setup, creative requirements, build, QA, launch, monitoring, optimization, and reporting.

 - Build and manage campaigns across paid social, search, display, retargeting, programmatic, partner, and account-based channels.

 - Partner with Content, Product Marketing, ABM, and Creative teams to develop and test ads, landing pages, offers, proof points, and calls to action.

 - Establish a structured testing roadmap across audience, creative, message, offer, placement, bid strategy, landing page, cadence, and conversion experience.

 - Monitor in-flight performance and make timely adjustments to bids, budgets, targeting, placements, frequency, creative rotation, and campaign sequencing.

 - Identify underperforming campaigns and root causes, then implement corrective actions with clear follow-through.

 - Maintain accurate campaign documentation, launch checklists, budgets, status, risks, dependencies, and optimization decisions.


CREATIVE AND MESSAGING PARTNERSHIP

 - Translate technical cybersecurity concepts, buyer pain points, product value, and account intelligence into paid advertising briefs and messaging recommendations.

 - Partner with Product Marketing and Content to develop persona-relevant creative for CISOs, security architects, IT, SecOps, and other technical buying-group members.

 - Guide creative testing across formats, messages, offers, proof points, customer stories, benchmarks, and calls to action.

 - Ensure paid creative is aligned to brand standards, campaign strategy, funnel stage, audience context, and the intended next action.

 - Use performance insights to inform creative iteration and improve relevance, engagement, and conversion.


MEASUREMENT, ATTRIBUTION, AND PIPELINE REPORTING

 - Define and own paid media KPIs, including reach, frequency, engagement, click-through rate, cost per click, conversion rate, cost per qualified response, meetings, pipeline generated, pipeline influenced, stage progression, and return on investment.

 - Build and maintain reporting that gives leadership visibility into performance by channel, campaign, audience, account tier, segment, region, funnel stage, and program.

 - Partner with Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations to ensure accurate campaign setup, campaign membership, UTM standards, Salesforce attribution, account matching, and lifecycle tracking.

 - Analyze paid media, account engagement, funnel, and pipeline data to identify trends, gaps, anomalies, and opportunities.

 - Distinguish activity and efficiency metrics from meaningful business outcomes.

 - Establish measurement approaches for both direct-response and account-based programs, recognizing different buying cycles and conversion paths.

 - Communicate performance insights and investment recommendations clearly to marketing and business stakeholders.


MARKETING TECHNOLOGY AND OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

 - Own day-to-day paid media platform operations and governance in partnership with Marketing Operations and the Director, Digital Marketing.

 - Maintain accurate audience, account, contact, campaign, conversion, and suppression logic across paid platforms and connected GTM systems.

 - Partner with Marketing Operations to troubleshoot data, integration, tracking, consent, and attribution issues.

 - Build repeatable processes for campaign intake, audience creation, creative QA, launch readiness, budget approval, monitoring, optimization, and closeout.

 - Identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone processes and replace them with scalable workflows, automation, or agent-based solutions.

 - Use AI and emerging tools to improve audience research, creative iteration, troubleshooting, reporting, and team productivity.

 - Maintain clear documentation for platform standards, campaign conventions, tracking requirements, QA procedures, and optimization practices.


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION AND LEADERSHIP

 - Work closely with Digital Marketing, Demand Generation, ABM, Field Marketing, Product Marketing, Content, Marketing Operations, Sales, SDR/BDR leadership, and regional teams.

 - Lead cross-functional paid media programs with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, deadlines, and competing priorities.

 - Create clarity around roles, decision rights, handoffs, timelines, campaign requirements, and success measures.

 - Serve as a trusted partner to Sales and SDR teams by connecting paid engagement signals to practical account and outreach actions.

 - Communicate plans, status, risks, results, and recommendations to both working teams and senior stakeholders.

 - Influence without direct authority by bringing structure, data, clear recommendations, and reliable follow-through.

 - Mentor peers and help establish stronger paid media, testing, measurement, and operating practices across Marketing.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 5+ years of experience in paid media, digital marketing, demand generation, performance marketing, ABM, or a related B2B marketing function.

 - Proven track record owning paid digital strategy and execution across multiple channels, with measurable pipeline or revenue impact.

 - Strong hands-on experience with platforms such as LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads or equivalent search platforms, display or programmatic platforms, and account-based advertising tools.

 - Experience developing paid media plans across funnel stages, target segments, buying groups, regions, and account tiers.

 - Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, forecast spend, allocate investment, and make data-driven tradeoffs.

 - Strong understanding of audience development, account targeting, segmentation, suppression, retargeting, frequency management, and lifecycle activation.

 - Experience designing and executing structured tests across audience, creative, messaging, offers, landing pages, and channel mix.

 - Strong command of campaign tracking, UTM standards, Salesforce or CRM campaign structures, attribution, and performance reporting.

 - Experience partnering with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, ABM, Sales, SDRs, Product Marketing, Content, and Creative teams.

 - Strong analytical judgment and comfort using paid media, funnel, account engagement, conversion, and pipeline data to guide decisions.

 - Ability to translate complex or technical subject matter into relevant paid advertising concepts and audience-specific messaging.

 - Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, audiences, budgets, stakeholders, and timelines without losing detail or momentum.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize performance and make clear investment recommendations.

 - Ability to operate independently, create structure in an evolving environment, and influence without direct authority.

 - Strong attention to detail and a bias for action, balanced with sound judgment about brand, compliance, data quality, and efficiency.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience in cybersecurity, DevSecOps, cloud security, or another highly technical B2B SaaS environment.

 - Experience running account-based advertising programs using Influ2, 6sense, Demandbase, Terminus, Bombora, ZoomInfo, or equivalent platforms.

 - Experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager and paid social programs targeting enterprise buying groups.

 - Familiarity with search advertising, display, programmatic, retargeting, and paid content distribution.

 - Experience supporting Federal or Public Sector digital advertising or ABM motions.

 - Experience with marketing automation platforms such as Pardot, Marketo, or HubSpot.

 - Familiarity with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or advanced reporting and visualization techniques.

 - Experience using AI tools or automation to improve audience research, creative development, campaign execution, troubleshooting, or reporting.

 - Experience building paid media playbooks, governance models, testing frameworks, or repeatable operating processes.

 - Experience mentoring marketers or leading cross-functional working groups without formal people-management responsibility.

 
 

Travel Requirements

This role may require up to 10% travel for internal offsites, key industry events, and team alignment.

Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

 

Perks of Horizon3

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.



Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

 - Base salary range: $149,000 - $185,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

 - Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.



You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.



Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 



Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Procurement & Procure-to-Pay to lead how Flexport buys and pays for corporate indirect and warehouse goods and services. You’ll run daily procure-to-pay operations and build the procurement processes that help us negotiate better agreements, manage renewals, and control costs.

You’ll lead a team of approximately five to ten people and work closely with Finance, Legal, and business leaders. Expect to negotiate with vendors, solve operational problems, and use AI and automation to improve how the team works.

We’re looking for someone with strong judgment, a record of results, and the ability to learn quickly. You may have developed those strengths in procurement, finance, operations, consulting, or another demanding role.

You Will

• Lead and develop the team: set priorities, coach team members, and uphold high standards for accuracy and service.

• Lead vendor negotiations with business owners, using spend data and commercial alternatives to improve pricing and terms.

• Maintain a clear view of contracts, commitments, and renewal dates. Work with Legal and business owners to address risks and negotiate before deadlines limit our options.

• Own purchasing approvals, invoice processing, exception resolution, and payments, working with Accounting and Treasury.

• Maintain reliable records and controls, including approval authority, separation of duties, and checks against duplicate or incorrect payments.

• Work with budget owners to challenge unnecessary spending and track realized savings with Finance.

• Track savings, renewal readiness, invoice accuracy, processing times, and timely payments. Fix the causes of recurring problems.

• Build and test AI-assisted workflows for spend analysis, contract review, and invoice exceptions. Work with Finance Systems and technical teams to implement them, train the team, and measure improvements without weakening payment controls.

Success in Your First Year

• Business teams follow a clear purchasing process, and key vendors, contracts, renewals, and approvals are easy to track.

• Negotiations and renewals produce measurable savings confirmed by Finance and better commercial terms.

• Invoices and payments are more accurate and timely, with fewer recurring exceptions and consistent controls.

• The team has clear responsibilities, stronger skills, and AI workflows that demonstrably reduce manual work.

You Should Have

• A record of strong results and increasing responsibility in procurement, finance, operations, consulting, or a related field.

• Experience leading and developing people, setting expectations, and addressing performance issues.

• Strong commercial judgment: you can negotiate, weigh tradeoffs, and influence people with competing priorities.

• The ability to analyze spending and financial data in Excel, Google Sheets, or similar tools and turn your findings into clear recommendations.

• An understanding of financial controls and how purchasing, invoices, and payments fit together, with the ability to learn unfamiliar systems quickly.

• Experience taking an unclear problem, building a workable process, and getting people to use it.

• Clear communication, reliable follow-through, and curiosity about better ways to work.

• Hands-on experience using generative AI to analyze information or improve a recurring workflow. You can explain what you built, how you tested it, and what improved.

• Sound judgment about AI: you check results against source data, recognize unreliable outputs, protect confidential information, and know when human review is needed.

jobs.description:
Antora Energy delivers affordable, reliable energy to industry, data centers, and the grid. Our thermal batteries turn low-cost electricity into always-on heat and power, without supply-constrained critical minerals or multi-year construction timelines.

We are growing our company with people who put team and mission first, value connection through laughter and joy, and work with humility and openness. We are committed to building a diverse, passionate, and creative team dedicated to a future powered by abundant, clean, low-cost energy.

Position Summary

Antora Energy is seeking a self-driven and passionate individual to join our engineering team to deliver zero-carbon industrial heat and power with our novel solid state thermal battery. We are a tight-knit team that loves what we do and we strive to have an impact, working with humility and openness while building lifelong relationships along the way. The Mechanical Engineer will scope, define, and design novel mechanical systems and components for balance-of-plant (BOP) process systems for Antora Energy’s thermal energy storage projects across test and commercial sites. You will be a key technical member of a cross-functional and rapidly growing organization. Your work will directly contribute to the testing and commercial deployment of an innovative long-duration energy storage technology.

You will be responsible for mechanical design of high-temperature heat transfer and process fluid systems — piping, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, and steam generation equipment — operating at elevated temperature and MW scale.

Roles & Responsibilities

• Full lifecycle ownership of plant mechanical components and system

• Develop detailed mechanical design for first of a kind pressure vessels, piping and process components, meeting critical performance, cost and scalability requirements.

• Perform thermal-mechanical analysis of hot components: differential thermal expansion between coupled structures, creep, thermal cycling/fatigue, thermal shock, and insulation/heat-loss trade-offs.

• Select valves, seals, instruments, and fittings for hot process fluid service (gas, liquid, or two-phase), including leak-tightness, material compatibility, and actuation at temperature.

• Identify, develop and work with vendors enabling design execution

• Create and implement test plans to validate performance, assembly and lifetime

Key Qualifications

• Bachelors or equivalent in an engineering field (e.g. chemical, mechanical, industrial, etc.) and/or 4+ years’ experience in industrial applications engineering (oil & gas, chemicals, power plants, etc.)

• Demonstrated experience solving novel engineering problems through commercial deployment

• Experience with industrial mechanical equipment: Pressure Vessels, Pumps, Heat Exchangers, Air Coolers, Fans, Tanks, Piping, Valves.

• Experience designing equipment for elevated-temperature service (>400 °C): materials selection, allowable evaluation, high-temp sealing.

• Understanding of process-fluid hazards and their mechanical design implications (inert gas asphyxiation, hot fluid release, freeze/solidification, corrosion).

• Working knowledge of piping and pressure vessel codes, including ASME BPVC, ASME B31, PED 2014/68/EU, CSA B51, etc

Additional Qualifications Desired

• Deep engineering experience and intuition, ideally with background in:

• Multi-wall, jacketed, trace-heated, or vacuum-insulated piping system experience

• Familiar with concentrated solar, HRSG/boiler, nuclear primary systems, industrial furnaces, or cryogenic process equipment

• Use of one or more of AutoCAD, Solidworks, COMSOL, ANSYS,

• Holds a PE in one or more related disciplines

Work Location:  Onsite - San Jose, CA

Salary Range:  $154,000 - 185,000

Salary Basis:  Annually

Please note that the salary range listed above reflects Antora Energy's estimated pay for this position. The actual salary offered will be within the posted range and determined based on several factors including but not limited to a candidate's experiences, credentials and expertise, as they pertain to the position's requirements.

In addition to a competitive base salary, Antora Energy’s Total Rewards program includes equity compensation in the form of stock options, a premium health benefits package with life and disability insurance, a 401K plan with employer contributions, flexible spending accounts, and an industry leading paid-time-off policy that features flexible and inclusive holiday observance, as well as paid volunteer time off.

We’re consistently recognized as a leader in the industry: a Leader in the Forrester Wave and Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contract Lifecycle Management, a Fortune Great Place to Work, and one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Workplaces. Ironclad has also been named to Forbes’ AI 50 and Business Insider’s list of Companies to Bet Your Career On. We’re backed by leading investors including Accel, Y Combinator, Sequoia, BOND, and Franklin Templeton. For more information, visit www.ironcladapp.com http://www.ironcladapp.com or follow us on LinkedIn.




THE ROLE

As a Staff or Senior Staff Engineer on the Developer Productivity team, you’ll lead improvements to how Ironclad engineers build, test, and ship software. Our team owns local development tooling, build and test systems, release automation, and our Backstage developer portal. We work closely with SRE at the intersection of developer tooling and infrastructure.


We’re looking for a hands-on technical leader with deep JavaScript/Typescript build and test experience, a background in SRE or infrastructure, and a track record of delivering projects that other teams adopt.


You’ll help shape the team’s technical direction and roadmap, working closely with engineers across Ironclad to understand where development slows down and what would make the biggest difference. You’ll turn those problems into practical tools and features, lead implementation and adoption, and use feedback to guide what comes next. You’ll also mentor engineers and share responsibility for supporting the tools we own.

We’re hiring at both the Staff and Senior Staff levels, with level determined through the interview process. We expect technical leadership at both levels. At Senior Staff, you’ll take broader ownership of the team’s direction, align priorities across teams, and lead improvements that benefit engineering as a whole.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Make JavaScript/TypeScript builds and tests faster and more reliable across webpack, Jest, and Vitest. Improve our Bazel build system, including remote caching, and lead the remaining migration off NX.

 - Build Kubernetes tooling that lets product teams make routine application changes independently.

 - Own the path from commit to production, including CI, environment promotion through Kargo, verification, and rollback.

 - Extend Backstage with plugins that connect deployment, monitoring, and incident data.

 - Make local development environments quick to start and consistent across engineers’ machines.

 - Use build times, CI reliability, lead time, and deployment frequency to identify problems and prioritize improvements.

 - Help set the team’s technical roadmap in partnership with other engineering teams. Identify problems, define solutions, and lead delivery and adoption, keeping engineering leadership informed of priorities, progress, and tradeoffs.

 - Lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, and participate in the team’s support rotation.

Our stack includes TypeScript, React, Node.js, and Docker containers running on Kubernetes in Google Cloud Platform.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Staff: 8+ years of software engineering experience. Senior Staff: 12+ years. For either level, at least 3 years in SRE, infrastructure, build systems, CI/CD, or developer tooling.

 - Deep experience with JavaScript and TypeScript build and test tools, such as webpack, Jest, or Vitest, including diagnosing slow builds and flaky tests at scale.

 - Production experience with Kubernetes and containers on GCP, AWS, or Azure, and CI systems such as CircleCI or GitHub Actions.

 - Strong programming skills in TypeScript, Go or Python, and comfort with shell scripting.

 - Experience leading technical projects that required adoption across teams, as a tech lead or engineering manager while staying hands-on.

 - Clear written communication, including design documents, technical proposals, and migration guides engineers can follow.

 - Alignment with Ironclad’s values: drive, intent, integrity, and empathy.




HELPFUL EXPERIENCE

 - Bazel or Nx, particularly migrations of JavaScript or TypeScript monorepos.

 - Kargo, Argo CD, or other GitOps tooling.

 - Building Backstage plugins.

 - Infrastructure as code, such as Terraform or Pulumi.
   
   
   

Base Salary Range: $210,000 - $235,000, offers company bonus

The base salary range represents the minimum and maximum of the salary range for this position based at our San Francisco headquarters. The actual base salary offered for this position will depend on numerous factors, including individual proficiency, anticipated performance, and the location of the selected candidate. Our base salary is just one component of Ironclad’s competitive total rewards package, which also includes equity awards (a new hire grant, along with opportunities for additional awards throughout your tenure), competitive health and wellness benefits, and a commitment to career growth and development.


US Full-Time Employee Benefits at Ironclad:

 - 100% health coverage for employees (medical, dental, and vision), and 75% coverage for dependents with buy-up plan options available

 - Market-leading leave policies, including gender-neutral parental leave and compassionate leave

 - Family forming support through Maven for you and your partner

 - Paid time off - take the time you need, when you need it

 - Monthly stipends for wellbeing, hybrid work, and (if applicable) cell phone use

 - Mental health support through Modern Health, including therapy, coaching, and digital tools

 - Pre-tax commuter benefits (US Employees)

 - 401(k) plan with Fidelity with employer match (US Employees)

 - Regular team events to connect, recharge, and have fun

 - And most importantly: the opportunity to help build the company you want to work at

**UK Employee-specific benefits are included on our UK job postings



Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Production Engineering
jobs.description:
OWN YOUR INTELLIGENCE

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: infrastructure and tools that help ambitious AI teams train, evaluate, and deploy advanced models.




ROLE IMPACT

Platform engineering at Prime Intellect sits on the path from a research idea to a running AI workload. Your core mandate is to make every engineering team faster and safer: turn recurring infrastructure and security needs into paved roads, self-service capabilities, and guardrails that help teams move from idea to production with confidence.

This is a hands-on senior role with broad technical ownership. You will write code, set platform standards, and partner directly with research, product engineering, and security to improve how services are built, shipped, and operated.




WHY THIS ROLE STANDS OUT

 - Work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and distributed, GPU-intensive AI workloads

 - Own foundational systems in a small, senior team where technical decisions have visible impact

 - Multiply the impact of other teams through secure defaults, automation, and a strong developer experience
   
   


WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Build reusable infrastructure-as-code and reliable CI/CD workflows for platform services

 - Design cloud foundations spanning compute, networking, identity, secrets, and service delivery

 - Develop progressive rollout, health-check, and rollback patterns for critical infrastructure

 - Build self-service platform capabilities, templates, and guardrails that shorten the path from code to production

 - Partner with research and product teams to remove delivery bottlenecks and turn recurring needs into reusable platform capabilities

 - Define practical observability standards across metrics, logs, dashboards, and alerting using tools such as Grafana

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years in infrastructure, platform, or security-focused engineering

 - Deep hands-on experience with Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tooling

 - Strong knowledge of cloud networking, IAM, secrets management, and CI/CD

 - Experience designing secure software delivery lifecycle environments from development through production

 - Production experience with Kubernetes or similar container orchestration platforms

 - Ability to debug across infrastructure layers and make sound trade-offs under ambiguity

 - Clear technical communication and a track record of leading cross-functional projects
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience operating ML/LLM training or inference infrastructure

 - Exposure to GPU infrastructure and distributed systems

 - Experience with zero-trust access patterns

 - Experience supporting compliance or audit-readiness programs




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Cash compensation $150K–$300K with significant equity

 - Flexible work arrangement (remote or San Francisco office)

 - Full visa sponsorship and relocation support

 - Professional development budget for courses and conferences

GROWTH OPPORTUNITY

You’ll have direct influence over the platform behind open frontier AI research and products used by ambitious AI teams. Your impact will show up in faster delivery, safer operations, and less infrastructure work repeated across teams. We value ownership, technical judgment, and engineers who turn complex problems into simple, durable systems.

jobs.title: Manager, Finance
jobs.description:
The Finance Manager is a key role on the Universal Studio Group (USG) Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team and will be responsible for driving Free Cash Flow (FCF) financial forecasting, reporting and analysis across the studio. This position partners with cross-divisional teams (including Production Finance, Controllership, Participations & Residuals teams, Studios, UTE, and NBCU Corporate) to drive strategic decision making, streamline processes, and ensure accurate financial performance. This role will report to the Director of Financial Planning & Analysis for USG.

Essential Responsibilities

Studio Delivery Volume Forecasting & Reporting

• Lead forecasting and reporting processes for the USG’s portfolio, including monthly presentations of production and delivery projections to Senior Finance Executives.
• Maintain and track key Studio volume metrics to ensure accuracy and transparency.

Financial Modeling & Forecasting

• Build and manage detailed 3rd Party & Peacock Collections in partnership with the USG Operating Cash Flow (OCF) team and cross-divisional finance stakeholders (NBC/Cable/Peacock).
• Support long-range planning through the development of annual operating plans, forecasts, and five-year financial models.

Free Cash Flow (FCF) Management

• Oversee the FCF pacing process by reviewing production spending, tax credits, development, collections, audits, Accounts Receivable (AR) aging, Participations & Residuals.
• Manage the 13-week cash flow forecast on a weekly basis.
• Identify and communicate risks and opportunities, delivering clear updates to USG/Studios Finance leadership and the corporate FP&A team.
• Manage FCF submissions, reporting, analytics, and scenario planning to support informed decision-making.

Executive & Strategic Support

• Assist with preparing executive presentations covering key business topics (e.g., Year over Year (YoY) analysis, OCF to FCF conversion).
• Provide ad hoc financial analysis and insights to help guide strategic initiatives.

Close & Controllership Support

• Lead critical close processes, including close checks, in close coordination with the Controllership team during month and quarter-end.

Corporate Partnership & Reporting

• Collaborate with corporate FP&A to provide studio-level analytics, elimination details, and key supplemental reporting.
• Work in partnership with the Studios & UTE Finance teams to provide key analysis and reporting

Project Management & Process Improvement

• Drive key initiatives across the studio, including process simplification, systems upgrades, and implementation of best practices to improve efficiency.

Basic Requirements:

• BS/BA degree with Accounting/Finance focus preferred
• 4+ years public and/or private accounting, or FP&A experience preferred
• High proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint
• Accounting / Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) knowledge

Desired Characteristics:

• Experience managing FP&A cycles is preferred
• Team player with ability to work well in a cross-functional environments and willingness to jump into projects to meet department goals
• Ability to quickly grasp new concepts and problem solve
• Strong initiative and ability to manage multiple projects
• Ability to work independently
• Strong interpersonal skills: ability to work and communicate effectively with all levels of finance, operations, and senior management
• Continuous improvement attitude, willingness to seek out and implement best practices
• Detail-oriented with strong organizational, analytical and PC skills
• Strong organization and time management skills; ability to deliver on multiple project assignments, meet tight deadlines and be effective under pressure
• Entertainment / Media / TV Production experience preferred
• SAP or Essbase knowledge preferred with exposure to BPC a plus

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $90,000-$125,000 (bonus eligible)
