jobs.title: Senior Marketing Campaigns Manager, ABM
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Senior Campaigns and ABM Manager to own account-based marketing strategy and execution while leading integrated campaigns that generate pipeline and accelerate revenue.

This is a senior individual-contributor role responsible for turning account intelligence and campaign strategy into coordinated, measurable programs across digital, field, webinars, direct mail, gifting, partner channels, and Sales or SDR outreach. You will own high-priority account plays while also managing repeatable campaign and webinar programs across AMER, EMEA, and APJ.

You will report to the Director, Campaigns and Marketing Operations and work closely with Demand Generation, Sales, SDRs, Field Marketing, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Marketing Operations, and regional teams. You will serve as the connective tissue between account strategy and campaign execution—ensuring that every priority account has a plan, every campaign has clear owners and outcomes, and every program is measured against pipeline impact.

This is not a traditional campaign coordination role. It is an account intelligence, program ownership, and execution role that uses marketing as a precision instrument to help Sales open doors, accelerate opportunities, engage buying groups, and win.




WHAT YOU’LL DO


ABM STRATEGY AND ACCOUNT PLANNING

 - Own ABM strategy and execution across East Coast priority accounts and other assigned target-account segments.

 - Build one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many programs based on account tier, segment, intent signal, buying stage, and pipeline status.

 - Partner with Sales and SDR leadership to define, maintain, and prioritize target account lists.

 - Develop account-level plans for priority accounts, including buying-group mapping, engagement-gap analysis, message personalization, channel sequencing, and next-best actions.

 - Build tiered plays for cold prospects, intent-active accounts, open opportunities requiring acceleration, and late-stage opportunities requiring coordinated buying-group engagement.

 - Establish a structured ABM planning and reporting cadence with Sales, SDRs, Demand Generation, Field Marketing, and Marketing Operations.

 - Use intent and engagement signals to refine account prioritization and recommend where to focus program investment.




INTEGRATED CAMPAIGN AND PROGRAM MANAGEMENT

 - Partner with Demand Generation, Campaigns, and Customer Marketing to plan and execute integrated campaigns aligned to pipeline and revenue goals.

 - Own end-to-end campaign project management: build plans, manage timelines, coordinate dependencies, track risks, and ensure deliverables stay on track.

 - Translate campaign briefs and ABM strategies into detailed project plans with clear tasks, owners, due dates, dependencies, launch requirements, and success metrics.

 - Ensure every campaign has defined goals, target audiences, offers, channels, account or contact segments, follow-up motions, and measurement plans before launch.

 - Coordinate inputs from Product Marketing, Content, Field Marketing, Digital, Partner Marketing, SDR/BDR, and Sales.

 - Build and manage multi-channel campaigns across email, paid media, landing pages, social, partner channels, field programs, direct mail, gifting, and coordinated Sales outreach.

 - Maintain clear, up-to-date campaign documentation and status so stakeholders have visibility into progress, risks, and changes.




GLOBAL WEBINARS AND VIRTUAL EVENTS

 - Own planning and execution of webinars and virtual events across AMER, EMEA, and APJ, including scheduling, registration, promotion, live-day coordination, and post-event follow-up.

 - Manage speaker, moderator, and partner logistics, including preparation calls, run-of-show documents, dry runs, and day-of support.

 - Collaborate with regional marketing and Sales teams to localize webinar topics, timing, promotion, and follow-up for local markets and time zones.

 - Partner with Marketing Operations to ensure webinars are correctly configured in Salesforce and the marketing automation platform, with accurate campaign membership and pipeline attribution.

 - Design webinar programs that support both broad demand generation and targeted ABM plays for priority accounts and buying groups.

 - Track registrations, attendance, engagement, meetings, pipeline, and conversion, then use learnings to improve future programs.




ABM PROGRAM EXECUTION AND ORCHESTRATION

 - Design and execute coordinated account plays using Influ2 or equivalent contact-level advertising, ZoomInfo intent, LinkedIn, Reachdesk or equivalent gifting, field event invitations, content, webinars, and SDR outreach.

 - Partner with Field Marketing to extend ABM plays into CISO dinners, roundtables, bespoke enterprise experiences, executive events, and regional activations.

 - Coordinate with Digital on account-targeted paid media, audience construction, messaging, and cadence.

 - Partner with Product Marketing to develop account-relevant proof points, case studies, benchmarks, and use cases for specific personas and buying groups.

 - Build direct mail and gifting programs with clear thresholds for when gifting is deployed, to whom, with what message, and with what follow-up motion.

 - Ensure ABM programs are integrated with broader campaigns rather than operating as disconnected, one-off activities.

 - Monitor in-flight performance and optimize audience, message, offer, cadence, channel mix, and sequencing.




SALES AND SDR ALIGNMENT

 - Serve as a primary ABM and campaign partner to Sales and SDR leadership.

 - Run account-planning sessions and campaign working sessions that align stakeholders on target accounts, buying groups, priorities, timelines, and next actions.

 - Share intent and engagement signals in real time, including ad engagement, direct mail activity, gifting, webinar attendance, content engagement, event participation, and account-level intent surges.

 - Give Sales and SDRs a clear next action for each active ABM or campaign play.

 - Partner with SDR leadership to design outreach sequences that complement ABM and campaign touches rather than running in parallel.

 - Serve as a central point of contact for campaign status, risks, changes, and follow-up readiness.

 - Hold regular performance reviews with Sales, SDR, Demand Generation, and Marketing Operations leadership covering account engagement, meetings, pipeline influence, stage progression, and ROI.




CAMPAIGN OPERATIONS AND SYSTEMS

 - Ensure campaigns, webinars, ABM plays, and events are correctly built and tracked in project management tools, Salesforce, and the marketing automation platform.

 - Partner with Marketing Operations to maintain consistent campaign hierarchy, naming, UTM structure, campaign membership, account and contact segmentation, lifecycle tracking, and attribution.

 - Build repeatable workflows for campaign intake, audience creation, execution QA, launch readiness, follow-up, and post-program analysis.

 - Monitor data quality and troubleshoot issues across Salesforce, Pardot or Marketo, webinar platforms, ABM tools, and related systems.

 - Identify workflow bottlenecks and implement process improvements that increase team velocity without sacrificing accuracy.

 - Use AI and automation to improve campaign planning, account research, workflow execution, troubleshooting, documentation, and reporting.

 - Maintain organized campaign, account-plan, timeline, and performance documentation as the team scales.




MEASUREMENT AND OPTIMIZATION

 - Define and own ABM and campaign KPIs, including account engagement rate, buying-group coverage, registrations, attendance, meetings booked, pipeline generated, pipeline influenced, stage progression, conversion, velocity, and ROI.

 - Build and maintain reporting that gives leadership visibility into performance at the account, campaign, channel, regional, and program levels.

 - Partner with Marketing Operations and Analytics to ensure data quality and actionable reporting.

 - Analyze account, campaign, webinar, and funnel performance to identify trends, gaps, anomalies, and opportunities.

 - Distinguish activity metrics from meaningful business outcomes and use that analysis to guide program decisions.

 - Continuously test and optimize messaging, channels, offers, sequencing, webinar formats, and account selection.

 - Turn program learnings into repeatable playbooks and recommendations for the broader marketing organization.




CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION AND LEADERSHIP

 - Work closely with Demand Generation, Campaigns, Customer Marketing, Field Marketing, Product Marketing, Digital, Partner Marketing, Marketing Operations, SDR/BDR leadership, Sales, Finance, and regional teams.

 - Lead cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and competing priorities.

 - Create clarity around roles, decision rights, handoffs, timelines, and success measures.

 - Communicate plans, status, risks, and results clearly to both working teams and senior stakeholders.

 - Influence without direct authority by bringing structure, data, clear recommendations, and reliable follow-through.

 - Mentor peers and help establish stronger campaign, ABM, webinar, and operating practices across the Marketing organization.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 6+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a focus on ABM, campaign management, demand generation, or integrated marketing programs in a high-growth SaaS or technology company.

 - Proven track record designing and executing ABM programs that generate measurable pipeline and accelerate deal velocity.

 - Demonstrated ownership of integrated campaigns or programs from strategy and planning through execution, follow-up, reporting, and optimization.

 - Hands-on experience managing campaigns in a project management system such as Asana, Monday.com http://Monday.com, Wrike, Jira, or similar.

 - Strong experience planning and executing webinars or virtual events across multiple regions and time zones.

 - Experience with ABM and intent technology such as 6sense, Bombora, Influ2, ZoomInfo, or equivalent platforms.

 - Experience with direct mail and gifting platforms such as Reachdesk or equivalent tools.

 - Strong command of Salesforce for campaign setup, campaign membership, account-level pipeline tracking, attribution, and reporting.

 - Familiarity with Pardot, Marketo, HubSpot, or another marketing automation platform.

 - Ability to build buying-group maps, account engagement plans, tiered plays, campaign briefs, project plans, and measurement frameworks from scratch.

 - Strong understanding of lead and account lifecycle management, segmentation, campaign tracking, attribution, and funnel measurement.

 - Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple account plays, campaigns, webinars, stakeholders, and deadlines without losing clarity or momentum.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly summarize plans, status, risks, and results.

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to balance input from multiple stakeholders while maintaining clarity and accountability.

 - Ability to operate independently, create structure in an evolving environment, and influence without direct authority.

 - Comfort working with complex technical subject matter and translating it into account-relevant messaging for CISOs, security architects, IT, and SecOps practitioners.




WHAT SETS YOU APART?

 - Experience in cybersecurity, DevSecOps, cloud security, or another highly technical B2B SaaS environment.

 - Experience coordinating global programs across AMER, EMEA, and APJ and adapting programs for regional needs.

 - Familiarity with webinar platforms such as Zoom, ON24, GoToWebinar, or similar.

 - Experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager for account-targeted paid programs.

 - Experience supporting Federal or Public Sector ABM or campaign motions.

 - Experience creating ABM playbooks, campaign governance models, or repeatable operating processes.

 - Experience using AI tools or automation to improve campaign execution, account research, troubleshooting, or productivity.

 - Familiarity with Tableau, Power BI, or advanced reporting techniques.



Travel Required

We are a fully remote company. This role may require minimal travel for internal offsites. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

 

Perks of Horizon3

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

jobs.title: Aircraft Maintenance Controller
jobs.description:
Stratolaunch is a technology accelerator that engineers operationally realistic testing at Mach 5+. Our air-launched, Talon testbeds are reusable, cost-effective platforms that enable routine access to the hypersonic environment. We deliver flight data critical to validating system performance and achieving rapid technology deployment. Together with our customers, we drive innovations that are imperative to advancing national security.

The Aircraft Maintenance Controller (Flight Test & Operations) serves as the central point of coordination for all maintenance activities supporting flight test programs and special operations. This role ensures experimental and production aircraft are maintained in a safe, airworthy, and mission-ready condition by coordinating scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, Modifications, and any other issues in real time, and maintaining close coordination with flight test crews, Program managers, and engineering teams. The controller facilitates timely execution of maintenance by supporting the organization successfully through dynamic test schedules, rapid configuration changes, and operational availability.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

• Monitor and track the status of aircraft assigned to Maintenance / Operations department

• Provide real-time Updates on aircraft status and tasking to programs and management.

• Coordinate rapid maintenance actions to support high-tempo test schedules, including quick-turn inspections and configuration changes.

• Ensure all maintenance performed is documented and aligned with engineering test requirements and regulatory guidance.

• Assist in planning of ground test, taxi test, and flight test events by ensuring aircraft readiness through support of Crew chiefs / Ground operations leads / Engineering

• Coordinate both planned and unscheduled maintenance around evolving test schedules.

• Develop and manage short- and mid-range maintenance forecasts to align with program milestones.

• Balance resources across multiple test aircraft and facilities to minimize downtime and maximize availability.

• Plan and coordinate Parts ordering and delivery, tooling, and outside vendors.

• Serve as the central communication link between engineers, pilots, maintenance crews, and operations.

• Provide timely updates to leadership on aircraft readiness, discrepancies, and recovery actions.

• Coordinate with engineering for resolution of discrepancies, modifications, or test-specific requirements.

• Work closely with supply chain/logistics to ensure parts availability for mission-critical repairs.

• Ensure compliance with FAA experimental regulations, company policies, and engineering requirements.

• Maintain accurate and timely records of maintenance actions and configuration changes in the tracking system.

• Assist in documentation of conformity inspections and configuration control for flight test instrumentation.

• Support audits, conformity checks, and engineering review boards as required.

• Promote strict adherence to safety, FOD, and tool control practices during flight test operations.

• Participate in incident/accident investigations and contribute to root cause analysis for corrective actions.

• Support continuous improvement of maintenance processes tailored to the unique demands of test programs.

• Integrate New maintenance / repair / and overhaul (MRO) software across all aircraft as they are delivered.

QUALIFICATIONS

• FAA Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) certificate. (preferred)

• Minimum [5+] years of experience in aircraft maintenance, preferably with flight test or experimental programs.

• Strong knowledge of aircraft industry standard Maintenance scheduling practices.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, test requirements, and experimental work instructions.

• Excellent troubleshooting and decision-making skills under dynamic, high-pressure conditions.

• Proficiency in maintenance tracking systems.

• Experience in staffing assignments and deconfliction of competing priorities

• Proficiency with Microsoft project, Visio, and all other common Microsoft 365 / Microsoft office applications

• Team player with exceptional interpersonal skills

• Self motivated to accomplish tasking with a high degree of accuracy.

• This role required utmost organizational skills to maintain a standardized daily product.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

• A&P license (preferred)

• IA (Preferred but not required)

• Flight line or flight test experience (Preferred)

• 5+ years in aviation field dealing with aspects of this positions responsibilities

Special remarks regarding work environment, if applicable

• This position is in Mojave, CA

• Occasional night / Weekend overtime work

• Must use a computer for extended periods and access operational work areas, with or without reasonable accommodation. Follow site safety requirements and use required PPE around noise, weather, and moving equipment.

• Ability and willingness to support flexible or off-shift hours and weekends when operational needs dictate; occasional mission travel may be required.

• 4/10 Schedule

• 2-5 years relevant experience: $71,000-$86,000

• 5+ years relevant experience: $82,000-$101,000

• Eligible for up to 10% annual bonus

Base salary and leveling are established on a case-by-case basis. We consider several factors to ensure a competitive offer, including your location, educational background, and a comprehensive assessment of the skills and experience demonstrated during your interviews.

Benefits and our location(s):

• Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)

• Paid Maternity and Parental Leave

• 50% company match per contributed dollar into 401(k) savings plan, up to $11,500

• Tuition reimbursement

This position may involve the operation of company vehicles as part of assigned duties.

Mojave Air & Spaceport is located just outside of Lancaster/Palmdale and is only 95 miles north of Los Angeles.  The area offers both affordability and central access to a variety of California's best attractions and landmarks.

Not much for the outdoors and prefer the city life? You’re within a half day’s drive or less of Los Angeles, San Diego, Las Vegas, and San Francisco where you can find a variety of live entertainment, museums, tours, and historical sight-seeing. Theme parks are in abundance, with Six Flags Magic Mountain, Disneyland, and Knotts Berry Farm ready to meet the needs of rollercoaster thrill seekers.

Food and drink fanatics are in a haven of delectable choices. Wine aficionados will also find easy access to some of the state’s best vino in Paso Robles, Santa Ynez, and even more locally in Tehachapi and Agua Dulce. Beer fanatics will find some of the best West Coast IPAs at Bravery and Lucky Luke’s in Lancaster. Any food option you crave is covered, and we always recommend the authentic and fresh Mexican food that you won’t find anywhere else in the United States.

jobs.title: Semiconductor Power Component Architect
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Power Component Architect (PCA) to join our silicon carbide (SiC) product release team in Roseville, CA. As a PCA, you will play a critical role in releasing our SiC PowerMOSFET technology and products and scaling them series production. These devices are mainly used for automotive applications, such as traction inverters, and will be used by both internal and external customers. By working with Bosch on the engineering process of these devices, you will work on the forefront of tomorrow’s technology for e-Mobility, such as (plug-in) hybrid and electrical vehicles.

As PCA, you will work in teams and projects consisting of different disciplines, such as lab characterization, device fabrication, semiconductor operations, customer interfaces and wide-bandgap technologies. Therefore, a good understanding of different physical aspects of SiC PowerMOSFET devices and wide-bandgap concepts are highly advantageous. As well as the capability to understand the physical working mechanisms and their implications on the final application. During your work, you will be at the forefront of bringing cutting-edge SiC technologies for power electronics from concept phase into series production.

Core responsibilities

• Enable Technology Transfers: Partner closely with the Center of Competence in Germany, to drive the performance assessment semiconductor technologies that are transferred to our US manufacturing facility.
• Derive Technical Specifications: Coordinate engineering sample build-ups, characterization and reliability testing. Drive the derivation and definition of Silicon Carbide (SiC) product specifications utilizing deep knowledge of power MOSFET testing concepts, leveraging statistical analysis and numerical simulations to establish robust datasheet limits, and securing alignment and formal sign-offs from internal and external stakeholders. Define a series testing concept to safeguard these specifications over lifetime during production.
• Support New Product Introductions: Assist product release projects with introducing new product variants to fulfill customer requirements. This includes facilitating and supporting engineering activities between the foundry, characterization lab, and product managers to transition from sample production to series production.
• Manage Stakeholder Requirements: Autonomously define engineering deliverables and drive alignment across multi-disciplinary teams, including project management, foundry partners, characterization labs, product managers, and customers, ensuring all technical and commercial requirements are balanced to meet aggressive project schedules.
• Support on technical focus topics, and establish and maintain engineering methods and structures, both during the development- and series manufacturing phase.

• B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a related technical field.
• Analytical Mindset: Capability to break down complex, multi-domain problems into structured, logical, and actionable architectural approaches.
• Sound knowledge of semiconductor device concepts and physics thereof including characterization.
• Communicative team player with the ability to coordinate teams and a high degree of willingness to work across departments in an international environment.
• Proven experience in the application of statistical data analysis to solve complex technical problems.
• Direct, hands-on experience utilizing Python, MATLAB, or equivalent scripting languages to analyze large, complex datasets and automate engineering workflows.
• Ability to evaluate complex technical trade-offs (e.g., performance vs. cost) and proactively mitigate project risks before they impact customer deliverables.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, incl. technical documentation skills, with a track record of collaborating effectively across global, cross-functional organizations.
• Preferred Qualifications
• Travel (including internationally) as needed.
• 1-3 years of hands-on experience in semiconductor device, process, product, or foundry engineering.
• Experience with electrical laboratory measurements and its challenges and limitations.

• This role will be working on-site in Roseville, CA.
• This position is on Monday-Friday, additional hours as necessary.
• Indefinite US work authorized individuals only. Future sponsorship for work authorization is unavailable.

About Bosch

BOSCH is a proud supporter of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering & Mathematics) Initiatives:

• FIRST Robotics (For Inspiration and Recognition of Science and Technology)
• AWIM (A World In Motion)

By choice, we are committed to a diverse workforce – EOE/Protected Veteran/Disabled.

jobs.description:

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.




THE ROLE 

Legora is scaling quickly, and our Revenue Accounting team is growing with it. We're looking for a Revenue Accountant to support revenue recognition and commissions accounting day to day: reviewing contracts, maintaining revenue and commission schedules, and keeping the revenue close accurate and on time. You'll work closely with the Revenue Accounting team, Billing, Sales, and RevOps, and you'll have real exposure to complex enterprise contracts and a growing, multi-entity business.

Nice to have

jobs.title: Financial Planning & Analysis Manager
jobs.description:
Rhombus Power, Inc. delivers AI-powered predictive intelligence in real time for defense and national security organizations worldwide. Our mission-built products— Ambient AI and Guardian— are transforming strategic, operational, and tactical decision-making. By empowering the shift from reactive analysis to proactive, predictive intelligence and decision support, Rhombus Power is providing foresight and freedom of action when it matters most.

Come join our cross-disciplinary and world-class team that is delivering game-changing solutions to transform global security.

Learn more about Rhombus Power, Inc. and watch a demonstration of Guardian, our AI Platform here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3PxY6su1Q-Q

https://www.youtube.com/@rhombuspower8558/videos

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Iby5WVNfQiI

See the following articles to learn more about what we do:

https://www.rhombuspower.com/news-and-media

Job Description

Rhombus Power seeks a hands-on, ownership-minded FP&A professional to help build financial models, reporting, forecasting, and planning processes that support our next stage of growth.

Our business combines software subscriptions with customer implementation, deployment, and support across commercial and government environments. You will help leadership understand how revenue, delivery costs, hiring, and contract timing affect profitability and cash—and turn that understanding into actionable investment decisions.

This is an ownership role within a small but robust team, with substantial ownership from data collection through recommendations. You need to bring established FP&A skills, enjoy building with limited infrastructure, and be comfortable moving between detailed analysis and practical business decisions, all within a fast-paced environment.

Please note that this is a HQ-based role with a 4 days/week onsite policy in our Palo Alto office. Please do not apply if you cannot meet this requirement.

What You’ll Own:

Budgeting, Forecasting & Modeling

• Assist in the creation, maintenance, and execution of the annual corporate budget, partnering with department leaders on revenue, headcount, infrastructure, and operating expenses.

• Update and maintain monthly and quarterly rolling forecasts using integrated three-statement models covering the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow.

• Build driver-based forecasts connecting sales pipeline, contract start dates, implementation schedules, renewals, and expansion to financial performance.

• Perform scenario analysis and financial modeling to stress-test growth assumptions, including delayed awards, longer sales cycles, customer concentration, and accelerated hiring.

Revenue

• Maintain clear visibility into bookings, annual recurring revenue (ARR), recognized revenue, billings, and cash collections, distinguishing recurring software revenue from implementation and services.

• Partner with Sales and customer teams to forecast renewals, expansion, churn, and pipeline conversion; explain changes in revenue performance and forecast confidence.

• Incorporate government contract funding, periods of performance, option-year assumptions, award timing, and invoicing milestones into forecasts.

• Distinguish funded commitments from potential contract value, and model the cash and resource implications of procurement or payment delays.

• Support contract and deal reviews with pricing, margin, payment-term, and delivery-cost analysis.

Monthly Variance Analysis

• Conduct monthly actual-versus-budget and actual-versus-forecast variance analysis, explaining underlying drivers and identifying actions for business owners.

• Review general ledger details to identify misclassifications or unexpected spending trends, partnering with Accounting to resolve discrepancies.

• Track corporate cash burn, working capital metrics, and primary efficiency ratios on a daily or weekly cadence, as appropriate.

• Maintain workforce models covering approved positions, hiring dates, compensation, benefits, contractors, and vacancies; partner with Recruiting and department leaders to keep assumptions current.

Financial Reporting & Dashboarding

• Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reviews that explain performance, forecast changes, and emerging risks in clear business terms.

• Build, update, and maintain business intelligence (BI) dashboards tracking financial and operational key performance indicators (KPIs).

• Provide data-driven schedules, trend charts, and commentary for monthly business review decks and support board reporting.

Systems

• Clean and structure historical operational datasets to improve forecasting precision.

• Support development projects, ROI analyses, pricing reviews, and unit economics updates, including product investments and expansion opportunities.

• Identify and implement ways to automate manual data collection workflows and recurring reporting.

• Help build the FP&A function’s core models, planning calendar, reporting standards, and tools, introducing useful structure as business needs evolve.

What You Bring

• Approximately 3-5 years of relevant experience, including direct responsibility for budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and variance analysis, preferably in a small or midsize B2B SaaS company. Candidates with specific experience working in enterprise sales cycles or meaningful implementation and delivery costs is ideal.

• Experience working on lean teams, with personal ownership from gathering inputs and building models through presenting findings and following up with business owners and executives alike.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, experience building integrated three-statement and driver-based models, and strong accounting fundamentals.

• An understanding of SaaS revenue mechanics and metrics, including ARR, retention, bookings, revenue recognition, and gross margin.

• Experience developing BI dashboards and reconciling financial and operational datasets; SQL and workflow automation skills are a plus.

• Demonstrated ability to build planning models, reporting, or processes from scratch and translate incomplete information into clearly documented assumptions.

• Creative problem-solving, flexibility, and sound judgment: you can adapt quickly while preserving accuracy, checking your work, and making uncertainty visible.

• Strong communication skills and the confidence to question assumptions constructively with technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders.

Helpful Additional Experience

• Exposure to government-facing software businesses, federal procurement cycles, or contract-level financial analysis.

• Experience forecasting cloud or AI infrastructure costs, deployment economics, or customer-level profitability.

Salary

• This position has a salary range of $110,000 to $140,000. Final salary will be determined based on experience and qualifications.

Benefits

• Full medical, dental, vision coverage for employee and dependents

• 401k matching program

• PTO and Holidays

• Bonus and other incentive programs

• Access to mental health program

• Access to Flexible Spending Accounts for Health Care, Dependent and Commuter

About Rhombus

Rhombus Power Inc. (Rhombus) is a startup located in the heart of Silicon Valley at Stanford Research Park in Palo Alto. We use cutting-edge cross-disciplinary approaches to solve pressing Big Data and Sensing problems in security, energy, and healthcare. Our advisory board includes two Nobel Laureates and a Draper Prize winner.

Rhombus compensates, motivates, and develops employees, who are trusted, empowered, and involved. Employees have clear roles and expectations – and their roles are flexible enough to move at the speed of innovation in order to meet and exceed client expectations. We have a unique culture of global purpose, rooted in the innovation and progress of Silicon Valley.

Rhombus knows that diversity is a condition for success. We are committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Marketing at Brex

Marketing tells the story of Brex to the world. From acquisition to activation, we translate product value into business results. Our team spans Revenue, Product, and Brand Marketing, and works closely with nearly every function at Brex. We move fast, experiment often, and think deeply about customer behavior. If you want your creativity to drive growth and shape perception, this is the place.

What you'll do

Brex is looking for a strategic, data-driven Senior Field Marketing Manager to build and lead the field marketing motion for our Commercial segment.

Commercial represents one of Brex's largest growth opportunities. This role will be responsible for developing the segment strategy, identifying the markets and audiences with the greatest potential, and creating integrated programs that generate new pipeline and accelerate existing opportunities.

You will operate as the marketing lead for the Commercial business, partnering closely with Sales to understand their goals, test new approaches, and build repeatable programs that can scale. Your campaigns may include executive and customer events, industry programs, direct mail, digital experiences, partner activations, webinars, account-based plays, and other creative approaches.

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial judgment with hands-on execution. You are comfortable analyzing pipeline and campaign performance, presenting to Sales leadership, and managing multiple campaigns and stakeholders.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our Seattle office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

• Own the field marketing strategy, annual plan, budget, and pipeline goals for the Commercial segment

• Partner with Commercial Sales leadership and set the planning rhythm across Marketing, Sales, and SDR

• Analyze account, pipeline, industry, geographic, and performance data to identify the highest-potential audiences

• Build integrated campaigns that combine in-person, digital, partner, content, direct mail, and account-based tactics

• Shape event strategy, from regional programs to targeted dinners. For larger experiences, partner with the Events team while owning the audience, objective, Sales plan, and pipeline outcome

• Test new campaign ideas, define success upfront, and turn what works into repeatable plays and documented playbooks

• Track results (pipeline, conversion, ROI) and present them to senior Marketing and Sales leaders

Requirements

• 7+ years of experience in B2B field marketing, demand gen, account-based marketing, or a related role, ideally in SaaS, fintech, or another high-growth technology company

• Experience owning marketing strategy for a defined customer segment, region, industry, or sales organization

• A track record of sourcing and accelerating pipeline through integrated programs

• A strong understanding of the B2B sales cycle and the ability to translate Sales priorities into focused marketing strategies

• Fluency in marketing and pipeline metrics, including the ability to analyze campaign performance, diagnose gaps, and clearly explain results

• Strong project management and executive communication skills, with comfort juggling multiple programs in a fast-paced environment

• Willingness to travel up to 40% for events, Sales meetings, and customer programs

Bonus points

• Experience building a field marketing motion or entering an underdeveloped segment

• Experience marketing to companies in the Commercial or emerging mid-market segment

• Familiarity with finance, fintech, spend, payments, ERP, or procurement audiences

• Experience using Salesforce and marketing analytics platforms to assess funnel performance and campaign impact

• Experience developing a business case for additional investment or team growth based on demonstrated results

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $131,000 - $163,000. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance.  Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer II - Mission Architecture
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR SYSTEMS ENGINEER II – MISSION ARCHITECTURE

Based out of Rocket Lab's global headquarters in Long Beach, CA the Senior Systems Engineer is responsible for leading the formulation of all new satellite systems, supporting capture of new civil, national security, and commercial business. You will manage the development and maintenance of technical budgets, requirements definition, test planning and execution, and overall management of the systems engineering process, including validation of customer requirements. You will support the Vice President of Business Development and Strategy and the broader Space Systems Business Development organization, with deliverables required for internal leadership, board of directors, and investors.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

• Lead Rocket Lab’s satellite engineering formulation supporting business development and new opportunity capture

• Develop and maintain:

• Technical budgets for vehicle performance

• System requirements and verification techniques

• Simulations and analysis across vehicle functions

• Test methods and data analysis

• Lead and own technical development of spacecraft missions

• Assist with program and product management

• Develop, in collaboration with team members, interface specifications, CONOPS definition, and other design documents

• Work directly with customers and our internal leadership team to shape requirements and write the core architecture for key proposals

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering (software, computer, electrical, aerospace, mechanical, or other technical engineering discipline)

• 8+ years of experience in the aerospace industry

• Experience supporting satellite and/or spacecraft development programs

• Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance

• US citizenship is required, due to program requirements

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Active TS/SCI clearance

• Master’s or PhD in engineering (software, computer, electrical, aerospace, mechanical, or other technical engineering discipline)

• Understanding of key spacecraft subsystems and their associated components, including: attitude determination and control (ADCS), electrical power systems (EPS), space-ground communications, on-orbit command and data handling (C&DH), and thermal control

• Thorough understanding of the space environment, orbital mechanics, and rigid body dynamics

• Highly effective and professional verbal and written communication skills with team and internal/external customers

• Previous experience with proposals and tech volume authorship

• Experience with MATLAB, Python, and STK

• Experience with CAD modeling and drawing

• Experience with requirement management tools such as JAMA or DOORS

• Experience with satellite operations

• Ability to work in a dynamic environment with competing priorities

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Total Compensation (base and equity)

$209,000—$255,000 USD

Base Salary

$132,000—$198,000 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com.This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant.  These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality.  For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Campaign Manager, Federal
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Sr. Campaigns Manager, Federal to own integrated campaigns for Horizon3's Federal and Public Sector business: civilian agencies, the DoD, the Defense Industrial Base, and SLED. You will build campaigns that fit how government buys, including budget cycles, procurement vehicles, compliance mandates, and partner-led sales, and hold them to the same pipeline ROI standard as the commercial business.

You will report to the Director, Marketing Campaigns & Operations and work in close partnership with Federal sales leadership, the Sr. Federal Field Marketing Manager, channel field marketing, Carahsoft, and Federal channel partners. Your job is to put Horizon3's strongest Federal proof points, including FedRAMP High authorization and NSA CAPT program participation, in front of the right agencies and programs in the right format.

This role requires someone who understands how the Federal government buys, how Defense Industrial Base suppliers operate, and how to design campaigns that work within procurement cycles and compliance constraints.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Federal Campaign Strategy and Planning

 - Own the Federal campaign plan, aligned to the Federal fiscal year, agency budget and procurement cycles, and Federal sales territory priorities.

 - Segment the market across civilian agencies, DoD, DIB suppliers, and SLED, and build target agency and account lists with Federal sales leadership.

 - Map buying groups for priority agencies and programs, including security and IT leadership, program offices, and the partners and integrators who influence the buy.

 - Write campaign briefs with mandate-driven themes that matter to each segment: CISA KEV rapid response, CMMC compliance for the DIB, FedRAMP, and continuous security validation at scale.



Campaign Execution

 - Build and run multi-channel Federal campaigns across email and nurture, paid and contact-level advertising, webinars, content, and Federal media and associations.

 - Run agency-level and program-level campaign plays with coordinated SDR and partner seller outreach, designed within Federal gift and ethics rules.

 - Coordinate with the Sr. Federal Field Marketing Manager so campaigns surround field programs before and after, rather than running beside them.

 - Partner with product marketing on Federal messaging and content, including compliance mapping, capability briefs, and public sector proof points.



Partner and Channel Campaigns

 - Work with channel field marketing, Carahsoft, and Federal resellers and systems integrators on partner-led demand generation, joint webinars, and co-branded campaigns.

 - Manage partner campaign funds as an investment with an expected pipeline return.



Sales Alignment and Measurement

 - Serve as the campaigns partner to Federal sales leadership, with a shared view of target agencies, engagement signals, and next actions.

 - Define Federal campaign KPIs that account for long sales cycles: agency engagement, meetings booked, pipeline sourced and influenced, CPO, and stage progression.

 - Work with marketing operations so Federal campaign activity is attributed correctly in Salesforce.

 - Report results to demand generation and Federal sales leadership with clear recommendations on what to scale and what to cut.

 - Mentor other marketers on the Federal buyer. This role has no direct reports.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 6+ years of B2B campaign, demand generation, or ABM experience, with meaningful time marketing to the Federal or Public Sector market.

 - Demonstrated understanding of how the Federal government buys, including agency budget cycles, procurement constraints, compliance frameworks, and partner-led sales motions.

 - Experience running campaigns across at least two of the following segments: civilian agencies, DoD, Defense Industrial Base, or SLED.

 - Proven track record driving pipeline through Federal campaigns, with the data to back it up.

 - Experience working with Federal channel partners, distributors, and systems integrators on co-marketing programs.

 - Familiarity with Federal compliance frameworks relevant to cybersecurity, including FedRAMP, CMMC, FISMA, and CISA KEV, and the ability to turn them into campaign themes that resonate with agency and DIB audiences.

 - Strong command of Salesforce for campaign attribution and account-level pipeline tracking, and experience with marketing automation (Pardot, Marketo, or HubSpot).

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Federal sales, channel, SDR teams, field marketing, and product marketing.




WHAT SETS YOU APART?

 - Experience in cybersecurity, DevSecOps, or adjacent B2B security markets with a Federal focus.

 - Familiarity with Carahsoft and the broader Federal distribution ecosystem.

 - Background in or direct exposure to the Defense Industrial Base.

 - Hands-on experience with ABM and intent tools such as ZoomInfo, Influ2, and Reachdesk or Sendoso in support of Federal account coverage.

 - Based in the Washington D.C. metro area.




TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

This role requires up to 25% travel for Federal sales alignment, partner planning, key industry events, and internal offsites. Travel will be concentrated in the Washington D.C. metro area. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

 

Perks of Horizon3

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.



Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

 - Base salary range: $145,000 - $185,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

 - Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.



You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.



Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 



Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

jobs.title: Laboratory Supervisor
jobs.description:
Are you a passionate scientist who thrives on developing people, improving processes, and delivering exceptional results? As a Laboratory Supervisor with the Eurofins Discovery ADMETox team, you'll lead a talented group of scientists, oversee critical laboratory operations, and ensure the successful execution of studies that support drug discovery and development. This is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact through both scientific leadership and team development.

Here's what you'll do:

• Lead daily laboratory operations, balancing people, equipment, schedules, and priorities to meet client commitments, quality standards, and turnaround expectations.
• Work hands-on alongside the team to support cell-based assays, high-content imaging, high-throughput screening, and related ADMET laboratory activities.
• Coach and develop laboratory staff through clear expectations, technical guidance, training, competency assessment, performance feedback, and career development.
• Forecast workload and resource needs; coordinate coverage and adjust priorities to maintain business continuity and on-time delivery.
• Ensure laboratory activities comply with approved procedures, quality requirements, client contracts, Environmental Health and Safety standards, and applicable regulations.
• Maintain strong document and data controls, including SOPs, batch records, study data, client deliverables, quality review, and record-retention requirements.
• Monitor performance metrics, identify risks and constraints, and lead practical process improvements that increase quality, productivity, and operational reliability.
• Manage and maintain a compliant BSL-2 cell-culture laboratory and promote aseptic technique, cleanroom practices, and a strong culture of safety.
• Oversee laboratory equipment and automation platforms, including evaluation, validation, qualification, maintenance, acquisition, implementation, and lifecycle planning.
• Manage laboratory supplies, inventory, storage, departmental expenses, rebilling support, and financial audit obligations.
• Partner with clients, Study/Technical Directors, Client Services, Product Management, and cross-functional teams on project planning, execution, reporting, interpretation, and issue resolution.
• Provide timely, decision-ready communication on project status, assay requirements, risks, constraints, and escalations to internal and external stakeholders.
• Support method development, portfolio expansion, site research and development objectives, and other strategic laboratory initiatives.

• The ideal candidate:
• Bachelor’s degree with 6 years of relevant experience; master’s degree with 4 years; or Ph.D. with 2 years.
• At least 3 years of direct experience with cell-based toxicology assays in a contract research organization or industry laboratory.
• Demonstrated experience leading laboratory operations and scientific teams, including workload planning, technical troubleshooting, training, and performance management.
• Experience leading client projects or contract research services from planning through execution and reporting.
• Experience developing, validating, or transferring bioanalytical methods in accordance with relevant FDA, ICH, or OECD guidance.
• Proven ability to lead laboratory troubleshooting, process improvement, and method or portfolio expansion in an industry setting.
• Experience leading cross-functional teams, projects, or process-excellence initiatives.
• Hands-on experience with LC-MS, LC-UV, high-throughput analytical method development, or high-resolution mass spectrometry in ADME/DMPK or biotherapeutics applications.
• Technical knowledge of metabolomics as applied to pharmaceutical drug metabolism.
• Project management experience and a track record of leading laboratory operations with limited oversight.

The position is full-time, Monday-Friday, 8 a.m.- 5 p.m., with overtime as needed. Candidates living within a commutable distance of St. Charles, MO are encouraged to apply.

• Excellent full time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
• Life and disability insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation and holidays

Eurofins USA Discovery Services is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Test Technician
jobs.description:
ICON is hiring Test Technicians to operate, build, troubleshoot, and repair the systems that prove out our technology, from fluid and electro-mechanical test stands in our Austin lab to Phoenix printers on active test builds in the field. You’ll work hands-on with PLCs, motion control, hydraulics, and electrical systems, partner with test and sustaining engineering, and document everything you touch. Level and team (Product Test or Printing Test) are determined by your experience and the needs of the business.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Set up, operate, and troubleshoot mechanical, fluid, electro-mechanical, and printer test systems.

• Build and maintain test infrastructure: test stands, fluid panels, electrical cabinets, PLC-controlled assemblies, and welded assemblies.

• Diagnose and repair using schematics, multimeters, and Beckhoff TwinCAT. Replace parts, calibrate, and work through root cause.

• Terminate and connect electrical, pneumatic, camlock, and EtherCAT cabling.

• Support on-site test builds and field operations, including material logistics, QC measurements, and build tracking (Procore).

• Log test data, ticket work, track downtime, and keep inventory and documentation accurate.

• Follow and uphold SOPs for safety and testing.

• Higher levels: lead shifts, coordinate and mentor other technicians, drive upgrades with engineering, and own proactive reporting.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalent; Associate’s in mechatronics, mechanical engineering technology, or related field preferred.

• Hands-on experience in mechanical, electrical, fluid, or manufacturing environments at the level’s required years (above). Technical certification, an Associate’s degree, or supervisory experience can offset years at Senior.

• Ability to read schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.

• Strong written and verbal communication and a collaborative approach under pressure.

• Ability to lift 50 lbs, stand and move for most of the day, climb ladders, and work outdoors in extreme heat, cold, rain, and mud, including sites without electricity.

• Willingness to travel outside Austin for multiple weeks at a time (required for Printing Test roles, occasional for Product Test) and flexibility for nights and weekends.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinarian - Manhattan Beach, CA
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Veterinarian, you’re more than just passionate about helping people and their pets; you thrive on it, especially when they need you most. At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Gather the signalment, presenting complaint, vitals, and physical exam

• Conduct physical examinations of animals, along with other required investigatory measures such as ultrasounds, X-rays, bloodwork, and biopsies

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Prepare estimates and present them to customers

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Perform minor and major emergency surgeries

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Educate customers on after care and preventative measures where appropriate

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM or equivalent degree

• Live and breathe emergency medicine, including emergency surgery (the soft tissue kind!) and endoscopy

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• The wage range for this role is $140,000.00 – $350,000.00 salary per year, inclusive of base salary and discretionary production bonus target. The expected base salary for this role is between $180,000.00 – $200,000.00 of this wage range.

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Principal Airframe Engineer - IPT Lead [AERO]
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Principal Airframe Engineer to lead airframe structural design and development for a Massed Modular Aircraft (MMA) program, supporting a platform architecture designed for low-cost, high-rate, distributed production. This role owns the airframe structural design approach from concept through qualification and production transition, with particular emphasis on modularity, producibility, and design-for-mass-manufacture principles that enable rapid, scalable build rates across multiple production sites or partners. The ideal candidate brings deep aircraft structures expertise combined with a strong producibility/manufacturing mindset suited to attritable, low-cost, or distributed-production aircraft concepts, rather than traditional low-rate, highly customized airframe programs.

Responsibilities:

• Lead the structural design and architecture of a modular airframe system, including primary and secondary structure, load paths, and major structural interfaces between modules/sections.

• Define and enforce a modular design architecture that supports interchangeable sections/subassemblies, common interfaces, and scalable configuration variants across the platform family.

• Own structural trade studies (material selection, joining methods, load path optimization) balancing performance, weight, cost, and producibility at scale.

• Ensure structural design integrates cleanly with propulsion, avionics, payload, and subsystem installations across modular interface boundaries.

• Apply design-for-manufacture and design-for-assembly (DFM/DFA) principles throughout the structural design process to enable high-rate, low-touch-labor production.

• Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to define producible joint designs, tooling concepts, and assembly sequences compatible with distributed or multi-site production.

• Drive design decisions that reduce part count, fastener count, and non-recurring tooling complexity without compromising structural integrity or certification/airworthiness requirements.

• Support make/buy and sourcing strategy discussions with Supply Chain to ensure structural designs are compatible with available/scalable material and fabrication sources.

• Lead or oversee structural analysis (static strength, fatigue/damage tolerance, dynamic loads) supporting design maturity and airworthiness substantiation.

• Define and execute the structural test program (coupon, element, component, and full-scale static/fatigue testing) required to substantiate the design.

• Support airworthiness qualification activities in accordance with applicable military airworthiness criteria (e.g., MIL-HDBK-516) and/or civil-derivative standards as applicable to the program's certification basis.

• Maintain structural analysis and substantiation documentation to support government and internal design reviews.

• Serve as the senior technical authority for airframe structures on the program, representing structures at Preliminary Design Review (PDR), Critical Design Review (CDR), and government technical interchange meetings.

• Partner with Systems Engineering, Program Management, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain to align structural design maturity with program schedule and cost targets.

• Identify and manage structural/technical risks, including material supply risk, fatigue/damage tolerance uncertainty, and producibility risk at scale.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related discipline; advanced degree preferred.

• 15+ years of aircraft structural/airframe design experience, including demonstrated ownership of structural design from concept through qualification/production.

• Strong background in structural analysis methods (static strength, fatigue, damage tolerance) and associated analysis tools (e.g., NASTRAN, FEMAP, or equivalent FEA tools).

• Demonstrated experience applying design-for-manufacture/design-for-assembly principles to reduce production cost and complexity at scale.

• Experience with composite and/or advanced joining methods (e.g., bonding, friction stir welding) suited to high-rate production.

• Experience supporting structural substantiation for military and/or civil airworthiness requirements.
