jobs.title: Firmware Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About the Firmware Team

The firmware team owns the embedded firmware on all of our microcontroller systems on our aircraft and delivery system. We range from the application layer to the platform and foundation it’s built on. Including bootloaders, RTOS integration, serial and ethernet communication, up to battery management and motor control.

The Role

Zipline aircraft depend on embedded firmware to execute critical flight and safety functions across a network of microcontrollers and embedded Linux computers. This software must perform reliably as aircraft move from manufacturing into delivery operations at field sites around the world, including locations that are difficult to access over a network.

You will own C++ firmware and supporting tools that are critical to the safety and operation of these systems. While making the system more observable and easier to diagnose at scale. Working alongside electrical, mechanical, embedded Linux, and systems engineers, you will turn hardware behavior and flight data into reliable, maintainable software for deployed aircraft.

What You'll Do

• Design and build C++ firmware for a distributed system of aircraft microcontrollers.

• Develop reliable Ethernet, serial, and other microcontroller communication interfaces.

• Define platform-level interfaces and reusable firmware components that support multiple aircraft subsystems.

• Own the predictable and reliable performance of our microcontroller systems and the communication buses that connect them, across startup, real-time operation, fault handling, and recovery.

• Optimize real-time behavior, including CPU utilization, memory usage, scheduling latency, timing jitter, and resource contention

• Develop metrics, monitoring and troubleshooting capabilities to prepare the system for field deployment at scale

• Develop Rust-based tooling and software-in-the-loop simulations to test and validate firmware behavior.

What You'll Bring

You are a person who:

• Is passionate about learning about firmware, realtime systems, Zipline’s aircraft and systems, and our mission.

• Has prior internship or design team experience.

• Has experience with writing C or C++.

• Has excellent grades in embedded systems classes.

It is expected that you will be onsite in South San Francisco 5 days / week for this internship. Rising seniors are preferred.

What Else You Should Know

Our internships are full-time positions, in-person at our South San Francisco. We will host our Summer 2027 interns from May to June/September.

Candidates are limited to three (3) applications within a 30-day period.

The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and working location. The total compensation package for each role may also include: a housing stipend; overtime pay; relocation support; paid sick time; and more.

jobs.title: Principal Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Principal Systems Engineer who will have a technical ownership of an autonomous Massed Modular Aircraft development program, holding end-to-end responsibility across the full program lifecycle — from concept definition and requirements development through design, integration, verification/validation, qualification, production transition, and in-service/sustainment support. This role requires deep command of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) practices using SysML, and the ability to establish and lead a model-centric development environment across a modular, multi-variant aircraft architecture. The ideal candidate combines strong systems engineering fundamentals with hands-on MBSE tooling experience and the leadership presence to drive technical decisions across a large, cross-functional engineering organization.

Responsibilities:

• Serve as the senior technical authority for systems engineering across all phases of the program: concept development, requirements definition, preliminary and critical design, integration and test, qualification, production transition, and in-service/sustainment support.

• Own the system architecture and requirements baseline for a modular aircraft platform, ensuring configurability and commonality across variants/mission modules while maintaining system-level integrity.

• Drive technical decision-making at major program reviews (SRR, SFR, PDR, CDR, TRR, qualification reviews) and own associated review packages and exit criteria.

• Partner with the Chief Engineer and Program Manager to balance technical, cost, and schedule trades across the lifecycle.

• Establish, govern, and continuously mature the program's MBSE environment using SysML, ensuring the system model serves as the authoritative source of truth for requirements, architecture, interfaces, and behavior.

• Define and enforce modeling standards, viewpoints, and model governance practices across a multi-disciplinary engineering team.

• Lead requirements decomposition and allocation from system-level down to subsystem and component levels within the model environment, maintaining full bidirectional traceability.

• Drive integration of the SysML model with digital engineering tools across the toolchain (e.g., requirements management, simulation, verification tracking, configuration management) to support a true digital thread/digital twin environment

• Define and maintain the modular system architecture, including interface control documents (ICDs) governing structural, electrical, data, and software interfaces between core airframe and mission/payload modules.

• Lead trade studies evaluating commonality vs. mission-specific optimization across module variants.

• Define the system-level verification and validation (V&V) strategy, ensuring full traceability from requirements through test/analysis/demonstration/inspection methods to verification closure.

• Lead integration of model-based verification artifacts (e.g., simulation-based verification, model execution/analysis) alongside traditional test-based verification.

• Support qualification planning and execution, ensuring the system design and supporting model artifacts meet contractual and regulatory certification/qualification requirements

• Partner closely with Configuration Management, Data Management, Program Scheduling, and Contracts functions to ensure systems engineering artifacts align with program baselines and contractual deliverables.

• Represent systems engineering in customer technical interchange meetings, program reviews, and audits.

• Support proposal efforts with systems engineering approach development, technical staffing plans, and MBSE implementation roadmaps for new business pursuits.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related discipline; advanced degree preferred.

• 15+ years of systems engineering experience within the aerospace/defense industry, including demonstrated ownership of a program across multiple lifecycle phases.

• Strong hands-on experience with MBSE practices and SysML modeling (e.g., using tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler/MagicDraw, Rhapsody, or equivalent).

• Demonstrated experience defining and governing system architectures for complex, multi-variant, or modular platforms.

• Strong understanding of systems engineering principles, including requirements management, architecture development, and verification/validation planning.

• Experience leading technical reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) and interfacing directly with government or commercial customers.

• Experience with model-based verification and simulation-driven V&V approaches.

Preferred Requirements:

• Direct experience with modular aircraft, unmanned aircraft systems (UAS), or multi-mission/multi-variant platform architectures.

• Experience establishing an MBSE environment and digital thread/digital twin capability on a new program from the ground up.

• Ability to obtain/maintain Secret/Top Secret/SCI clearance

Why CHAOS?

• Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

• Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

• Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

• Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

• Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

Salary Range: $198,000 - $320,000

jobs.title: Staff Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



As a Staff Technical Account Manager, you’ll join 1Password’s Technical Account Management team, helping customers realize long-term value from their investment through implementation, adoption, and ongoing technical guidance. You’ll support complex customer environments, advise on identity, access, device trust, and Software as a Service (SaaS) security, and help shape scalable practices that advance 1Password’s mission to create a safer, simpler digital future. This role reports to the Sr. Manager of Technical Account Management and Solution Architects.




How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.



This is a remote opportunity within the US;



Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.



What we're looking for:

 -  Required: 8+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, or Implementation Consultant, ideally in a SaaS or Business-to-Business (B2B) security environment.

 - Required: Experience leading technical onboarding and implementation conversations with technical and business stakeholders across complex customer environments.

 - Required: Strong communication, storytelling, and demonstration skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value.

 - Required: Experience with identity technologies and protocols, including Single Sign-On (SSO), Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), as well as security frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

 -  Required: Experience with SaaS products, cloud infrastructure, scripting or software development, DevOps practices, and tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and command-line interfaces.

 - Required: Ability to work autonomously in a remote-first environment, mentor peers, improve team practices, and collaborate effectively across functions.

 - Preferred: Experience with 1Password or other password managers, SaaS lifecycle management, Mobile Device Management (MDM), device posture tools, and advising customers on evolving artificial intelligence (AI) technologies.





What you can expect:

 - Own complex post-sale technical relationships, guiding customers from onboarding through adoption and renewal.

 - Lead technical implementations, including integrations, configuration, and security reviews.

 - Serve as a trusted technical advisor for strategic accounts and help customers achieve meaningful business outcomes.

 - Partner with Customer Success Managers to identify risks, support expansion opportunities, and maximize customer value.

 -  Represent the customer perspective internally while collaborating with Product, Marketing, Support, and other cross-functional teams.

 - Create and maintain scalable resources, playbooks, knowledge-base content, processes, and metrics.

 - Mentor team members, contribute to enablement, support team leadership activities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical challenges.



USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $143,000 USD and $207,00 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.


At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.



Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.



This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. 


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy 

 Growth and future 
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community 
🤝 Paid volunteer days 
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.



You belong here.



1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.



Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.



Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.



Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

jobs.title: Engagement Manager, Special Projects
jobs.description:
ABOUT GALLATIN

At Gallatin, we are rebuilding logistics infrastructure for the national security missions of the United States and allied partners. We build AI systems that determine how logistics decisions are made — not just how they're executed. From factory to foxhole, we operate at the layer where data becomes decisions, and decisions make the advantage.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring an Engagement Manager on our Special Projects Team to play a foundational role in helping our customers achieve success and become passionate, lifelong partners. As part of the team, you’ll own the account plan, care for our customers, and ensure an exceptional customer experience. You’re the ultimate all-rounder: a hybrid of Customer Success and Technical Project Manager who leads a cross-functional team to deliver value. Day to day, you’ll manage the customer relationship, deliver AI/ML solutions, align internal resources, manage subcontractors, and triage customer issues, all in service of delivering outsized value toward our customers’ AI/ML objectives.

You have a track record of operating and delivering in ambiguity and you are naturally empathetic and excel at building long-term relationships through diligent problem solving and thoughtful, strategic discussions.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Value Management
   
   - Oversee the delivery and implementation of Gallatin’s technologies for the customer, from onboarding through adoption as an everyday tool.
   
   - Lead a cross-functional project team to exceed the customer’s AI/ML objectives.
   
   - Build and execute a plan to deliver all project work above expectations and ahead of schedule.

 - Customer Management 
   
   - Manage customer relationships from end users to senior leadership.
   
   - Drive alignment between what Gallatin is building and the customer’s explicit and implicit priorities.

 - Contract Management
   
   - Identify and execute on opportunities to improve delivery motion.
   
   - Manage the long-term health of the customer base by identifying and preempting areas of risk or concern.
   
   - Strategically identify ways we can make customer success repeatable and solve issues for future customers.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Eligibility to obtain and maintain an active U.S. security clearance.

 - At least 6 years of work experience, including a customer-facing technical program management role in industry, professional services, engagement management, or government.

 - A technical background (education or professional experience in CS, Economics, Statistics, or Engineering).

 - Prior experience in logistics or sustainment operations.

 - A proven track record in B2B client-facing roles and growing client relationships.

 - Strong cross-functional experience and collaboration skills.

 - Familiarity with enterprise systems such as MAVEN and Advana.

 - Excellent verbal and written communication, with a track record of structured, analytics-driven problem solving.

 - Willingness to travel at least 50% of the time.



MISSION AND IDENTITY

We are building the system that enables faster, smarter logistics decisions in contested environments, and we're doing it with a team of seasoned entrepreneurs, operators, and technologists who have built and scaled solutions in this space before. We hold ourselves to an extremely high standard. We value clear thinking, direct communication, and the kind of ownership that doesn't stop until something actually works.

Our mission is to create decision advantage when the stakes are the highest. If we succeed, the system doesn't just run;  it gets smarter. We're not building AI for its own sake. We're building it because faster, smarter decisions in the most demanding environments on earth can't wait. If you want to work somewhere the stakes are real and the mission is urgent — you'll fit in here.




WHY GALLATIN?

The logistics infrastructure that supports America's warfighters and humanitarian disaster responders is overdue for transformation, and we are building it. From defense operations to disaster response, we're solving the hardest problems that keep missions moving when it matters most. Join a team where the mission is the point.

Compensation: Gallatin offers competitive compensation commensurate with experience. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to base salary, we offer a generous equity grant, full healthcare coverage, 401k, unlimited PTO, and the perks of working in a high-caliber, mission-driven environment.

jobs.description:
ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.




WHY APPLY

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity. As we scale, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the engineering organization and lead major technical initiatives.

Strong Team: Our founding team has experience from Citadel Securities, Meta, Google, Silver Lake, and Morgan Stanley — work alongside world-class engineers and researchers.






OVERVIEW

AfterQuery is hiring a Research Program Manager to run the operations behind its research programs: public benchmark releases, collaborations with academic and industry partners, and the research roadmap. You own the coordination, external relationships, and progress tracking that keep the program moving, and you are welcome to contribute to the research itself, from benchmark design to co-authoring publications.

This is a technical, hands-on role, not a pure coordination one. You will read results tables, run evals, sanity-check numbers before they go public, and turn loosely specified research needs into engineering and operational roadmaps. You will also be the program's voice to external partners, so clear writing and confident communication across researchers, executives, and academics are as important as technical fluency. You work daily with researchers, engineers, domain experts, and go-to-market partners.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Serve as the point of contact for collaborations with academic and industry partners, including fellowships, grants, and joint research projects, and run each from scoping through delivery.

 - Coordinate benchmark releases end to end, from launch checklist through publication, and keep releases on cadence.

 - Maintain AfterQuery's leaderboards and benchmark sites, and verify every result before it goes to a community leaderboard or publication.

 - Track progress across all active research projects. Anticipate resourcing gaps and technical bottlenecks, unblock projects that fall behind, and escalate with a clear recommendation when a timeline or scope needs to change.

 - Coordinate the expert pool for upcoming benchmarks: forecast expert needs, manage capacity, and keep contributor logistics running.

 - Write the program's external and internal communications: launch briefs, partner updates, planning documents, and status memos that turn technical detail into clear, actionable summaries.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 1-3+ years in research operations, technical program management, or a similar role in a fast-moving research or engineering organization.

 - Technical background in computer science, machine learning, statistics, or a related field, with working Python and SQL.

 - Evaluation literacy: you have taken part in evaluating a product, an agent, or a foundation model, can read a results table, and can tell when a number should not be trusted.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication. You can distill a technical result into a summary a partner, executive, or academic collaborator can act on, and you write documents people actually read.

 - A track record of running cross-functional programs end to end, including managing external partners, contractors, or collaborators.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and building processes from scratch, and the judgment to keep processes light so researchers stay effective.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Graduate degree or research experience in a technical field.

 - Contributed to a benchmark, dataset, or evaluation project in any role.

 - Familiarity with public leaderboards or open research communities.

 - Exposure to programs with external partners, such as fellowships, grants, or academic collaborations.

 - Exposure to expert or annotator pools, or other human-data work.

 - Comfort with lightweight dashboards or building small tools with AI assistants.

jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.
Role Overview:

The Contract Administrator will manage the full contract lifecycle for the Massed Modular Aircraft (MMA) program, supporting a portfolio that includes U.S. government (DoW) prime and subcontracts as well as potential Foreign Military Sales (FMS) and Direct Commercial Sales (DCS) contracts with international customers. This role serves as the primary contracts point of contact for assigned programs, ensuring compliance with the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR)/Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), and applicable international agreements, while proactively managing risk, obligations, and customer relationships throughout contract performance.

Responsibilities:

• Review, draft, negotiate, and administer a variety of contract types (FFP, CPFF, CPIF, T&M, IDIQ) for U.S. government prime contracts, subcontracts, and teaming agreements.

• Serve as primary point of contact for contract interpretation, modifications, and correspondence with government and commercial customers throughout the contract lifecycle.

• Prepare, negotiate, and administer non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), teaming agreements, and other pre-award instruments.

• Monitor and manage contract deliverables, milestones, funding, and performance obligations to ensure timely execution.

• Support contract administration for potential Foreign Military Sales (FMS) cases and Direct Commercial Sales (DCS) agreements, coordinating with Business Development, International Programs, and Export Control on structuring and compliance.

• Ensure compliance with ITAR, Export Administration Regulations (EAR), Technical Assistance Agreements (TAAs), Manufacturing License Agreements (MLAs), and applicable Letters of Offer and Acceptance (LOAs) for FMS cases.

• Coordinate with Export Control/Trade Compliance on export license applications, agreements, and country-specific restrictions tied to contract performance.

• Support international customer communications and negotiations in partnership with Business Development and Program Management, respecting offset requirements and country-specific contracting norms where applicable.

• Ensure contract actions comply with FAR/DFARS, agency supplements, corporate policy, and applicable public law.

• Identify, flag, and help resolve contractual risks (e.g., scope creep, funding gaps, IP/data rights issues, non-compliant terms) in coordination with Legal, Program Management, and Engineering.

• Support flow-down of prime contract terms and conditions to subcontracts and suppliers as applicable.

• Maintain accurate, audit-ready contract files and documentation in accordance with corporate records retention and government audit requirements (e.g., DCAA, DCMA).

• Partner with Program Management, Finance, Engineering, and Supply Chain to align contractual requirements with program execution, funding profiles, and technical baselines.

• Support proposal development by reviewing solicitations (RFPs/RFQs/RFIs), advising on terms and conditions, and coordinating contract-related proposal inputs.

• Track contract funding, incremental funding actions, and options; coordinate timely exercise or extension actions to avoid performance gaps.

• Support contract closeout activities, including final invoicing, deliverable reconciliation, and release of claims.

• Provide regular contract status reporting to program and functional leadership, highlighting risks, upcoming actions, and compliance issues.

• Prepare correspondence, contract modifications, and formal notices to customers and government contracting officers.

• Support internal training and awareness on contract terms, obligations, and compliance requirements for program teams.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, contract management, or related field.

• Minimum 10 years of contract administration experience within the defense/aerospace industry, including direct experience with U.S. government contracts (FAR/DFARS).

• Working knowledge of various contract types (FFP, CPFF, CPIF, T&M, IDIQ) and their administration requirements.

• Familiarity with export control regulations (ITAR/EAR) as they apply to contract structuring and performance.

• Strong negotiation, drafting, and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex contractual terms and flag risk.

• Experience with Foreign Military Sales (FMS) case administration, Letters of Offer and Acceptance (LOAs), or Direct Commercial Sales (DCS) international agreements.

• Experience with Technical Assistance Agreements (TAAs), Manufacturing License Agreements (MLAs), or other export authorizations.

Preferred Requirements:

• Direct experience supporting aircraft, UAS, and related weapons systems programs.

• Certification such as NCMA's Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM) or Certified Commercial Contracts Manager (CCCM).

• Ability to obtain/maintain Secret/Top Secret/SCI clearance

Why CHAOS?

• Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

• Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

• Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

• Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

• Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

Salary Range: $132000 - $225000

If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. jobs.description:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your impact on our mission

Our technology teams are the foundation of the products and experiences we build for patients and providers, and the talent we bring in directly shapes our trajectory. As a Senior Technical Recruiter, you will play a critical role in building high-performing Technology teams by owning complex searches, advising hiring managers, and delivering an efficient, highly personalized candidate experience.

You will serve as a trusted recruiting partner to engineering and technology leaders, bringing strong market knowledge, sound judgment, and a data-informed approach to every search. You will help streamline hiring processes, improve funnel conversion, and raise the talent bar across our Technology organization.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are…

• A Strategic Recruiting Partner: You view technical recruiting as a business problem to solve. You enjoy partnering with hiring teams to clarify role profiles, calibrate evaluation criteria, and build effective hiring plans.

• A Technical Talent Advocate: You understand how to engage highly sought-after technical candidates and create a thoughtful, credible, and personalized candidate experience throughout the process.

• A High-Velocity Problem Solver: You thrive in a fast-paced environment where you manage competing priorities, operate with autonomy, and proactively create order out of complex hiring demands.

• Passionate About Technical Talent & Metrics: You understand technical talent markets, role profiles, leveling, and candidate motivations. You use data to tell stories, manage pipelines, and influence hiring decisions.

• Grounded in Ownership and Humility: You hold yourself to a high standard, operate with low ego, and treat candidates, peers, and stakeholders with equal respect and dignity.

Your day-to-day is…

• Owning Technical Searches: Managing the full-cycle recruitment process for software engineering, infrastructure, data, security, product, and other technology roles—from intake and sourcing through closing and onboarding handoff.

• Advising Hiring Managers: Serving as a trusted advisor to engineering and technology leaders by providing market intelligence, setting realistic expectations, and recommending effective sourcing and assessment strategies.

• Building Strong Pipelines: Developing creative sourcing strategies and diverse talent slates for both active and anticipated hiring needs, while maintaining strong candidate engagement throughout the process.

• Improving Hiring Processes: Identifying bottlenecks and opportunities to improve interview workflows, candidate evaluation, decision-making, and overall hiring efficiency.

• Funnel Analytics & Pipeline Health: Using recruiting metrics—such as pass-through rates, time-in-stage, source effectiveness, and offer acceptance rates—to monitor pipeline health and communicate clear updates to partners.

• Creating an Inclusive Experience: Ensuring every candidate has equitable access to opportunities and an exceptional, transparent, and personalized experience at every step.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have…

• 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a strong focus on in-house technical recruiting across software engineering, infrastructure, data, security, product, or technology leadership.

• Technical Recruiting Expertise: Deep familiarity with technical roles, leveling, interview processes, candidate motivations, and competitive technology talent markets.

• Strong Stakeholder Partnership: Demonstrated ability to build trust, establish credibility, and effectively influence hiring managers and senior technology leaders.

• Candidate Closing Strength: A proven ability to assess candidate motivations, navigate objections, and close high-quality technical talent in competitive markets.

• Data & ATS Fluency: Experience using ATS tools such as Greenhouse or Lever and sourcing platforms such as LinkedIn Recruiter or Gem to track funnel metrics and drive data-informed decision-making.

• Process Improvement Mindset: A track record of identifying recruiting challenges and implementing practical solutions that improve speed, quality, or candidate experience.

• High Autonomy and Accountability: A proven ability to manage competing priorities, communicate clearly across distributed teams, and consistently deliver results independently.

• Commitment to Inclusive Hiring: A passion for building diverse teams and creating an equitable, respectful, and inclusive candidate experience.

Benefits

• Unlimited Vacation

• 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)

• Commuter Benefits

• 401(k) with employer funded match

• Corporate wellness program with Wellhub

• Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)

• Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement

• Cell phone reimbursement

• Catered lunch everyday along with beverages and snacks

• Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging

Base salary offered is determined by a number of factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills. Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay and/or equity; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. jobs.description:
Job Title: Vice President, Capital Campaigns & Other Campaigns

Department: Development

Location: Hybrid within Washington D.C. Metro area

Reports to: Chief Development Officer

Direct Reports: No

Classification: Exempt

Position type: Full-Time Employee

Anticipated Pay Range at Commencement of Employment: $128,000 - $177,000 per year

Blue Star Families

Blue Star Families is the largest nonprofit dedicated to making military life better for families. Each year, we support over 1.5 million military- and veteran-connected family members through a national network of 300,000+ members and local chapters in communities across the country.

Our mission is simple and bold: We make military life awesome for families.

We listen, share, partner, and act to deliver evidence-based, data-driven solutions that work for real people. We’re a lifestyle organization, a friend and neighbor, and a trusted partner. Our approach is collaborative, human-centered, and designed with the whole family in mind.

A Blue Star Family is one with an immediate family member — a spouse, parent, or child — actively serving in the U.S. Armed Forces, including the Guard and Reserves. These families face unique challenges: frequent relocations, deployments, career disruption, and isolation. We respond with research-informed programs that create connection, build resilience, and foster a true sense of belonging.

We serve with urgency but build trust over time — because change happens at the speed of trust. Whether we’re driving spouse employment, supporting caregivers, or helping communities welcome military families, we strive for upstream solutions.

Who We’re Looking For:

• Bold thinkers. Fast movers. Smart collaborators. People who want to build, lead, and drive measurable change — and who care deeply about making an impact that matters.

What You’ll Do Here:

• Solve complex challenges with data, heart, and humility

• Build cross-sector partnerships that get things done

• Help military families feel at home wherever they live

If you're ready to work in a high-performance, mission-driven environment — and to make life better for those who serve — Blue Star Families is where you belong.

General Description

The Vice President, Capital Campaigns & Other Campaigns leads the strategy, planning, and execution of Blue Star Families' capital campaign and other major, time-bound fundraising initiatives. Reporting to the Chief Development Officer, this role partners closely with the President, CEO, and Board leadership to build the case for support, structure campaign phases, and drive campaigns from feasibility through public phase and close-out.

This is a senior leadership role responsible for building the strategy, timelines, and stakeholder engagement plans a large-scale campaign requires, while also identifying and managing other significant campaigns—such as matching-gift challenges, emergency or rapid-response appeals, and signature anniversary or naming campaigns—as organizational priorities dictate.

This role requires the ability to travel overnight several times per year to attend team offsites, leadership sessions, donor meetings, and company-wide events. Attendance and participation in these gatherings is a non-negotiable component of the position.

Key Job Functions

Campaign Strategy & Planning

• Design and lead the strategic framework for the capital campaign and other major campaigns, including case-for-support development, campaign readiness assessment, and feasibility study coordination.

• Build gift-range charts, campaign timelines, and phase plans (quiet phase, leadership phase, public phase) aligned with organizational priorities and revenue goals.

• Partner with the Chief Development Officer to translate campaign strategy into clear, resourced execution plans: a game plan with defined goals, owners, and milestones.

Campaign Execution & Pipeline Management

• Manage moves-management activity for campaign prospects in partnership with Major Gifts and Development leadership, ensuring disciplined portfolio assignment and solicitation readiness.

jobs.title: Principal Mechanical Systems Engineer, IPT Lead
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Principal Mechanical Systems Engineer who will lead design and development of aircraft mechanical systems — including landing gear, doors/hatches/access panels, wheels and brakes, actuation mechanisms, and related mechanical subsystems — for a Massed Modular Aircraft (MMA) program. This role owns the mechanical systems design approach from concept through qualification and production transition, with emphasis on modularity, producibility, and design-for-mass-manufacture principles that support high-rate, distributed production. The ideal candidate brings broad aircraft mechanical systems expertise across multiple subsystem domains, combined with a strong producibility mindset suited to attritable, low-cost, or mass-producible aircraft concepts.

Responsibilities:

• Lead design and integration of aircraft mechanical systems, including:

• Landing gear (main and nose gear, retraction/extension mechanisms, shock absorption/struts, steering)

• Wheels, tires, and brake systems (including brake control and anti-skid considerations)

• Doors, hatches, access panels, and associated latching/locking mechanisms

• Actuation systems (electromechanical, hydraulic, or pneumatic as applicable) supporting flight control surfaces, doors, and landing gear

• Other mechanical subsystems as required (e.g., tow fittings, jacking points, ground handling provisions)

• Define and enforce a modular mechanical systems architecture with common interfaces, standardized attachment schemes, and interchangeable subassemblies across platform variants.

• Own mechanical system trade studies (actuation method, materials, kinematics) balancing performance, weight, reliability, cost, and producibility at scale.

• Ensure mechanical systems integrate cleanly with airframe structure, avionics, and flight controls across modular interface boundaries.

• Apply design-for-manufacture and design-for-assembly (DFM/DFA) principles to mechanical systems to enable high-rate, low-touch-labor production.

• Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to define producible mechanism designs, standardized components, and assembly/installation sequences compatible with distributed or multi-site production.

• Drive design decisions that reduce part count, unique fastener/hardware types, and non-recurring tooling complexity without compromising mechanical reliability or safety.

• Support make/buy and sourcing strategy discussions with Supply Chain, including identification of commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) or modified-COTS mechanical components where appropriate to reduce cost and lead time.

• Lead or oversee mechanical systems analysis, including kinematic/motion analysis, structural analysis of mechanism components, load analysis (landing gear ground loads, braking loads, door/latch loads), and reliability/durability analysis.

• Define and execute the mechanical systems test program (component, subsystem, and full-system functional, environmental, and endurance testing) required to substantiate the design.

• Support qualification activities in accordance with applicable military and/or civil-derivative standards relevant to landing gear, brakes, and mechanical systems (e.g., applicable MIL-STD/MIL-HDBK guidance, SAE Aerospace Recommended Practices).

• Serve as the senior technical authority for mechanical systems on the program, representing the discipline at Preliminary Design Review (PDR), Critical Design Review (CDR), and government technical interchange meetings.

• Partner with Systems Engineering, Structures, Avionics, Program Management, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain to align mechanical systems maturity with program schedule and cost targets.

• Identify and manage mechanical systems risks, including component supply risk, wear/durability uncertainty, and producibility risk at scale.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline; advanced degree preferred.

• 15+ years of aircraft mechanical systems design experience, including demonstrated ownership of one or more of the following: landing gear, brakes, doors/mechanisms, or actuation systems, from concept through qualification/production.

• Strong background in mechanism design, kinematic analysis, and structural/load analysis of mechanical components, with experience using relevant analysis tools (e.g., CAD-integrated motion simulation, FEA tools).

• Demonstrated experience applying design-for-manufacture/design-for-assembly principles to reduce production cost and complexity at scale.

• Experience supporting mechanical systems qualification/substantiation for military and/or civil-derivative requirements.

Preferred Requirements:

• Direct experience with modular aircraft, unmanned aircraft systems (UAS), or multi-mission/multi-variant platform architectures.

• Ability to obtain/maintain Secret/Top Secret/SCI clearance

Why CHAOS?

• Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

• Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

• Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

• Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

• Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

Salary Range: $198,000 - $300,000

The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.

Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.

Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Our purpose is to create autonomous technology that helps the real world work better. Brain's robotic and AI solutions help retailers ensure that the right product is on the right shelf at the right price, in a clean environment. Through the BrainOS® Robotics Platform, which powers the largest global fleet of the Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) in operation in commercial public spaces, Brain Corp delivers insightful and efficient automated solutions in both commercial floor cleaning and inventory management, empowering organizations and their employees to achieve more. Brain Corp currently powers more than 50,000 AMRs, representing the largest fleet of its kind in the world. Brain Corp is funded by the SoftBank Vision Fund, Clearbridge, and Qualcomm Ventures.

Named a top workplace by the San Diego Union Tribune and USA today in 2025, we make life-changing impacts through innovation, helping workers globally unlock their abilities in orchestration with intelligent machines.

Position Summary:

As an Electrical Engineer II on the Hardware Engineering team, you will play a hands-on role in bringing our next-generation autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) to life. You will be responsible for reviewing, testing, debugging, and refining board- and system-level electrical circuitry across the full product development lifecycle. Working closely with cross-functional teams and international Joint Design/Original Design Manufacturers (JDM/ODM), you will validate complex hardware architectures—including CPUs, MCUs, sensors, motor drivers, and power distribution systems—ensuring our robotic platforms meet high standards for reliability, safety, and performance in dynamic real-world environments.

Essential Job Functions:

• Test, debug and validate circuit designs incorporating specialized hardware devices such as CPUs, MCUs, cameras, analog and digital sensors, motor drivers etc.

• Perform board and system-level troubleshooting to identify functional issues and assist with implementing Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) for approved fixes

• Collaborate and support outsourced development partners on electrical hardware design, build and development activities

• Participate in electrical hardware development stages for complex products and platforms, contributing to design, validation, tooling, manufacturing support, and testing

Our fast-growing company is profitable and bootstrapped with a healthy run rate. We have a fully distributed and diverse 150-person team based in 16+ states and 23+ countries. In 2026, Donorbox was named by Built In as one of the Best Places to Work in Washington, DC.

🏅 Donorbox is rated the #1 software for fundraising, donor management, and nonprofit payment on G2 based on hundreds of verified customer reviews — a reflection of the care our team puts into building products that nonprofits trust.

The Role

The Support Trainer plays a pivotal role in scaling Customer Support and Operations capacity by delivering high-impact new hire training, internal team enablement, and client training support. jobs.title: Principal Avionics Systems Engineer, IPT Lead
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Principal Principal Avionics Systems Engineer who will own the end-to-end avionics architecture for the Massed Modular Aircraft (MMA) program — spanning onboard (air vehicle) avionics and the associated Ground Control Station (GCS) — for an unmanned aircraft system. This role carries single-threaded technical ownership of the avionics system across both segments, ensuring the onboard avionics and GCS are designed, developed, integrated, and qualified as a coherent, interoperable system rather than as separately managed efforts. The ideal candidate brings direct unmanned aircraft system (UAS) experience, a strong systems-level view of air vehicle/ground segment interaction, and a producibility mindset suited to a modular, mass-producible aircraft architecture.

Responsibilities:

• Own the overall avionics architecture spanning both the air vehicle (onboard avionics) and the Ground Control Station (GCS), ensuring end-to-end consistency across the air-ground system boundary.

• Define avionics system architecture including flight management, navigation, data links/command-and-control (C2) links, sensor/payload interfaces, power distribution to avionics, and health monitoring/diagnostics.

• Define and own the GCS architecture, including operator interfaces, mission planning functions, vehicle command/control functions, telemetry display, and data link ground equipment.

• Establish and maintain interface control documents (ICDs) governing the air-ground data link, command/telemetry protocols, and other critical avionics interfaces.

• Drive a modular avionics architecture (open architecture / modular open systems approach, where applicable) that supports interchangeable avionics line replaceable units (LRUs) and scalable configuration variants across the platform family.

• Lead design and integration of onboard avionics subsystems: flight control computer interfaces, navigation sensors (GPS/INS or equivalent), communications/data link equipment, avionics bus architecture (e.g., MIL-STD-1553, ARINC 429, Ethernet-based avionics buses), and payload/sensor integration interfaces.

• Define avionics packaging, wiring, and installation approach in coordination with Structures/Mechanical to support modular production and maintainability.

• Oversee avionics software/hardware integration with flight control, propulsion, and mission systems as applicable.

• Own GCS hardware and software architecture, including operator workstation design, mission planning and command/control software, and data link ground terminal integration.

• Ensure GCS human-machine interface (HMI) design supports safe, effective command and control of the unmanned aircraft across all mission phases (launch/takeoff, mission execution, recovery/landing).

• Define GCS interoperability requirements with relevant command and control networks, as applicable to the program's operational concept.

• Lead integration and test activities validating air vehicle/GCS interoperability prior to flight test and qualification.

• Apply design-for-manufacture and design-for-assembly (DFM/DFA) principles to avionics hardware design, packaging, and wiring harness architecture to enable high-rate, distributed production.

• Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Supply Chain to identify commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) and modified-COTS avionics components that reduce cost, lead time, and supply chain risk at scale.

• Lead or oversee avionics system analysis including link budget analysis, latency/bandwidth analysis for the air-ground data link, avionics reliability/FMEA analysis, and electromagnetic environmental effects (E3)/EMI-EMC analysis.

• Define and execute the avionics and GCS test program (bench, hardware-in-the-loop/HWIL, ground, and flight test) required to substantiate the design.

• Support airworthiness/qualification activities in accordance with applicable military standards relevant to UAS avionics and command/control links (e.g., applicable MIL-STD/MIL-HDBK guidance, relevant spectrum/frequency approval processes).

• Serve as the senior technical authority for avionics (onboard and GCS) on the program, representing the discipline at Preliminary Design Review (PDR), Critical Design Review (CDR), and government technical interchange meetings.

• Partner with Systems Engineering, Structures/Mechanical, Flight Controls, Software, Program Management, Manufacturing, and Quality to align avionics maturity with program schedule and cost targets.

• Some travel may be required to support flight test events, supplier visits, and government program reviews.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Avionics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline; advanced degree preferred.

• 15+ years of aircraft avionics design experience, with direct, hands-on experience on unmanned aircraft system (UAS) programs spanning both onboard avionics and Ground Control Station segments.

• Demonstrated experience owning or architecting the air-ground interface (command/control data link, telemetry, interface control documents) for a UAS program.

• Strong background in avionics system architecture, including navigation, communications/data links, and avionics bus architectures.

• Experience supporting avionics system test and integration, including hardware-in-the-loop (HWIL) testing and flight test support.

• Familiarity with Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA) principles as applied to avionics architecture.

Preferred Requirements:

• Direct experience with modular aircraft, unmanned aircraft systems (UAS), or multi-mission/multi-variant platform architectures.

• Experience designing avionics for distributed or multi-site production (as opposed to a single centralized production line).

• Experience with cybersecurity/Risk Management Framework (RMF) requirements for UAS avionics and GCS software.

• Experience with GCS human-machine interface (HMI) design and operator workflow for unmanned systems.

• Ability to obtain/maintain Secret/Top Secret/SCI clearance

Why CHAOS?

• Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

• Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

• Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

• Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

• Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

Salary Range: $198,000 - $300,000

The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.

Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.

jobs.title: Partnerships Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Million Dollar Baby Co.

Million Dollar Baby Co. started in 1990 and is proudly family-owned and operated in Los Angeles. Since then, MDB has grown to 7 distinct brands of children’s furnishings ranging in style, aesthetic, and price, while carrying some of the industry’s most eco-conscious and award-winning designs. We can be found in retailers like Target and Amazon, and specialty retailers like Pottery Barn Kids and Crate & Barrel.

Under the Million Dollar Baby Co. parent company are our family of brands: Babyletto, daVinci, Nursery Works, and Namesake. We’re proud to offer the most Greenguard Gold–certified cribs on the market and to use FSC-certified sustainable wood across our brands whenever possible. We’ve also pioneered Styrofoam-free packaging for several of our best-selling collections — an innovation that reduces waste while protecting our products during shipment.

At Million Dollar Baby Co., our team members are our #1 priority, and we partner with exceptional partners and retailers around the world who share our core values:

• Treat Your Team Like Family — lead with respect, gratitude, empathy, and kindness.
• Make an Impact, Drive Results — focus on meaningful work that moves families forward.
• Deliver a “Wow” Customer Experience Every Time — every detail matters.
• Strive for Continuous Improvement & Learning — keep growing, keep getting better.
• Cultivate Quality Conversations — communicate honestly and thoughtfully to build trust.

Over the years, our commitment to people, innovation, and a positive workplace culture has earned us five consecutive “Best Place to Work” awards, one of the best workplaces by “Built in LA”, a 4.6 rating on Glassdoor, and 13 years on the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Companies list — recognitions that reflect the heart of who we are and the community we’re proud to build. We’d love to talk to you!

About the role:

We’re looking for a Partnerships Coordinator to join the Marketing team at Million Dollar Baby Co., the parent company behind Babyletto, Namesake, and DaVinci. This role is the connective tissue between our brands, our creator partners, and the cross-functional teams that bring campaigns to life.

You’ll own the day-to-day of our influencer and UGC partnerships — sourcing creators who genuinely fit our brands, building relationships that go beyond transactional gifting, and making sure every collaboration delivers content that meets our creative standards. You’ll also serve as a key liaison for press inquiries and best-seller content needs across the portfolio.

The right person for this role is equal parts relationship builder and detail keeper — someone who can negotiate a rate, write a compelling brief, and follow through on every logistical thread without dropping a beat.

What You’ll Be Doing

Partnerships & Creator Management

• Source, vet, and build a pipeline of on-brand creators across Babyletto and Namesake, with a sharp eye for aesthetic and audience fit

• Develop and send detailed briefs that guide creators toward high-performing, brand-aligned content

• Negotiate deliverables, rates, and usage rights — balancing budget discipline with fair, relationship-forward terms

• Manage the full lifecycle of each partnership: outreach, contracting, product send-outs, content review, and payment coordination

• Review all submitted content against brief and brand standards before it goes live

• Own and organize the UGC asset library — archiving, tagging, and surfacing evergreen content for repurposing

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with the growth marketing team to align creator content with paid performance needs and surface top-performing assets

• Lead the growth marketing content grid and recommend high-performing UGC for ad creative

• Represent the partnerships function in Growth Content Alignment Meetings

• Coordinate with brand and DTC teams on priority SKUs each season to ensure creator coverage of key products

Best-Seller & Always-On Content

• Track best-sellers across channels and maintain a running hero product list

• Brief the creative team on content needs for top-performing products and flag coverage gaps before they impact performance

• Proactively surface seasonal best-seller opportunities to the broader marketing team

Press Support

• Own incoming press request management across Babyletto, Namesake, and DaVinci

• Maintain and oversee the press tracker via Google Analytics

• Serve as the point of contact between the marketing team and PR agency — providing product information, brand context, and timely support

WHO YOU ARE

• A natural relationship builder — you earn trust quickly and maintain it through consistent follow-through and clear communication

• An excellent written and verbal communicator who can shift tone between a creator DM, an internal brief, and a press response without missing a beat

• Detail-obsessed when it comes to contracts, timelines, and deliverables — nothing slips through the cracks

• You have a trained eye for brand fit: you can look at a creator’s feed and immediately sense whether they align with Babyletto’s elevated, design-forward aesthetic or Namesake’s heritage warmth

• Comfortable negotiating — you can advocate for the brand’s budget while keeping the relationship healthy

• Proactive and solutions-oriented: you flag issues early and come with a plan, not just a problem

• Genuinely interested in the creator and influencer space — you follow trends, know the platforms, and understand what makes content perform

What You Bring To The Table

• 1–3 years of experience in influencer marketing, partnerships, PR coordination, or a related field

• Experience managing creator or influencer relationships, including outreach, negotiation, and content approvals

• Familiarity with influencer platforms (e.g., ShopMy, CreatorIQ, Aspire, or similar)

• Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple projects and timelines simultaneously

• Proficiency in Google Workspace; experience with project management tools (Asana, Monday, Notion) a plus

• A portfolio or examples of past partnerships work is a strong plus

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience in the baby, kids, home, or design/lifestyle space

• Familiarity with UGC content strategy and paid social creative needs

• Exposure to PR workflows and press coordination

• Interest in AI tools and willingness to integrate them into daily workflows

California pay range

$78,000—$87,000 USD

Our Benefits:

• 100% of your health, dental and vision insurance monthly premiums paid by us!

• Flexible PTO because we respect the need for work/life harmony

• Company matching 401(k)

• Vacation reimbursement and wellness and enrichment subsidy programs

• Tuition reimbursement

• Matching charitable donations to the nonprofit organization of your choice

• Free MDB Co. swag + generous employee discount on products
