jobs.title: Nursing Dean Academic Affairs
jobs.description:
Opportunity at a Glance

Empowering. Influential. Inspiring. Passionate….these are the leadership traits that our future Dean, Academic Affairs (Nursing) will hold. You will engage, guide & lead the management, delivery and continuity of our academic nursing program. Build and empower a high-performing faculty and academic support team. Ensure curricula are current and consistently delivered to meet the college's objectives, while driving student success through data-informed strategies and maintaining full compliance with regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities

• Provides academic leadership within the faculty for the development, implementation, evaluation, and continuous improvement of the BSN curriculum, ensuring alignment with the University’s academic strategy, curriculum standards, program outcomes, and applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements.

• Execute the BSN academic strategy with a focus on driving strong student outcomes (NCLEX pass rates, persistence, graduation, and student satisfaction).

• Ensure curriculum delivery meets institutional standards and accreditation benchmarks through rigorous evaluation and continuous improvement.

• Lead and support faculty development, mentoring, evaluation, and performance review processes in accordance with University policies and applicable academic, regulatory, and accreditation standards; identify professional development needs and implement strategies to strengthen faculty effectiveness and student learning outcomes.

• Oversee hiring, onboarding, development, scheduling, performance and retention of faculty and associate deans with accountability for teaching excellence.

• Participate in and make recommendations regarding faculty appointment, promotion, tenure, retention, and other faculty employment decisions in accordance with University policies, established academic criteria, and applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements.

• Embed Chamberlain Care principles and Covista culture expectations into academic operations and support services. Fosters and maintains an environment conducive to effective teaching, learning, faculty engagement, and student success by modeling a care-based leadership approach and promoting a culture of collaboration, accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

• Manage academic operations with national support teams and budgets, faculty workload models, and instructional resources.

• Serve as a liaison between the campus/BSN academic program, central administration, national academic teams, and other University units to facilitate effective communication, coordination, implementation of academic priorities, and resolution of issues affecting program delivery and student success.

jobs.description:
Here at Ooma we empower people to connect in smarter ways. We do this by creating powerful communication experiences through our cloud-based platform to bring people together at work and at home. Our solutions help small business owners stay connected with their customers and manage their businesses from anywhere. For larger companies we provide customized unified communications solutions to meet their unique needs. At home, we help our customers connect with their loved ones by providing the #1 rated VoIP phone service available. We also provide them with peace of mind through our innovative smart home security solution. At Ooma, all our products and services are priced competitively, because we believe advanced technology should be accessible to all.

About the Role:

Ooma is looking for a Director, Infrastructure Engineering to lead the organization responsible for the infrastructure Ooma's customers depend on: data centers, public cloud, Linux server fleets, Kubernetes clusters, networking, ISP relationships, network storage, logging and monitoring infrastructure, network security, compliance, and more.

Your core mandate is to run a high-performing infrastructure organization of 12 engineers—developing team leads, driving operational excellence and reliability, owning capital and operating budgets, and continuously finding opportunities to optimize cost, vendor spend, and efficiency—all while serving as a trusted infrastructure partner to peer teams in Network Operations and to Engineering. As the company grows, you'll modernize the technology stack and scale the team and its practices to match.

If you're an infrastructure leader who is technically credible with strong individual contributors, operationally rigorous, and polished enough to present strategy to executives, this role was written for you.

What You’ll Do:

• Build and run a high-performing, distributed infrastructure organization of ~12 engineers, driving operational excellence, reliability, and accountability across all infrastructure services.

• Manage capital and operating budgets, own vendor relationships and contract negotiations, and continuously identify opportunities to reduce cost without compromising reliability.

• Set technical direction across data centers, cloud environments, Linux, Kubernetes, networking, storage, observability (logging and monitoring), and network security. Bring the technical depth to earn the respect of strong individual contributors and make sound architectural trade-offs.

• Operate as a service provider to sibling teams within Network Operations, building and maintaining the hardware platforms on which they deploy and upgrade Ooma's products and services.

• Collaborate with Product and Development teams to define, architect, and document infrastructure solutions for upcoming products and services, bringing infrastructure into the design conversation early — including SLAs, performance targets, scalability, and capacity planning.

• Establish and develop team leads, build a leadership bench, and evolve the team structure over time toward functional domains as the unified organization matures.

• Partner with Security and broader organizational leadership to define security policies and standards for data center and cloud infrastructure and lead the implementation and enforcement of those policies across all environments—including security patch and operating system upgrade cadences, and partnering with audit and compliance teams (e.g., SOX, SOC).

• Build strategic plans, roadmaps, and presentations for executive leadership that connect infrastructure investment to business outcomes.

• Own the 24/7/365 on-call escalation path. Build an escalation model and on-call program where you're accountable for outcomes—without needing to personally join every incident bridge.

• Champion automation, standardization, and modern infrastructure practices so the organization scales with the company's growth.

• Bring a point of view on where AI can meaningfully improve infrastructure operations and engineering efficiency, and help the organization explore and adopt it thoughtfully.

• Represent infrastructure externally with customers and partners as needed and serve as the infrastructure integration lead for future acquisitions.

• Operate within a genuinely flexible work model—fully remote within the US, hybrid, or onsite at our Sunnyvale, CA headquarters, your choice—aligned with the organization's US business hours, with occasional travel as needed.

• 10+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering or operations required, including 5+ years leading teams—ideally including experience leading through team leads or managers.

• Must have deep technical fluency across the domains this organization runs: Linux, Kubernetes, and open-source tooling; cloud infrastructure and environments; and core disciplines including data center operations, networking, storage, observability, and network security.

• A background in telecom, VoIP, or other carrier-grade / high-availability service environments strongly preferred.

• A demonstrated track record of measurable infrastructure cost optimization a plus. #LI-CC1

jobs.title: Hospitalists and Family Medicine Physicians: AI Diagnosis Review
jobs.description:
WHAT WE'RE RESEARCHING

We're hiring hospitalists and family medicine physicians to help us evaluate the accuracy of clinical AI tools. This research feeds directly into improving how algorithms suggest diagnoses based on patient charts. Your medical expertise will help determine where AI models succeed and where they fall short in real-world clinical scenarios.


HOW IT WORKS

You will review a series of de-identified patient records through our remote platform. For each case, you will form your own clinical diagnosis based on the provided chart. Next, you will review diagnoses proposed by an AI model and state whether you agree or disagree with its conclusions. The project requires a commitment of at least five hours to complete the assigned reviews.


WHO THIS IS FOR

This opportunity is for active physicians who are comfortable reviewing general medical cases. We welcome licensed hospitalists, family medicine physicians, and general internal medicine practitioners. You should have strong experience in chart review and differential diagnosis generation.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Review de-identified patient charts and medical records

 - Evaluate AI-proposed diagnoses for accuracy and clinical relevance

 - Dedicate a minimum of five hours to complete the case reviews


WHO SHOULD APPLY

 - Active medical license in the US

 - Practicing hospitalist or family medicine physician

 - Strong background in generating differential diagnoses

 - Available to complete remote chart reviews between September 24 and 27

jobs.title: IT Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our Mission to Protect Humankind!

Vaxcyte is a clinical-stage vaccine innovation company engineering high-fidelity vaccines to protect humankind from the consequences of bacterial diseases, which have serious and costly health consequences when left unchecked. Working to eradicate or treat bacterial infections such as invasive pneumococcal disease, Group A Strep, and Shigella is just the beginning. Our path to success is clear and well-defined, and Vaxcyte is set up to go the distance.

WHAT we do is every bit as important as HOW we do it! Our work together is guided by four enduring core values:

*RETHINK CONVENTION: We bring creative and intellectual diversity to every facet of the work we do in order to innovate and re-innovate the way vaccines are delivered.

*AIM HIGH: We embody our collectively audacious goal to courageously make the most complex biologics ever attempted to protect humankind.

*LEAD WITH HEART: Everyone leads at Vaxcyte with a kindness-first, inclusive approach to collaboration and vigorous debate that advances our business objectives.

*MODEL EXCELLENCE:  The magnitude of our challenge requires our shared commitment to demonstrating integrity, accountability, equality and clarity across communications and decision making.

Summary:

Vaxcyte is seeking an IT Operations Engineer to deliver the frontline and escalated IT support that keeps the organization running. Working within the IT Operations team, the IT Operations Engineer supports end users, manages endpoints and IT services, provisions accounts and access, and helps maintain a secure, reliable environment. This role is a strong fit for a customer-focused, hands-on technician who enjoys solving problems and wants to grow their IT career.

Essential Functions:

• Provide Tier 1 / Tier 2 IT support through the helpdesk / ticketing system, resolving issues promptly and with strong customer service while adhering to SLAs.

• Perform user onboarding and offboarding, including new hire orientation, account, access, and license provisioning across core systems.

• Deploy, configure, and support end-user devices (Windows) through Microsoft Intune / MEM and related endpoint tools.

• Provide IT support for lab computers — operating system, connectivity, endpoint management, security, and best-effort support for lab and instrument software — in partnership with Lab Operations, escalating specialized or validated-system issues as appropriate.

• Support core end-user technologies, including M365, Okta, Teams / Zoom, and conferencing / AV systems.

• Provide hands-on support for meetings and conferencing — conference-room setup, AV equipment, and video conferencing (Teams / Zoom) — including live support for meetings and company events.

• Manage IT asset inventory and lifecycle, including procurement support, tracking, and reclamation.

• Support endpoint and operational security, including endpoint protection, patching, MFA.

• Escalate complex technical issues to Systems Engineering and collaborate on resolution.

• Support cross-functional and office / facilities-adjacent IT needs as they arise.

• Create and maintain clear documentation, knowledge-base articles, and standard operating procedures.

• Participate in pre-scheduled, after-hours or on-call support for special projects or events.

• Provide first-line support and administration for end-user AI tools (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT / Claude Enterprise) — including access requests, provisioning, and troubleshooting.

• Support enforcement of AI acceptable-use and data-handling policies at the end-user level, escalating governance or security concerns as needed.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical IT experience with a minimum of 4+ years of IT support / operations experience. Biotech experience is a plus. Other combinations of education and/or experience may be considered.

• Experience providing helpdesk / desktop support and using a ticketing system (Freshservice is a plus).

• Experience managing Windows endpoints with tools such as Microsoft Intune / MEM.

• Experience supporting lab, scientific, or instrument PCs is a plus.

• Working knowledge of M365, Okta, and Zoom administration.

• Experience supporting conference-room AV and video conferencing (Teams / Zoom) is a plus.

• Strong customer-service orientation, communication skills, and a systematic approach to troubleshooting.

• Awareness of IT security fundamentals (endpoint protection, MFA, patching, security awareness).

• Exposure to supporting enterprise AI tools is a plus.

• Ability to create clear documentation, adapt and learn new skills, and follow established procedures.

• Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

Reports to: Senior Director, IT Operations & Infrastructure

Location: San Carlos, CA

Work Arrangement (may be adjusted based on business needs, job responsibilities, or changes to company policy): Onsite (minimum of 4 days per week onsite)

Compensation: The compensation package will be competitive and includes comprehensive benefits and an equity component.

Salary Range: $120,000 – $140,000

Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Please be aware of fraud or scams from individuals, organizations and/or internet sites claiming to represent Vaxcyte in recruitment activities. Vaxcyte has an established recruitment process for all positions prior to issuing an offer for employment and we will never extend unsolicited employment offers or ask candidates to provide financial or sensitive personal information as part of the application process. All legitimate communication from Vaxcyte will come from an official @vaxcyte.com email address. Qualified and interested candidates should apply to current openings at vaxcyte.com/careers.

jobs.title: Product Lead, Business Systems
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Product Lead, Business Systems
NYC CEO Office Location
Hybrid

Anticipated deadline to submit application: October 23, 2026 before 5pm EST. Position may close early if application limit is met. Apply promptly for full consideration.

The Opportunity

At CEO, Product Managers and Product Leads own a portion of the organization’s technology ecosystem and staff user experience with a focus on ensuring efficient, compliant, and integrated systems that minimize user friction.

The Product Lead - Business Systems serves as a strategic, technical, leader for CEO’s financial and operations systems. This role owns the Finance and Operations platforms strategy. An immediate priority will be supporting the end-to-end execution of our Finance technological transformation with implementation partners—including the modernization of accounting, financial planning, and grants management systems. Over time, this role will oversee adjacent enterprise platforms, including Payroll, Procurement, and potentially Contracts and People Systems.

This individual serves as a crucial organizational leader, bridging strategy, operations, and technical implementation. They will work closely with business leadership, key stakeholders, IT operations and implementation partners and to co-design, configure, deploy, maintain and support these platforms. They are responsible for driving continuous improvement, navigating complex trade-offs, and managing external vendor partners to support high-quality delivery.

As part of our mission, we strongly encourage individuals who have lived experience of incarceration or involvement in the justice system to apply for this role.

Who We Are

The Center for Employment Opportunities (CEO) provides employment services to people recently released from incarceration. Across the United States, 8,000-9,000 people participate in CEO each year, transitioning to employment that supports themselves, their families, and their communities.

What began as a demonstration project of the Vera Institute of Justice in the 1970s to address employment barriers facing the formerly incarcerated following release in New York City has grown into the leading reentry employment organization in the country, where over 30,000 formerly incarcerated individuals have secured full-time employment since 1996.

Who You Are

• You have at least 7+ years of progressive experience in enterprise business systems, internal product management, or IT product ownership within complex organizations.

• You have demonstrated experience in leading multi-year enterprise platform transformations (e.g., ERP, Financial Systems, HRIS) from vendor selection through post-implementation governance.

• You have a proven track record managing technology roadmaps, writing specifications, prioritizing backlogs, and leading cross-functional deployments.

• You have experience in collaborating closely with external implementation providers or technology consultants on large-scale system overhauls.

• you have strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to navigate reporting lines across Finance leadership and product departments.

• You have proven experience in influencing and advising Senior Leadership on technology investments, trade-offs, and risk management.

• You have deep expertise in managing and directing external implementation partners, systems integrators, and software vendors on large-scale overhauls.

Preferred

• You have expertise in core financial workflows, accounting principles, grants management structures, and fund accounting in complex, multi-entity, or non-profit context.

• You have professional certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), PMP, or administrator-level credentials in major financial planning or accounting software suites.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Key responsibilities of the Product Lead, Business Systems include but are not limited to:

Business Systems Strategy & Roadmap Execution

• Define, own, and execute the roadmap for CEO’s financial and operations systems in alignment with organization priorities.

• Drive the convergence and modernization strategy for adjacent systems and processes (e.g., Payroll, Procurement, Contracts) to eliminate data silos and manual handoffs.

• Lead and/or co-lead (with the implementation partner/lead and business owner) the implementation of finance and operations platforms and related processes .

Solutions Identification and Development

• Team with stakeholders and the implementation provider to co-design, blueprint, configure and implement new Finance systems.

• Lead the strategic selection, blueprinting, and architectural design of future business systems in collaboration with executive stakeholders and vendors.

• Lead internal product discovery deep dives as needed, mapping workflows across teams and translating distinct stakeholder needs into technical specs.

• Lead rigorous, cross-functional processes to identify, evaluate and select relevant vendors, implementation partners, and third-party tools.

Implementation and Change Management

• Develop role-specific onboarding materials and documentation to upskill staff on new systems and workflows.

• Lead change management, communication plans, and training rollouts for the updated platforms to ensure high staff adoption in partnership with business owner.

• Serve as the chief strategic translator between non-technical executive stakeholders, finance teams, and external technical development teams/implementation partners.

• Establish continuous feedback loops to identify and remove operational friction, ensuring compliance and internal controls do not impede staff productivity.

Ongoing Governance and Operations Support

• Balance the reactive requests by teams with building resilient future systems aligned to organization priorities.

• Establish clear data governance structures, security access levels, and change control protocols in tight alignment with IT security standards and external audit compliance.

• Manage the configuration, user permissions, control frameworks, and day-to-day functional administration of the systems in partnership with IT Operations.

• Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to support sustainable growth and maintenance.

• Manage external technology vendors, configuration partners, and implementation consultants as needed, holding them accountable to delivery timelines, specifications, and technical standards.

• Troubleshoot complex, tier-2 and tier-3 functional issues, managing escalation paths to software vendors or support partners when required.

• Define, track, and optimize system KPIs related to operational effectiveness (e.g., speed to close, grant tracking compliance, reporting accuracy) and general platform satisfaction.

• Audit and optimize data flows, API connections, and cross-platform integrations between financial tools and secondary organizational systems to prevent data fragmentation.

• Monitor industry trends and upcoming software releases to proactively suggest features, automation improvements, and optimizations.

• Monitor tools performance using data and qualitative employee feedback to identify, isolate, and eliminate friction points and drive continuous improvement.

• Other duties as assigned

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $118,000 to $140,000. Consistent with CEO's compensation philosophy, we place candidates within a given salary range based on comparable tenure in title, relevant knowledge, skills, and experience. The midpoint of the range generally reflects the market rate for a fully proficient employee in this role, with placement toward the top of CEO's posted range reserved for candidates with more extensive and comparable experience. In keeping with CEO's compensation philosophy, final offers also account for internal parity and geographic location.

We recognize that salary is a part of the overall compensation package and also provide a comprehensive benefits package, including medical and dental coverage, as well as professional development opportunities to our staff.

We also offer paid parental leave, participation in a retirement plan, sick and vacation leave, paid holidays and more. We are a workplace that promotes continual learning and teamwork, offering lunch and learns, team outings, holiday gatherings and more for our staff.

More About Us

Center for Employment Opportunities believes that everyone deserves the chance to shape a stronger future for themselves, their families, and their communities. People who are justice involved are highly encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels. CEO is committed to the CROWN Act, and creating an open space where our employees can present as their true authentic selves.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without unlawful discrimination based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, gender, gender identity, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, military status, prior record of arrest or conviction, citizenship status, current employment status, caregiver status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. We value diverse experiences, including with regard to educational background and justice system contact.

Please note that due to the volume of resumes received, we are unable to contact each applicant regarding the status of each position or reply to candidates' inquiries via phone or email.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer I - CI/CD - Platform Engineering Productivity
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role :

The Platform Engineering Productivity team operates the CI, CD, and Release infrastructure for the company. We ensure developers can efficiently and safely deploy changes across our various environments and at scale. In an age of AI, the landscape is evolving rapidly from scaling needs to, more than ever, securing our supply chain. There are interesting challenges to tackle.

We're looking for a proactive systems thinker who delivers on business-driven projects while identifying and driving the work that keeps our infrastructure ahead before scaling and security challenges become problems. If you're energized by work that makes every engineering team at Elastic ship faster and more securely, we'd love to hear from you.

What You Will Be Doing :

• Define the roadmap and technical vision for CI/CD, from problem identification through org-wide adoption.

• Identify where CI/CD is a bottleneck, a source of friction, or a security risk before it becomes an incident, and drive the remediation rather than waiting to be assigned it.

• Design and enforce release gates covering supply chain integrity, artifact provenance, and release readiness, built to scale across teams without becoming a tax on engineering velocity.

• Direct engineers on your team through complex, multi-quarter projects: break down the architecture, assign the work, and own the outcome even when the execution is distributed.

• Drive clear technical communication and alignment across teams, and produce high-quality documentation for systems, processes, and architectural decisions.

• Serve as Incident Commander on high-severity supply chain or release incidents, and use each incident as a forcing function for structural improvements.

• Raise the engineering bar across the org through code review, mentorship, design review, and by setting standards others adopt voluntarily.

• Remain hands-on at the right depth: you'll review code, prototype approaches, and debug production issues, but your primary leverage at this level is through the work of others, not your own output.

What You Bring :

• Deep expertise in CI/CD and what it takes to harden a release pipeline against supply chain attacks.

• Strong debugging instincts across the full pipeline stack: you trace failures from test runner to artifact store to cluster deployment without needing a specialist for each layer.

• Hands-on with CI infrastructure (Buildkite, GitHub Actions, or equivalent), GitOps/ArgoCD, and Kubernetes.

• You use AI to accelerate your own work and your team's and you understand AI's impact on supply chain security and scale.

• A track record of multi-quarter, cross-org ownership: you've identified the right problem, designed the solution, and gotten organizations that didn't report to you to change how they work.

• The judgment to push back on a prescribed plan when it's the wrong call, and the credibility to get alignment on a better approach.

• Experience directing the work of other engineers toward outcomes not just collaborating, but breaking down complex problems into executable work and holding the outcome.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary.  This role does not have a variable compensation component.

These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.  We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.

An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program.  Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

The typical starting salary range for this role is:

$159,800—$252,800 USD

The typical starting salary range for this role in the select locations listed above is:

$191,900—$303,500 USD

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

• Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary

• Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

• Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles

• Generous number of vacation days each year

• Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

• Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love

• Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.

Our Acute Behavioral Services (ABS) group homes support individuals with complex mental health and behavioral needs. Many of the people we serve have experienced frequent crises, hospital stays, or legal involvement. They may have a history of failed placements and need a highly structured environment to succeed.

Our homes are specially designed for safety, and our approach is consistent, person-centered, and focused on helping individuals reach their goals while maintaining safety for everyone. • Must be at least 18 years of age; some programs require employees to be 21 years of age or older
• Valid driver’s license and proof of auto insurance

jobs.title: Structural Engineer
jobs.description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You and The Role

The Ground System Deployments team is looking for an innovative, collaborative and self-driven Structural Engineer to join the team to ensure the successful deployment of Zipline’s Ground Systems in all possible applications and configurations.This role is well suited to structural engineers looking to apply their experience designing novel and innovative sites, foundations and structures to advance and accelerate the new and growing industry of  autonomous drone delivery ground systems. With broad scope to influence the design of current and next generation systems this role will join a stellar team responsible for the site level designs, layouts, civil designs, structural and foundation designs and implementation. Interacting with various mechanical, civil, structural and electrical engineering stakeholders across the organization this role will  ensure the overall system and its site design work hand in hand to ensure the successful deployment of Ziplines Ground Systems within cost and timeline goals.This role has a mandate to drive positive change through the organization - as problems or scenarios occur this individual will be tasked with both 0 to 1 problem/project responsibility and also working with the broad engineering and deployments organization to implement foundation changes to product and process as needed.

What You'll Do

• Be a key stakeholder responsible for structural analysis and design of:

• Charging towers

• Dropboxes and related structures

• Develop designs that are:

• Code-compliant

• Constructible

• Cost-effective and scalable

• Produce and review:

• Structural calculations

• Drawings and design documentation

• Support permitting and regulatory approvals

• Interface with:

• Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs)

• Customers and external partners

• Collaborate with:

• Mechanical and electrical engineering teams

• Real Estate and Construction teams

• Provide input on constructability and installation approaches

• Improve and maintain standard designs and design documentation

• Advise on permitting, codes and and other certification efforts relevant to the projects and structures.

• Engage and interact with cities and relevant inspectors or relevant external parties to ensure timely project approvals and deployment.

• Understand our internal and external customer’s business and needs and work with our internal engineering and business teams to refine and roadmap necessary changes to ensure the successful deployment of the Ground Systems infrastructure.

• Source and develop relationships with outside organizations (local jurisdiction, utilities, contractors, OEM and material suppliers etc).

• Evaluate all options and a lean budget, select best vendors to ensure reliable and quality services and products.

• Understand and mitigate the preconstruction, construction, operational and sustaining risks associated with each project.

• Interact directly with internal and external partners and stakeholders as needed.

• Domestic travel to project sites expected on an ad-hoc basis.

What You'll Bring

• Bachelors and/or Masters degree in Civil/Structural Engineering

• Licensed Professional Engineer (PE) in Civil Engineering and/or Structural Engineering

• 3–8+ years of experience in structural design

• Strong knowledge of:

• IBC, ASCE 7, AISC (and related codes/standards)

• Steel and/or concrete design

• Experience with tower, vertical structure, or similar systems preferred

• Experience supporting permitting and approvals

• Ability to work on non-standard or first-of-kind designs

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to communicate clearly with cross-functional teams

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, iterative environment

• Strong candidates should have excellent communications skills to:

• Drive internal alignment of requirements for projects based on business needs.

• Provide leadership team with updates on scope, schedule and budgets.

• Drive external parties for the implementation of real estate projects.

• The individual will be based at Zipline's headquarters in South San Francisco and will be expected to travel intermittently to implement Zipline's expansion in multiple metros across the US and internationally .

• Must be eligible to work in the US

What Else You Need To Know

The starting cash range for this role is $145,000 – $225,000. Please note that this is a target, starting cash range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications for this role. The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, working location, and projected impact. The total compensation package for this role may also include: equity compensation; discretionary annual or performance bonuses; sales incentives; benefits such as medical, dental and vision insurance; paid time off; and more.

jobs.title: Clinical Field Scheduling & Logistics Specialist
jobs.description:
This role is remote, though we're prioritizing candidates based in New Jersey.

The Clover Home Care team is responsible for ensuring patients have access to the right care at the right time, in the right setting. We are a group of caring and passionate professionals dedicated to improving the lives of our most vulnerable members by providing in-home primary care, annual wellness visits, supportive care services, behavioral health and community services coordination.

The Clinical Field Scheduling & Logistics Specialist supports the daily scheduling and logistics of our growing field-based clinical workforce. This role manages provider availability, assignments, routes, and real-time schedule changes to ensure patients receive timely care and field teams operate efficiently.

As a Clinical Field Scheduling & Logistics Specialist, you will:

• Manage clinician schedules, profiles, availability, and service areas in CareLink.

• Coordinate scheduling and logistics across New Jersey.

• Optimize clinician routes based on geography, availability, and operational priorities.

• Identify and resolve scheduling errors, overbooking, unused capacity, and coverage gaps.

• Manage last-minute schedule changes caused by callouts, urgent requests, and field needs.

• Coordinate daily assignments for Nurse Practitioners and Medical Assistants.

• Support the PTO approval and schedule-update process in partnership with clinical managers.

• Respond to real-time scheduling questions and resolve scheduling-related concerns.

• Train new clinical team members and operational partners on CareLink workflows.

• Use approved AI and automation tools to streamline repetitive workflows, improve accuracy, and reduce manual work.

• Document processes and maintain cross-training to ensure consistent operational coverage.

You should get in touch if:

• You have experience in scheduling, workforce coordination, field logistics, or healthcare operations.

Picogrid is seeking a detail-oriented Site Operations Associate to support security operations for a Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) project. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Calm and clear in communication. You can be polite but firm with visitors and speak up right away when something seems off.

REQUIREMENTS

Training on access control procedures and site security protocols will be provided.

This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment. Must be able to operate a computer and other standard office equipment. Must be able to remain in a stationary position, 80%.

jobs.description:
Career Opportunity: Clinical Services Responder in the Tri-State of Kentucky and Surrounding Regions

Are you looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful, life-changing impact through organ donation? In this role, you will use your clinical expertise to evaluate potential donors, coordinate critical care and support, guide hospital professionals through time-sensitive decisions, and help maximize opportunities for successful donation. This position is ideal for a compassionate, detail-oriented healthcare professional who thrives in fast-paced, sensitive, and highly collaborative environments.

As a Clinical Services Responder, you will respond to referred potential organ donors, review medical records and clinical information, determine donation suitability under organizational and regulatory guidelines, and provide timely information to donor-hospital professionals. You will also document required donor information, assess family and hospital support needs, identify the legal next-of-kin, and assist with specimen collection and labeling requirements. This position reports to the Manager of Recovery Services and works across hospital clinical settings.

We are committed to supporting the professional growth and development of our team members, with opportunities to expand skills, take on additional responsibilities, and advance within the organization. In this role, you will be expected to consistently perform your work safely, ethically, and in accordance with organizational policies, professional standards, and applicable laws and regulations. Your commitment to safety, integrity, and compassionate care will be essential to supporting donors, their families, healthcare partners, and our mission.

Responsibilities:

• Respond to potential organ donor referrals and evaluate clinical suitability using Life Connection of Ohio, CMS, OPTN/UNOS, AOPO, and CDC guidelines.

• Identify clinical triggers that support timely hospital referrals of potential donors.

• Review medical records, including present and past medical history, malignancies, surgeries, treatments, laboratory results, diagnostics, and procedural records.

• Recognize organ-specific behavioral risk factors and understand legal and hospital requirements for death declaration and organ donation.

• Assess family dynamics, available hospital support, and cultural, religious, emotional, and informational needs.

• Identify the patient’s legal next-of-kin in accordance with state law and the Uniform Anatomical Gift Act.

• Support required blood, culture, and tissue-typing specimen collection and labeling procedures.

• Maintain accurate, complete, and confidential donor records in compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.

• Maintain current knowledge of donation standards and regulatory changes and communicate relevant updates to staff and leadership.

Qualifications:

• High school diploma or GED and healthcare experience required.

• Associate degree in nursing, respiratory care, paramedic medicine, biological sciences, or a related field preferred.

• Relevant credentials may include LPN, STNA, Paramedic, EMT, or Medical Assistant.

• One to two years of hospital experience required.

• BLS, ACLS, and PALS certifications preferred.

• Strong attention to detail, time management, professional communication, and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to exercise discretion, protect confidential information, and collaborate effectively in sensitive clinical situations; nonprofit experience is helpful.

Physical Requirements:

Ability to work 12-hour shifts and outside normal business hours, respond promptly to dispatches, and travel to assigned sites. The role requires work in office and hospital settings, frequent sitting and typing, occasional physical activity, lifting up to 75 pounds, and assisting with donor transfers. Reasonable accommodations may be available to perform essential functions.

What do we offer:

• Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays.

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance options.

• Retirement savings benefits.

• Employer-supported professional development and training opportunities.

• Additional employee wellness and support resources.

If you are passionate about helping others and are ready to join a diverse and inclusive team; apply online today. Be a part of our future!

jobs.title: Engineering, Business Management/COO, Principal
jobs.description:
About TPG

TPG is a leading global alternative asset management firm, founded in San Francisco in 1992, has investment and operational teams around the world. TPG invests across a broadly diversified set of strategies, including private equity, impact, credit, real estate, and market solutions, and our unique strategy is driven by collaboration, innovation, and inclusion. Our teams combine deep product and sector experience with broad capabilities and expertise to develop differentiated insights and add value for our fund investors, portfolio companies, management teams, and communities.

TPG’s success depends on our people, and we build and sustain our world-class team by creating an inclusive, supportive culture within the firm that seeks excellence and encourages humility and transparency. The quality of our investments and our ability to build great companies depend on the originality of our insights. Reaching our firm’s full potential means supporting every team member to bring the fullness of their unique perspective to their work and to our community. We are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace to foster diversity of thought and reflect the breadth of our limited partners and portfolio companies.

Description of Position

As TPG continues to modernize its technology organization, we are seeking a Principal to join the Engineering Business Management team. This role serves as a strategic engine for the department, driving operational excellence, portfolio visibility, and execution discipline across the engineering ecosystem. Operating at the unique intersection of engineering, finance, and strategy, the Principal partners directly with Engineering leadership to ensure investments and resources are optimized to deliver measurable business outcomes.

Serving as a trusted advisor to the Engineering COO and the broader Leadership Team, this individual owns the business operations framework. You will be responsible for providing clear transparency into priorities, capacity, and delivery risks, ensuring every technical initiative aligns with TPG’s firm-wide strategic objectives.

The ideal candidate functions as a hybrid Chief of Staff and Portfolio Leader—someone who can move fluidly between high-level executive strategy and hands-on program execution. This is a high-visibility role that requires the ability to influence at all levels, translating complex engineering data into actionable business insights.

Principal Responsibilities

Engineering Portfolio Management

• Own the Engineering Book of Work and provide oversight of the engineering portfolio management process.

• Drive annual planning, quarterly prioritization, and capacity planning processes that determine where engineering resources, budget, and effort are invested.

• Partner with business leaders and Engineering leadership to ensure engineering investments, resource allocation, and delivery commitments align to firm strategic objectives and business priorities.

• Maintain visibility into strategic initiatives, delivery commitments, dependencies, risks, and organizational capacity.

• Partner with Engineering leaders to balance strategic priorities, resource allocation, and execution commitments across the portfolio.

• Build and maintain executive reporting, dashboards, and portfolio analytics that provide visibility into delivery performance, organizational capacity, engineering impact, and business enablement, helping Engineering leadership, business stakeholders, and firm senior leadership make informed decisions about priorities, investments, and strategic outcomes.

• Develop and maintain frameworks that measure not only delivery execution, but also the business value, strategic alignment, and operational impact created by engineering investments.

Strategic Program Delivery

• Lead execution of the organization's highest-priority cross-functional initiatives.

• Establish delivery plans, milestones, governance structures, and success measures.

• Coordinate across engineering teams and business stakeholders.

• Manage dependencies and remove barriers to successful execution.

• Escalate risks, trade-offs, and decision points to leadership as appropriate.

• Representative initiatives may include:

• AI transformation and productivity initiatives

• Engineering operating model transformation

• Strategic platform modernization efforts

• Enterprise tooling and developer experience programs

• Technology planning initiatives

• Organizational effectiveness initiatives

Business Operations

• Establish and run the Engineering operating cadence, including leadership reviews, planning cycles, portfolio reviews, and operational forums.

• Prepare executive communications, leadership presentations, board materials, and strategic updates.

• Drive organizational performance management through operating metrics, business reviews, and executive reporting.

• Establish mechanisms that connect firm strategic objectives to engineering priorities, investment decisions, delivery outcomes, and business value realization.

• Partner with Engineering leaders, executive leadership, and business stakeholders to improve execution discipline, transparency, accountability, and decision-making.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to the Engineering COO and Engineering Leadership Team on organizational effectiveness, execution, business operations, and strategic planning.

Financial Management

• Partner with Finance on annual budget planning, forecasting, and variance management.

• Track technology investments, vendor spend, software contracts, and contractor expenses.

• Develop capacity, funding, and investment models that support strategic planning.

• Support investment proposals and business case development.

• Establish approaches for measuring value realization, engineering productivity, business enablement, and return on investment.

Workforce Planning

• Support organizational design and workforce planning activities.

• Maintain visibility into skill gaps, hiring plans, organizational capabilities, and staffing requirements.

• Partner with Engineering leaders on headcount planning and resource allocation.

• Analyze capacity, workload, and utilization trends.

• Support talent planning, succession planning, and team growth strategies.

Continuous Improvement

• Establish engineering KPIs, operational metrics, and executive scorecards.

• Identify opportunities to simplify planning, governance, and reporting processes.

• Improve transparency and predictability across the engineering portfolio.

• Drive initiatives that increase organizational efficiency, effectiveness, and execution maturity.

• Champion data-driven decision-making across the Engineering organization.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.

• 10+ years of experience in technology business operations, program management, engineering operations, PMO leadership, consulting, strategy, finance, or related disciplines.

• Experience supporting senior technology executives and leadership teams.

• Strong portfolio, program, and operational management capabilities.

• Experience leading large-scale cross-functional initiatives.

• Exceptional executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.

• Strong analytical, financial, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to influence across organizations without direct authority.

• Experience partnering with Engineering, Product, Operations, and business stakeholders.

• Proven ability to balance strategic thinking with operational execution.

• Experience driving planning, governance, budgeting, and portfolio management processes in a technology organization.

Preferred Qualifications

• MBA, Master's degree, or equivalent advanced business, technical, or operational experience.

• Experience supporting a CIO, CTO, Engineering COO, Head of Engineering, or comparable technology executive.

• Experience establishing portfolio management, planning, governance, and operational reporting frameworks within a technology organization.

• Certifications in Program Management, Agile Delivery, Portfolio Management, or related disciplines are a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiting Manager, Advanced Effects
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Air Dominance & Strike team develops the most advanced combat aircraft and systems that ensure our forces own the skies and strike with precision when it matters most. From next-generation fighters to autonomous unmanned systems, we're building the future of aerial warfare. When pilots take off on missions, when commanders make split-second decisions, when national security hangs in the balance—our technology is there. We're not just building aircraft; we're building the edge that keeps our nation safe and our warfighters protected.

As a Recruiting Leader, You're Building:
The teams behind Advanced Effects and the Barracuda & Roadrunner families. AE is the largest revenue driver in AD&S, multi-billion dollar portfolio, and top 3 revenue driver of Anduril across all divisions. You'll find the aerospacialty engineers designing stealth capabilities, the software developers programming AI vehicle integration, the systems integrators making it all work seamlessly, and the program leaders bringing billion-dollar programs to life.

Every hire you make directly contributes to platforms that protect lives, secure freedoms, and maintain peace through strength. This isn't just recruiting—it's mission-essential talent acquisition for programs that literally define air superiority.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Senior Recruiting Manager, you are the single-threaded owner of talent delivery for a Business Line and/or Strategic Program within one of Anduril's Divisions. You combine strategic business partnership with direct people leadership. This role exists at the intersection of strategy and execution. You are embedded deeply within your Business Line - understanding its programs, products, revenue drivers, and leadership priorities at a level that allows you to translate business objectives into hiring strategies, prioritize demand against capacity, and ensure the right talent lands on the right programs at the right time.

As a Sr. Recruiting Manger, you add direct people leadership - owning performance management, coaching, career development, and capacity allocation for a team of recruiters while simultaneously acting as the strategic advisor for your key stakeholders.

You are the voice of the business to TA and the voice of TA to the business. You own the hiring plan, the reporting, the escalations, and the outcomes. This is the formalized leadership layer within our Business Line construct - the person who ensures every major program and initiative has the talent it needs to hit its milestones.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Strategic Business Partnership & Ownership

• Own the end-to-end TA strategy for your assigned Business Line, including headcount planning, demand management, requisition prioritization, and delivery against hiring targets tied to program milestones and revenue commitments.

• Act as a trusted advisor to BL leadership (VP, Program Directors, General Managers, and Division Heads), using market intelligence, hiring data, and capacity models to influence decisions and shape the talent roadmap.

• Define and manage hiring goals, SLAs, and success metrics for your Business Line — reporting progress through dashboards and business reviews with full transparency on pipeline health, risks, and capacity.

• Partner with Division BizOps, Finance, and Workforce Planning to align on headcount allocation, budget, hiring sequencing, and revenue-driven demand changes.

• Own all hiring progress reporting for your Business Line, delivering regular updates to divisional leadership and acting as the primary escalation point for hiring blockers.

Recruiting Execution & Delivery

• Set the standard for recruiting excellence: sourcing strategy, candidate engagement, assessment rigor, and closing. You are the bar that your team calibrates against.

• Maintain hands-on market expertise by actively recruiting on a select portfolio, ensuring you deeply understand talent availability, compensation dynamics, and competitive positioning for your BL's role families.

• Lead major cross-functional hiring initiatives and surge efforts for your BL — batch days, high-volume campaigns, and ramp-to-milestone sprints — acting as the single-threaded owner for program execution.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

• Provide direct people leadership for recruiters aligned to your Business Line: performance management, coaching, mentorship, career development, and structured feedback through regular 1:1s.

• Manage recruiter allocation, capacity, and performance tracking — acting as the single source of truth for the Divisional Head of TA on team health and delivery confidence.

• Foster a high-performance culture that emphasizes skill development, collaboration, data discipline, and delivering a world-class candidate and hiring manager experience.

• Provide structured, high-quality feedback into recruiter performance reviews, ensuring business impact and hiring outcomes are recognized alongside activity metrics.

jobs.title: Tableau Developer, People Analytics (Contract)
jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Tableau Developer, People Analytics (6-Month Contract)

Remote (Preference for CST)

About the Team

At PlayStation, we're not just building the Best Place to Play — we're also building the Best Place to Work.

The People Analytics team within Sony Interactive Entertainment's (SIE) People & Places organization partners with leaders across the business to transform people data into meaningful insights and smarter decisions. We're a small but mighty team passionate about making data more accessible, actionable, and engaging for the people who use it.

We're currently on a mission to level up our entire portfolio of People Analytics dashboards — reimagining how we visualize workforce and workplace data, expanding access to insights, and empowering more leaders to make informed decisions through intuitive, self-service analytics.

We're looking for an experienced Tableau Developer to join us on a 6-month contract and help bring this vision to life.

About the Role

As a Tableau Developer on the People Analytics team, you'll play a critical role in modernizing our dashboard portfolio, combining exceptional data visualization skills with the technical expertise needed to make people data more accessible without compromising security.

You'll focus on two key priorities:

• Dashboard Modernization: Transform existing Tableau dashboards into visually compelling, intuitive, and high-impact analytical products. Improve aesthetics, functionality, usability, and content to help our stakeholders find the insights they need and understand what actions to take.

• Expanded Access & Row-Level Security: Design and implement scalable row-level security solutions within Tableau, enabling us to safely expand dashboard access to new audiences while ensuring users see only the employee data they're authorized to access.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves building exceptional data products, enjoys solving technical challenges, and takes pride in creating solutions that people genuinely want to use.

What You'll Be Doing

Dashboard Design & Development

• Lead the redesign, development, and enhancement of existing Tableau dashboards, incorporating modern data visualization best practices, intuitive navigation, and engaging user experiences.

• Partner with People Analytics team members and stakeholders to understand business questions, identify opportunities for improvement, and translate requirements into effective dashboard solutions.

• Optimize dashboard performance, usability, and maintainability, ensuring solutions are scalable and deliver a seamless user experience.

• Incorporate user feedback into iterative improvements, balancing visual appeal, analytical accuracy, and practical business needs.

• Build dashboards that empower stakeholders to independently explore data, answer business questions, and make informed decisions.

Row-Level Security & Data Access

• Design, implement, test, and maintain robust row-level security (RLS) solutions within Tableau to support expanded access to sensitive employee data.

• Develop scalable security models that dynamically restrict data visibility based on user identity, organizational hierarchy, role, or other defined access permissions.

• Collaborate with People Analytics and relevant technology/security partners to ensure security implementations align with organizational data governance and privacy requirements.

• Validate security configurations through comprehensive testing, including different user roles, access scenarios, and organizational changes.

• Document security architecture, configuration, and maintenance procedures to enable reliable ongoing administration by the People Analytics team.

Data Integration & Technical Excellence

• Develop and optimize Tableau data sources, connections, and underlying data models, primarily leveraging Snowflake.

• Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and prepare data for dashboard development.

• Troubleshoot data quality, performance, and integration issues across dashboards and underlying data sources.

• Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and standardize dashboard development and maintenance processes.

• Collaborate with team members to ensure knowledge transfer, thorough documentation, and sustainable solutions beyond the contract period.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• Significant hands-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining complex Tableau dashboards in a professional environment.

• Advanced Tableau expertise, including dashboard design, calculated fields, parameters, filters, actions, data modeling, performance optimization, and visualization best practices.

• Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and maintaining row-level security in Tableau, including user-based access controls, entitlement/security mapping, and dynamic data filtering.

• Strong understanding of Tableau's security architecture and how permissions, data sources, and row-level security interact.

• Proficiency working with relational databases and querying data using SQL or comparable technologies.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical challenges independently.

• Experience translating business requirements into intuitive, high-quality analytical products.

• Excellent attention to detail, particularly when working with sensitive or confidential information.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to independently manage priorities, deliver high-quality work within defined timelines, and document solutions for long-term sustainability.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Snowflake, including querying, data modeling, and optimizing Tableau connections to Snowflake datasets.

• Experience with Alteryx or similar ETL/data preparation tools for automating data transformation and integration workflows.

• Experience working with HRIS or People Analytics data, particularly employee records, organizational hierarchies, and workforce metrics.

• Familiarity with enterprise Tableau environments, including Tableau Server or Tableau Cloud administration, permissions, and governance.

• Experience implementing dynamic row-level security based on organizational hierarchies or complex business rules.

• Experience modernizing existing dashboard portfolios, including establishing reusable design patterns and development standards.

• Familiarity with Workday or other enterprise HR systems.

Who You Are

• Design-minded: You believe a great dashboard should be as intuitive and engaging as it is analytically rigorous.

• Technically curious: You enjoy untangling complex data and security challenges and finding elegant, scalable solutions.

• Impact-driven: You care about more than delivering a dashboard — you want to know whether people use it and whether it helps them make better decisions.

• Collaborative: You're an approachable partner who welcomes feedback, shares knowledge, and helps others succeed.

• Detail-oriented: You understand that accuracy, privacy, and security are non-negotiable when working with people data.

• Pragmatic and adaptable: You balance innovation with practical execution, recognizing that delivering sustainable improvements matters more than chasing perfection.

The Impact You'll Make

By the end of this 6-month engagement, you'll have helped transform how leaders across PlayStation access and interact with workforce insights.

Your work will contribute to a modernized, more intuitive dashboard portfolio, a scalable foundation for secure access to people data, and a more self-sufficient People Analytics team equipped to maintain and expand these capabilities into the future.

Most importantly, you'll help us turn people data into better decisions — and better experiences for the people who make PlayStation extraordinary.

jobs.title: Senior Tax Analyst
jobs.description:
Summary

Topstep is seeking a hands-on Senior Tax Analyst to support its growing U.S. and international tax function. This individual contributor role will be a key member of the Finance team and will help build a scalable, well-controlled in-house tax compliance function. The role will initially focus on recurring indirect tax compliance across U.S. sales and use tax, Canada GST/HST, EU VAT/OSS, Australia GST, and New Zealand GST, with responsibility expanding as Topstep registers and becomes compliant in additional jurisdictions. The Senior Tax Analyst will work closely with the Tax Director, Accounting, Treasury, People/Payroll, Legal, Operations, Avalara, and external tax advisors to ensure accurate filings, timely payments, complete journal entries and reconciliations, and strong supporting documentation. A key near-term objective is to support the transition of recurring indirect tax compliance in-house beginning with the January 2027 compliance cycle.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and support recurring indirect tax compliance across U.S. sales and use tax, Canada GST/HST, EU VAT/OSS, Australia GST, New Zealand GST, and additional jurisdictions as the compliance footprint expands.

• Support the transition of recurring indirect tax compliance from external providers to the internal tax function beginning with the January 2027 compliance cycle.

• Prepare monthly and quarterly tax returns and supporting workpapers; ensure filings and related tax payments are completed accurately and on time.

• Extract, validate, and reconcile tax data from NetSuite, Avalara, payment processors, and other source systems, and investigate differences between tax collected, reported, paid, and general ledger balances.

• Prepare indirect tax journal entries, accruals, true-ups, and balance sheet account reconciliations, and maintain complete filing and payment support.

• Maintain the tax compliance calendar, registrations, filing frequencies, portal access, tax IDs, deadlines, and filing/payment confirmations.

• Coordinate with Avalara and external advisors on filings, data requests, notices, registrations, taxability matters, and open compliance issues.

• Assist with responses to state, federal, and international tax notices, audits, and information requests, including maintaining an organized record of correspondence and resolutions.

• Coordinate data gathering and workpaper support for federal, state, and international direct tax compliance, including returns, extensions, estimated payments, and tax provision support performed with external advisors.

• Provide support to People/Payroll on state tax registrations, payroll tax notices, withholding compliance, and related filings as needed.

• Research taxability, nexus, filing requirements, and new jurisdiction obligations and support implementation of new registrations and compliance processes.

• Identify opportunities to improve tax processes, documentation, controls, and automation, including effective use of Avalara, NetSuite, and other tax technology.

• Partner with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, People/Payroll, and Operations on tax-related matters and support forecasting, exposure analyses, and other ad hoc tax projects.

Required Qualifications and Key Competencies

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field.

• 4-7 years of progressive tax experience in a corporate, public accounting, or advisory environment.

• Strong hands-on tax compliance, reconciliation, and Excel skills, with the ability to manage recurring monthly and quarterly deadlines across multiple jurisdictions.

• Experience with U.S. sales and use tax and/or international VAT/GST compliance strongly preferred.

• Experience with Avalara and NetSuite, including tax data extraction, reconciliation, or compliance workflows, strongly preferred.

• Experience supporting corporate income tax compliance and coordinating with external tax advisors preferred.

• CPA, EA, MST, or similar tax/accounting credential preferred but not required.

• Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with high attention to detail and accountability for personal deliverables.

• Ability to operate as a hands-on individual contributor, prioritize competing deadlines, document processes, and collaborate effectively across Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, People/Payroll, Operations, and external advisors.

Company Culture & Perks

• Topstep is an engaging working environment that ranges from fully remote to hybrid. We foster a culture of collaboration by keeping cameras on during meetings and maintaining a robust Slack environment for communication.

• Seven Company-paid Holidays and generous Family Leave. Paid time off is front-loaded.

• Competitive 401(k) matching, health, dental, and vision insurance are offered for full-time employees.

• Vacations are encouraged with a bonus for taking 5 consecutive days. Topstep offers a food and groceries budget and contributes towards health and wellness.

New Hire Base Salary Range

• $95,000.00 - $120,000.00 annually.

• The compensation offered will take into account the internal compensation structure and may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, among other factors.

• This position is eligible for a performance-based bonus as provided by the plan terms and governing documents.

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
